title: Electrical Design Engineer, Data Center Design Engineering
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help. You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Amazon Web Services is seeking a Jr. Electrical Engineer to become part of a global engineering team, responsible for the design and continuous innovation of our rapidly expanding data center foot print.

Engineers at Amazon work to design resilient, cost effective electrical distribution systems. As engineers at Amazon we are responsible for achieving a world class uptime for our customers. We justify and communicate the technical decisions we make to Sr. Management and work hard to drive continuous advancements and improvements with our designs. As an engineer at Amazon you have the ability to drive change and define/design the systems our customers rely on.

Amazon offers a fast paced, fun, and exciting work environment. We continue to grow at exponential rates and are looking for individuals that can support our speed to market, enjoy a challenge, and have a desire for professional growth and continuous learning experiences. Amazon’s work environment is unique in every aspect and offers an exceptional opportunity for the right candidate.

If you are a creative, smart and driven individual that enjoys working with complex problems we want YOU! At Amazon you will be responsible for working on multi-million dollar designs that support our array of businesses and wide variety of customers. Great ideas are encouraged and supported. Ingenuity is the main mechanism which supports our focus on quality, speed, and cost.

We are looking for engineers with hands on electrical design experience. If you can design an electrical system, have an understanding of the critical equipment needs for a data center, and understand the constructability of varying designs you may be a good fit. As we grow we are structuring our team to own more of our engineering in house. Engineers will be responsible for taking designs from concept to the permit and construction document set. You must be capable of defining critical equipment specifications and approving equipment submittals. Engineers will directly support construction and be a part of the process from site selection review through commissioning and ultimately turnover. At Amazon we highly support continued learning opportunities and focus on continued employee development.

At Amazon team work is absolutely necessary for us to accomplish our goals. You must be able to work within a team and depend on others to accomplish the required work. As an electrical engineer at Amazon you will be working with other internal groups as well as external groups including utilities, manufacturers, vendors, and contractors.

Amazon has a global presence. As this position is based out of Seattle, WA, travel to our data centers (located Oregon, Ohio and throughout AMER region), yearly team off-sites and vendor factory visits are required. Travel could be up to 20% of your time.


Key job responsibilities
Responsibilities of the Jr. Electrical Engineer:
Under the direction of a senior engineer, the Jr. Electrical Engineer will be responsible for the following:
- Data center electrical designs and collaboration with other disciplines to create a construction document set.
- Creation of designs which meet or exceed our quality requirements and fall within our budgetary requirements.
- Work with local agencies having jurisdiction to ensure compliance with federal, state and municipal requirements and building codes.
- Review and approval of equipment submittals.
- Define project scope and provide technical support for information requests prior to, and during construction phases.
- Work with commissioning teams to properly test and validate installation, operation, and performance of electrical systems.
- Ability to work on concurrent projects in multiple geographical regions.
- Travel to sites for site review and work with onsite field engineers, as well as provide engineering evaluations, electrical systems audits, and startup as needed.
- Having fun and offering creative, out of the box solutions.

About the team
Why AWS? About AWS Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to celebrate our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Work/Life Balance We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Mentorship & Career Growth We have a career path for you no matter what stage you’re in when you start here. We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Our team also puts a high value on work-life balance. Striking a healthy balance between your personal and professional life is crucial to your happiness and success here, which is why we aren’t focused on how many hours you spend at work or online. Instead, we’re happy to offer a flexible schedule so you can have a more productive and well-balanced life—both in and outside of work.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or a related field
- Knowledge of critical data center mechanical and electrical equipment
- Knowledge of Microsoft Office including Outlook, Word, and Excel
- Experience with the design, construction, operation, or maintenance of mission critical facilities, especially data centers

Preferred qualifications

- Knowledge of building codes and regulations for your region
- Knowledge of commercial or industrial power systems or mechanical systems
- Experience carrying design concepts through exploration, development, and into deployment or mass production
- Experience using a variety of web-based and other software tools for calculation and data processing

title: Retail Lead Associate (Reduced-Time), Customer Experience Operations
descriptionHtml:
Pay starts at $19.7 per hour with benefits available.

Reduced Time Hours: Average work between 30-39 hrs per week.

This role requires open availability FH 2:45-9:15pm.

As a Retail Lead Associate, you will be the face of Amazon and contribute to the culture based on customer obsession, trust, respect, integrity, continuous learning, and fun. You possess strong attention to detail, the ability to quickly prioritize tasks, the willingness to learn new things, and a commitment to delighting our customers. title: Industrieelektroniker:innen/Mechatroniker:innen
descriptionHtml:
Das Wartungs- und Instandhaltungsteam (Reliability Maintenance Engineering Team oder RME-Team) ist für unseren Betrieb von fundamentaler Bedeutung – es sorgt dafür, dass unsere technischen Systeme und Anlagen laufend funktionieren. Als Instandhaltungstechniker:in bist Du für die Wartung und Instandhaltung unserer förder- und haustechnischen Anlagen sowie Produktionsanlagen zuständig. Du hilfst, die höchsten Sicherheitsstandards im Arbeitsschutz zu gewährleisten und Maschinenausfallzeiten zu verhindern. Unser technisches Team stellt eine hohe Verfügbarkeit der technischen Anlagen sicher und verbessert die Qualität unserer Geräte.


Key job responsibilities
- Ausführung präventiver Wartungsmaßnahmen an einer breiten Vielfalt von Geräten an unseren Standorten
- Durchführung von Reparaturen und Fehlerdiagnosen
- Verwendung neuester Tools zur Maximierung der Geräteeffektivität
- Einhaltung aller Arbeitsschutzrichtlinien und -praktiken
- Unterstützung der Entwicklung und des beruflichen Fortschritts von Auszubildenden am Standort
- Arbeit an Projekten zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung und Einführung von Best Practices an verschiedenen EU-Standorten

A day in the life
Als Instandhaltungstechniker:in bist Du vor Ort in einem unserer Logistikzentren tätig, um schnell auf technische Störungen reagieren zu können. Du führst eine Reihe geplanter präventiver Wartungsmaßnahmen an Geräten durch, um für ihren sicheren Betrieb zu sorgen. Außerdem reagierst Du als Instandhaltungstechniker:in unverzüglich auf Störungen und Ausfälle. Du untersuchst die Ursachen, findest so schnell wie möglich Lösungen und wendest sie an. Zudem machst Du Vorschläge für langfristige Verbesserungen.
In Zusammenarbeit mit leitenden Kolleg:innen nimmst Du tägliche Wartungsaufgaben wahr und kommunizierst mit Dienstleistern, falls Du externe Expertise benötigst. Du arbeitest in rotierenden Schichten, damit wir rund um die Uhr unsere Standorte unterstützen – und dafür sorgen, dass Amazon weiterhin in dem Tempo liefern kann, für das wir bekannt sind.

Basic qualifications

- Abgeschlossene technische Berufsausbildung, anerkannt durch die Industrie- und Handelskammer (IHK) oder Handwerkskammer (HWK). Nachweis eines erfolgreich abgeschlossen Hochschulstudium im Ingenieurwissenschaftlichen Bereich (Maschinenbau / Elektrotechnik oder artverwandt) einer deutschen Hochschule oder anerkannte ausländische Hochschulabschlüsse (BA, B. Sc., MA, M. Sc., Dipl.-Ing.)
- Mindestens zweijährige Berufserfahrung in dem entsprechenden Handwerk.
- Erfahrung in der Instandhaltung von industriellen Produktionsanlagen.
- Fortgeschrittene Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.

Preferred qualifications

- Erfahrung mit zustandsorientierter Überwachung.
- Erfahrung in der Arbeit mit Druck- und Applikationsmaschinen.
- Erfahrung in der Störungssuche und Wartung von Förder- oder Automationssystemen.

title: Principal HR Business Partner, Ops Tech PXT
descriptionHtml:
Amazon is looking for a Principal HR Business Partner to support the Robotics organization. This is a rare opportunity to operate at the intersection of people strategy and one of Amazon's most ambitious and fast-moving businesses — teams inventing the world's most advanced technology.

The Principal HRBP will set and drive the people and organizational strategy for a complex, high-stakes business. This role requires a leader who can define the vision, navigate significant ambiguity, and deliver results across large, multi-dimensional organizations. You will serve as a trusted advisor to senior executives, influencing critical decisions on talent, organizational design, and culture.

This is both a strategic and hands-on role. You will own the people agenda end-to-end: diagnosing organizational health, designing and executing integrated talent solutions, leading enterprise-scale change, and building the mechanisms that scale best practices across the business.

Key job responsibilities

Set the vision and strategy for organizational design across complex organizations;
Design and implement scalable org structures aligned to business strategy
Serve as a coach and advisor to leadership teams, challenging mental models and continuously strengthening culture.
Assess long-term and immediate senior leader talent needs; develop strategies to build required capabilities through hiring, internal development, and succession planning.
Lead complex change initiatives across multiple organizations and geographies; own the change strategy from diagnosis through durability assessment.
Use listening mechanisms and data to identify trends, risks, and hotspots; translate insights into change plans that de-risk the business and maximize customer experience.
Own the long-term workforce plan for the business, aligned to cost, skills, and location strategy; provide perspective on tradeoffs and resourcing decisions.
Proactively create talent goals and cadence with the Senior Leadership team, embedding inclusive talent mechanisms into the rhythm of business.
Anticipate industry trends and future talent needs; partner with central teams to identify capability gaps and propose solutions that accelerate business objectives.
Communicate effectively, decomposing complex problems into clear, actionable solutions.
-Create scalable mechanisms and best practices and educate others on them.
-Identify and mitigate risks before they become roadblocks.

- Bachelor's degree
- 10+ years of human resources management experience
- Experience working directly with senior executives and leadership teams
- Experience creating and implementing large-scale organizational programs
- Experience demonstrating strong analytical abilities and confidence in the use of data
- Experience translating business strategy and goals into optimal HR processes that are scalable, simple, customer-focused and adaptable to unique and changing business needs

- Experience working cross-functionally and across regions
- HRBP experience supporting technical or engineering populations

title: Program Manager – Data Governance, LMAQ
descriptionHtml:
Amazon.com’s success is built on a foundation of customer obsession. Have you ever thought about what it takes to successfully deliver millions of packages to Amazon customers seamlessly every day like a clock work? To make that happen, behind those millions of packages, billions of decision get made by machines and humans. Last Mile Technology team make this happen. The Last Mile Analytics and Quality team (LMAQ) works within Last Mile Tech to bridge the automation gaps on problems where no technology exists or the tech solution is in the works. The team has an eco-system of quality specialists, program managers and BI Engineers working together to improve geo-spatial data quality and support the driver lifecycle & experience programs.

As the team expands, we need a Data Governance Framework to identify and eliminate data and information security risks (current and future). The program manager will define the framework working with the program and tech teams, benchmarking and adopting the best practices from different teams across Amazon. Individual will own the framework and conduct the audits at regular cadence.


Key job responsibilities
The successful candidate will :
• Be a custodian of the data usage risks when liaising with internal teams to help drive tools and process improvements that affect secure management workflows
• Proactively identify pain points and opportunities for continual secure process simplification and improvement to create program efficiencies
• Monitor existing metrics, analyze data, and partner with other internal teams (e.g., engineering, finance, Business Operations, technical operations, Business Intelligence, Product management, Partnership, legal & public policy) to identify process and system improvement opportunities.
• Create compliance frameworks for use of AI technologies enabling stakeholders to understand and implement compliance requirements.
• Conduct AI reviews and audits to identify risks and implement risk mitigation measures. Collaborate with stakeholders to implement risk mitigation measures and monitor risks.
• Monitor AI and Data privacy regulations and advise business leaders and tech teams on emerging regulatory challenges.
• Create and publish Data Privacy risk review reports for leaders detailing the risks, root causes, impacts, risk mitigation measures, action owners and risk closure timelines. Monitor all the identified risks.
• Work towards improving the data privacy risk review process, improving the quality of the risk register, and identifying opportunities for automation and tools improvements.
• Drive the "Data Governance Training and Awareness Program," in collaboration with LMAQ Learning & Development Team, providing data handling training and data security Do's and Don'ts to the employees.
• Provide privacy-by-design and AI use guidance to business teams creating new use cases for analyzing customer data.
• Maintain comprehensive, high quality & up-to-date program & policy documentation that clearly outlines risks mitigations, standards, controls & policies.
• Periodically conduct internal audits & reviews on controls & processes to identify gaps & strengthen controls.
• Collaborate with internal information security, fraud and abuse teams to identify & mitigate risks.
• Act as single-threaded owner ensuring compliance requirements are implemented by establishing project plans, defining owners and milestones, reporting status to senior management and driving towards launch approval
• Work with product management and engineering teams to prioritize scalable technology solutions to enable business growth within compliance standards.
• Create clear compliance requirements for tech and product teams to translate into engineering requirements

Basic qualifications

- Experience in program or project management
- 7+ years of data governance, data privacy, risk management, use case/tool audits and reviews
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- Experience with data privacy laws including GDPR, DPDPA, etc.
- Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
- Experience with risk management, information security or compliance framework management
- Experience with stakeholder management including tech teams

Preferred qualifications

- Experience of working in an product engineering organization
- Experience in influencing senior leadership through data driven insights
- Software development experience, or experience of working closely with the tech, BI and DE teams

title: Capacity Planner AMZL, AMZL
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Logistics India (IN AMZL) is looking for a driven and analytical professional to join the Short Term Capacity Planning team. This role sits at the intersection of operations, data analytics, and strategic planning — responsible for ensuring the right capacity is available across VAN and BIKE service networks to meet customer promise while optimizing cost-to-serve.

The Short Term Capacity Planner will own near-term capacity planning across DSP, Hubs, AMFLEX, and emerging channels, ensuring delivery sufficiency across all zones and stations in India.

Key Responsibilities
Capacity Planning & Forecasting

Own weekly and daily capacity plans across all channels (DSP, hubs, AMFLEX, and emerging) for the India network
Develop and maintain short-term (D-1, D-7) capacity plans aligned with volume forecasts
Build cycle-level volume predictions and translate them into actionable block and route plans
Lead capacity planning for High Volume Events (HVEs) including Prime Day, ART events, and peak seasons, ensuring cost and capacity sufficiency
Performance Monitoring & Analytics

Track and analyze key capacity metrics including DPPH (Deliveries Per Productive Hour), assignment compliance, block mix, and ROBL (Return-on-Business-Load) across zones
Conduct Daily Business Reviews (DBR), Weekly Business Reviews (WBR), and Monthly Business Reviews (MBR) with actionable insights
Identify capacity gaps, over/under-supply situations, and recommend corrective actions proactively
Block Mix & Cost Optimization

Optimize block mix across VAN and BIKE channels to reduce cost-to-serve while maintaining service levels
Manage DSP, eDSP, and pickup pricing strategies to eliminate defects and improve productivity
Drive initiatives to improve assignment compliance and reduce unplanned shipments
Cross-functional Collaboration

Partner with Routing, Supply Planning, and Operations teams to align capacity inputs with routing configurations and station-level constraints
Collaborate with BI and tech teams to build scalable planning tools, dashboards, and automated reporting
Work with regional and global AMZL teams (NA, EU) for benchmarking and adoption of best practices
Process Improvement & Governance

Develop and maintain SOPs, planning frameworks, and governance mechanisms for capacity decisions
Lead automation initiatives such as auto-cap approval workflows and CTO-based capacity enrichment
Drive standardization of planning processes across stations and zones

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of tax, finance or a related analytical field experience
- 5+ years of Excel (including VBA, pivot tables, array functions, power pivots, etc.) and data visualization tools such as Tableau experience
- 3+ years of business or financial analysis experience
- Experience defining requirements and using data and metrics to draw business insights
- Experience making business recommendations and influencing stakeholders
- Experience with Excel

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of business analyst, data analyst or similar role experience

title: Software Development Manager III, Apollo
descriptionHtml:

To meet the ever-growing demand for AWS Services around the globe, we need exceptionally talented, bright, and driven people.

Amazon’s massive software deployment system, Apollo, is a core part of Amazon and AWS high availability and expansion, enabling thousands of distributed software services running on millions of servers with constantly-updating software and no downtime. We are looking for a Software Development Manager who will have the opportunity to attract and lead a team of Software Development Engineers that will expand Apollo into new AWS locations, and scale it to assure the operational success of the systems used to deploy some of the largest cloud services on the planet, such as EC2, S3, DynamoDB, and the thousands of services behind Amazon’s consumer brands.

Do you like automating complex tasks, solving technical problems, and working with systems at scale? Do you have experience managing large, complex programs? Want to learn how to stand up new AWS regions from scratch?

A Software Development Manager in our team will play a critical role in shaping the roadmap for the expansion of Apollo. - 7+ years of working directly within engineering teams experience
- 3+ years of designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- 8+ years of leading the definition and development of multi tier web services experience
- Knowledge of engineering practices and patterns for the full software/hardware/networks development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, certification, and livesite operations

- Experience in communicating with users, other technical teams, and senior leadership to collect requirements, describe software product features, technical designs, and product strategy
- Experience in recruiting, hiring, mentoring/coaching and managing teams of Software Engineers to improve their skills, and make them more effective, product software engineers

title: Senior Security Solution Architect, APJC Customer Security, APJC Customer Security
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is seeking a Senior Secure AI Solution Architect to join our APJC Customer Security team. This is a builder's role. Customers across the region are moving fast on AI and seeking guidance on challenges they have not faced before — how to give autonomous agents an identity, how to defend against prompt injection, how to govern the AI development lifecycle, and how to produce the governance evidence a regulator will trust. You are the architect who helps them get there, working hands-on in their environment to build the prototypes and proofs of concept that turn ambition into validated proof — often in days.

You operate at the frontier, where the path forward is still being defined. Customers have a clear objective: put agentic AI into production while managing risk, regulatory, and data-residency obligations. Your role is to design the way there — creating new approaches where no established pattern exists and applying judgment about each customer's operational context and regulatory environment. You are technically self-sufficient: you write the code, deploy it with IaC, harden it, and demonstrate it live against real data.

Depth alone is not the job — scale is. The hardest problems you solve with one customer should lift the whole field. You independently dive deep on complex, novel Secure AI challenges, produce original technical content (reference architectures, working code, patterns, workshops), and share it so a pattern proven with one customer becomes something every area can reuse. You own the relationship with AWS service teams (Bedrock, AgentCore, SageMaker) — you are the voice of the field that shapes the product roadmap, and the voice of the product that shapes field guidance.

Security and governance are what let customers say yes to AI with confidence. You give the CISO the frameworks, evidence, and tooling to move quickly and safely, and you give the CIO/CTO confidence that governance won't slow delivery. You are the proof that AWS is the best place to build securely with AI.

Key job responsibilities
Key job responsibilities

Build working prototypes and proofs of concept in customer sandbox environments — using AWS AI services (Bedrock, AgentCore, SageMaker), AI-augmented development tooling, and IaC (CDK, Terraform) — that prove a Secure AI control works against the customer's data and risk model, in days rather than quarters.
Implement directly to unblock decisions: stand up agentic-identity, prompt-injection-defence, AI development lifecycle, guardrail, and audit/evidence patterns that validate what conversations alone cannot.
Stay engaged through implementation so the design holds against reality; exercise judgment on when to revise the approach based on what you learn.

Partner with the Bedrock, AgentCore, and SageMaker service teams — you are the voice of APJC field security requirements that shapes what ships, and the voice of the product that shapes what the field advises.

Feed customer voices back through feature requests and direct engagement, staying current with a threat and regulatory landscape that moves in hours.
Translate service-team roadmap into field-ready guidance, ensuring it gets packaged at scale.
Produce original technical content — reference architectures, working code, patterns, blog posts, and workshops — that peers and customers adopt, turning a single customer win into reusable regional IP.
Mentor and develop others — area-based Solutions Architects and the wider field community — raising the Secure AI technical bar across the region and growing the next set of specialists.
Hand proven patterns to the content and enablement team so guidance reaches the field without requiring your presence.

A day in the life
You start the morning in a customer's sandbox, not a slide deck. A financial-services customer wants to launch an agentic application on Bedrock, and overnight the identity and audit controls you built produced exactly the evidence their CISO needed. You tidy the code, capture the pattern, and prep a short summary naming the two guardrail settings that gave them confidence to proceed.

Mid-morning you join your Security Sales partner and the area account team with a manufacturer who wants to build with Bedrock and needs guidance on governing data residency and PII. It is a genuinely new problem — no established pattern exists — so you design the way forward: you whiteboard an agentic-identity and data-residency approach, then commit to prototyping the non-human-identity pattern their builder team will adopt.

After lunch you go heads-down and build it — hands on keyboard, deploying to a sandbox, hardening it — then run a working session with a customer's platform team on prompt-injection defence for a coding-assistant rollout.

You close the day scaling beyond yourself: you package this week's FSI win into a reference architecture the other areas can reuse, hand it to the content team to turn into a workshop, share a write-up with the field, and file a feature request for the AgentCore team based on what you learned. No two days look the same, but the thread is consistent: you help a customer accelerate securely, then turn what you built into something the whole region benefits from.

About the team
APJC Customer Security helps customers across the region adopt AI on AWS with confidence — ensuring security, risk, and regulation accelerate AI adoption rather than slow it down. We run two coupled programmes: Secure AI (making AWS the best place to build securely with AI) and AI for Security (using AI to help customers defend themselves). As a Senior Secure AI Solution Architect, you are the deep technical expertise brought directly to where customers need it. You define the approach on novel problems, prove it hands-on, then hand the pattern to the content team and the field to scale. You will have a clear development path, a peer community of specialists, direct leadership visibility, and the autonomy to set technical direction in one of the most consequential areas in the industry.

Basic qualifications

- 8+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics) experience
- 3+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience
- 10+ years of IT development or implementation/consulting in the software or Internet industries experience

Preferred qualifications

- 5+ years of infrastructure architecture, database architecture and networking experience
- Experience within specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics).

title: Regional ICQA Manager, Global RAD Operations (GRO)
descriptionHtml:
Regional RAD Operations (GRO) provides end-to-end IT supply chain services supporting Amazon's global technology infrastructure. GRO is looking for a results-driven leader to join our team as the Global Inventory Control and Quality Assurance (ICQA). This leader will own inventory integrity as a system discipline across GRO's 5-facility global network, building and executing the control framework that ensures accuracy, prevents cross-customer contamination, and drives continuous reduction in inventory-related losses.

The EMEA Regional ICQA Manager owns the strategy, methodology, and governance for inventory accuracy across all GRO sites on the region. This leader is responsible for designing and deploying standardized cycle count programs, root cause analysis frameworks, defect resolution processes, and accuracy KPIs. GRO operates shared infrastructure serving multiple business units from common physical space. This creates a unique ICQA challenge: maintaining absolute inventory segregation and accuracy when multiple customers' assets occupy the same facilities, flow through the same processes, and are managed in the same systems.

This role is both strategic and hands-on. The Regional ICQA Manager will define what "accurate" means for a multi-BU shared infrastructure operation, build the framework to measure and enforce it, and lead a team responsible for executing that framework across 8 countries. They will partner with Operations Engineering on platform requirements to ensure upcoming WMS capabilities enforce accuracy at the system level. They will drive root cause ownership on every inventory failure event and install the accountability mechanisms that make the operation self-correcting.


Key job responsibilities
- Own inventory accuracy strategy and execution across GRO's 5-facility EMEA network, targeting measurable reduction in IRDR (Inventory Record Defect Rate) and inventory-related financial losses
- Design and deploy standardized cycle count methodology across all sites and regions, establishing frequency, sampling approach, and escalation triggers appropriate to each facility's volume and complexity
- Build and maintain the cross-BU inventory segregation control framework that prevents cross-customer consumption in shared infrastructure environments
- Lead root cause analysis on all inventory failure events (leakage, misallocation, shrinkage); drive systemic corrections rather than one-time fixes
- Define and govern the ICQA KPI framework: accuracy targets by site, by BU, and by process path with clear accountability at each level
- Partner with Operations Engineering to define inventory accuracy requirements for the execution platform (WMS), ensuring the control framework translates into system-enforced logic at deployment
- Build dashboards and reporting that provide real-time visibility into inventory health across all sites without manual compilation
- Drive continuous improvement in ICQA processes through kaizen methodology, defect trend analysis, and cross-site best practice sharing
- Collaborate with Global Transportation and Logistics, Operations Engineering, and regional operations leaders to resolve inventory discrepancies that cross functional boundaries
- Support financial reconciliation efforts by providing accurate defect data, loss quantification, and trend analysis to Finance and leadership


A day in the life
This leader starts each day reviewing inventory health across the EU network: IRDR results, aging defects, and any leakage events requiring investigation. Mornings are spent partnering with site leaders to drive root cause analysis and corrective actions. Midday focuses on framework development: refining cycle count methodology, validating WMS segregation requirements with Engineering, or analyzing accuracy data for systemic failure patterns. Afternoons shift to program governance, team development, and cross-regional standards alignment. When a significant inventory event occurs, this role owns the investigation through structural resolution.

Global RAD Operations (GRO) is part of Amazon's Technology Supply Chain organization. GRO operates as a single global platform with regional execution across 13 facilities in 8 countries, processing 5.4M+ units annually with 82% year-over-year growth. The operation serves multiple business units (AWS, Stores, Field IT) from shared infrastructure, absorbing complexity across three paths: planned deployment, rapid response spare parts, and returns/lifecycle management.

The ICQA function sits at the center of GRO's operational integrity. Accuracy is not one metric among many; it is the foundation that enables every other outcome (on-time delivery, customer trust, cost-to-serve). This role joins a leadership team that values operational discipline, data-driven problem solving, and building mechanisms over relying on heroics.

At Amazon, we're working to be the most customer-centric company on earth. To get there, we need exceptionally talented, bright, and driven people. Amazon is one of the most recognizable brand names in the world and we distribute millions of products each year to our loyal customers.

Amazon Operations
Operations is at the heart of Amazon business. We are known for our speed, accuracy and exceptional service. Our buildings deliver tens of thousands of products to hundreds of countries worldwide, every day. In these key roles, you’ll come in to help us exceed productivity goals and deliver against our customer promises. Our scale is expansive and our presence is growing. Our goal is simple: to offer the world’s greatest selection of products and services with the world’s best customer experience.

We are seeking an Operations Manager to lead a team in one of our FCs.
Your responsibilities:
- Managing an environment concerning the delivery of Amazon orders direct to our customers, subject to ever rising volume and complexity, operating on a 24/7 basis
- Managing day-to-day relationships with multiple stakeholders
- Driving operational goals and metrics for your area. Communicating the vision to your team
- Presenting operational metrics regularly to the senior leadership team
- Problem-solves for closing gaps between performance and goals
- Hires and develops top talent. Creates and implements a talent plan for the site including talent acquisition, performance and career management, learning and development, succession planning, and employee engagement.


Key job responsibilities
The Ops Manager, leads an operation for +65k packages. Leads a team of 7 managers and +200 Associates, being the owner of solving complex problems and making key decisions and escalations on behalf of their team. Fosters a Culture of Safety. Responsible for protecting service levels monitoring and improving drivers and associates performance.

A day in the life
This manager will be responsible for key metrics include, but are not limited to: Safety Metrics, Quality Metrics, Cost Metrics including lead Savings projects

About the team
Responsible for goals in an area where the strategy may not yet be defined. Establishes workflows, SLAs, and operational excellence mechanisms at the site. Sets the standard for effective Inbound management and is well versed in industry practices and technologies. Has a deep understanding of the business priorities and customer needs, and can proficiently translate those needs into the right solutions. Brings Operations perspective to decision making with strong business acumen (understands contribution to the business and partners with finance for cost-benefit analyses). Broad experience across functional and technical areas, designing, developing, deploying, and maintaining large-scale operations.

Inclusive team culture
At Amazon we embrace our differences and we are committed to furthering our culture of inclusion. We host annual and ongoing learning experiences. Amazon’s culture of inclusion is reinforced within our 14 Leadership Principles, which remind team members to seek diverse perspectives, learn and be curious, and earn trust.
 
Work Life Balance
We believe striking the right balance between your personal and professional life is critical to life-long happiness and fulfillment. We offer flexibility in working hours and encourage you to find your own balance between your work and personal lives.
 
Mentorship & Career Growth
Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects based on what will help each team member develop into a better-rounded professional.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of employee and performance management experience
- Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays
- Bachelor's degree
- Experience in oral and written communication in English
- 8+ years of Strong Operations Management Proficient in Data Analysis

Preferred qualifications

- Experience supporting hourly workforces of 50+ employees and leading teams
- MBA, or Master's degree
- 2+ years of performance metrics, process improvement or lean techniques experience

title: Regional RME Manager, IntlRME - LATAM - Mexico
descriptionHtml:
At Amazon, we're working to be the most customer-centric company on earth. To get there, we need exceptionally talented, bright, safety-oriented and driven people.

The Regional RME Manager — SSD MX will own reliability, maintenance, and engineering operations across Amazon's Sub Same Day (SSD) network in MX. This is a regional role responsible for building and scaling the SSD maintenance organization — covering cold-chain and HVAC-R infrastructure, co-located operations within existing Delivery Stations, and standalone facilities. The role includes budget ownership, maintenance planning, vendor management, remote monitoring of cold storage systems, and team development under the International RME framework (AMS - Amazon Maintenance System).

This is a highly ambiguous environment — the SSD program is rapidly evolving, with project scopes, timelines, and operational models still being defined. The successful candidate must be comfortable navigating uncertainty, proactively defining RME strategies where no playbook exists, and influencing cross-functional teams to ensure maintenance and reliability requirements are embedded into program decisions from the start.


Key job responsibilities


- Own end-to-end building and facilities maintenance across all SSD nodes in MX— standalone and co-located within existing Delivery Stations
- Ensure a safe work environment applying Amazon Safety Policy, Permit to Work (PtW), LOTO standards, and VSOP procedures
- Lead equipment maintenance for cold-chain infrastructure (walk-in coolers, freezers, refrigerated display units), HVAC-R systems, conveyors, workstations, labeling machines, PLC control systems, and electrical systems
- Implement and operate remote monitoring systems for cold storage — temperature tracking, alarm management, and rapid response protocols to ensure food safety compliance and prevent temperature excursions
- Develop and deploy Preventive Maintenance routines aligned with AMS standards, with focus on cold-chain asset criticality
- Implement Condition-Based Maintenance (CBM) on critical cold-chain assets to advance toward predictive maintenance maturity
- Own the RME launch playbook for new SSD nodes — from Design for Maintainability reviews through commissioning and steady-state handover
- Scale RME coverage across a rapidly growing network, establishing cluster-based support models
- Manage 3rd party service providers through structured SLAs, KPI tracking, and regular business reviews
- Ensure cold storage food safety compliance — temperature monitoring, HACCP-aligned protocols, and regulatory requirements for perishable grocery, partnering with Grocery/Perishables and Quality Assurance teams
- Own the SSD RME budget for MX (OPEX and CAPEX), drive spare parts optimization, and coordinate vendor negotiations
- Actively participate in SSD project definition and design reviews — represent RME requirements in new node design, equipment selection, and operational model decisions. Have backbone to advocate for reliability and maintainability standards, even when priorities compete, always grounded in the impact to the end customer
- Define RME strategy for SSD in MX in a new environment
- Develop maintenance models, gearing ratios, vendor strategies, and technology roadmaps from scratch, adapting as the program evolves
- Partner cross-functionally with AMZL RME, SSD Operations, Grocery/Perishables, Real Estate, and Automation teams
- Provide immediate technical guidance to operations during critical events
- Be a leader within the group and across partner teams — positive, creative, and driven to find solutions in a fast-paced, high-ambiguity environment

About the team
Inclusive team culture
 
At Amazon we embrace our differences and we are committed to furthering our culture of inclusion. We host annual and ongoing learning experiences. Amazon’s culture of inclusion is reinforced within our 14 Leadership Principles, which remind team members to seek diverse perspectives, learn and be curious, and earn trust.  
 
Work Life Balance
 
We believe striking the right balance between your personal and professional life is critical to life-long happiness and fulfillment. We offer flexibility in working hours and encourage you to find your own balance between your work and personal lives.  
 
Mentorship & Career Growth
 
Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects based on what will help each team member develop into a better-rounded professional.

Basic qualifications

- Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- Experience in English-language communication skills, both written and verbal
- 1+ years of industrial maintenance experience
- 1+ years of direct leadership/supervisory experience
- 3+ years of managing department spend and labor budgets, performing root cause analysis (RCA), and implementing continuous improvement (CI) experience

Preferred qualifications

- Master's degree, or Six Sigma Black Belt Certification
- Knowledge of statistical analysis
- Experience in design review process to incorporate electrical, mechanical, automation controls solutions to drive equipment reliability and standards
- Experience in automated conveyors systems and controls, electrical and electronic principles, blueprint and electrical schematic reading, CMMS programs, preventive maintenance procedures, industrial electrical, industrial controls , industrial electronics
- Experience leading network level/multi-site maintenance organizations
- Experience working with major MHE integrators

title: Construction Manager, AWS CM - South East Asia
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Amazon Construction Managers (CMs) are always at the forefront of the construction industry in terms of innovation and maintain a focus on delivering the most innovative products to our customers. Our data centers are industry leading facilities in terms of energy efficiency and cost effectiveness. The Data Center CM is ultimately responsible for the day-to-day construction oversight and management of the contractors. The CM will also be utilized as a leader in their specific discipline (construction management, building services, architecture, electrical or mechanical engineering) and shall be responsible as a team member for delivering construction of some of the most sophisticated electrical and mechanical systems in the world.

At Amazon we leverage unique opportunities presented to us by owning everything from the substation to the server, and back to the cooling towers. We are diverse, upbeat, creative, team-oriented construction professionals working on a daily basis to develop data centers that are changing the face of data facilities.

Daily responsibilities will include all aspects of the entire data center lifecycle construction starting with the site feasibility, through the procurement of the design teams and design review, daily construction oversight, and commissioning of completed facilities.


Key job responsibilities
Project management and oversight of construction related activities for new builds or general capital projects in Malaysia. This will include the ownership of the project scope, timeline, and budgets.
• Driving costs down and schedules shorter while maintaining quality.
• Provide Construction Management for specific initiatives aimed at increasing the resiliency of our data centers.
• Review of constructability of electrical and mechanical system and building designs associated with the construction of new data centers or the optimization of existing data centers.
• Creation of project scope and equipment requirements, assist with request for proposals, and capital requests.
• Total project quality includes assisting with commissioning and integrated system testing and oversight of the execution of the project.
• Issue/Manage the Request for Information process during construction and coordinate construction administration with engineers
• Recording and reporting key metrics to team members and management.
• Concurrently managing multiple projects including new data center building and capital improvement projects associated with existing data centers.
• Operational support of installed facilities including review of procedures, best practices, and maintenance initiatives.
• Be a leader within the group as well as within internal and external teams that support the data center.
• Travel to datacenter sites for electrical systems audits, mechanical system reviews, constructability reviews, startup testing, and full commissioning, as required. #explorerAISsourcing

A day in the life
You’ll join a diverse team of project managers, design engineers, commissioning managers, software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

About the team
Diverse Experiences
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

Inclusive Team Culture
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our department, Data Center Planning and Delivery (DCPD), sponsors leadership programs that support the growth and development of builders across the organization. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events build stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation draws on the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship and Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field
- Experience carrying new design concepts through exploration, development, and into deployment or mass production
- Experience in MS Excel, Word, and Windows Operating Systems
- Experience in construction management of large, complex projects involving large-scale mechanical, electrical and plumbing (MEP) plants

Preferred qualifications

- 5+ years of project management in data centers or comparable critical infrastructure experience
- Knowledge of critical data center equipment
- Knowledge of engineering documentation, electrical diagrams and standard operating procedures
- Knowledge of building codes and regulations including Life Safety, BOCA, NFPA, NEC, or OSHA
- Experience in project management in data centers or comparable critical infrastructure
- Experience reading and interpreting construction specifications and drawings for all domains

title: ID - Rack Lifecycle Tech, Rack Lifecycle Team
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You'll join a diverse team of hardware and network engineers, logistics specialists, security and safety experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You'll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you'll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

We are looking for a detail-oriented, technically skilled Rack Lifecycle Tech to join our Rack Lifecycle Team within AWS Infrastructure Operations. In this individual contributor role, you will be a hands-on executor responsible for the physical installation, cabling, handoff, and decommissioning of racks across your assigned data center site. You are the person on the floor who turns capacity plans into operational reality.

As an Rack Lifecycle Tech, you will execute structured cabling, rack installation, and decommission activities with precision and to standard — following established SOPs, escalating deviations to your team lead, and ensuring every rack you touch is installed correctly, cabled to specification, fully documented, and handed off with zero blockers, prepare SOP’s with new processes, stake holder management with cross functional teams. This is an individual contributor role with no people management responsibilities.


Key job responsibilities
🔷 Rack Installation & Cabling
· Execute rack installations including physical placement, power connections, grounding, and cable management per AWS standards and MOPs
· Perform structured cabling including fiber/copper terminations, patch panel connections, labeling, and dressing to specification
· Complete OTDR and power testing; validate results against acceptance thresholds; escalate failures to team lead promptly rather than self-resolving outside approved procedures
· Follow all EHS protocols, lockout/tagout (LOTO) procedures, and safe work practices during installation activities
🔷 Rack Lifecycle Operations
· Execute work orders and tasks assigned by the Rack Lifecycle Team Manager under direct manager direction, maintaining accurate status updates in workflow management tools (e.g., Boost, MARS)
· Perform quality checks on completed cabling work including port map verification, label accuracy, and as-built documentation updates in CMDB/DCIM
· Identify and escalate issues, blockers, or deviations from SOPs encountered during task execution to the team lead or manager promptly; do not self-resolve outside approved procedures
· Support deployment wave readiness by participating in pre-work site walks, material staging, and tool preparation
🔷 Material Handling & Supply Chain Support
· Receive, verify, and stage incoming rack, cable, optics, and hardware deliveries; validate against BOM and flag discrepancies
· Maintain accurate site inventory records for cables, optics, patch cords, and consumables used during deployments
· Support cycle count activities and assist in identifying inventory shortfalls that may impact deployment timelines
🔷 Handover & Documentation
· Complete all required as-built documentation, port maps, test result records, and workflow sign-offs before handoff to Data Center Operations
· Update CMDB/DCIM and IPAM records accurately following rack installation or decommission activities
· Ensure handoffs are clean and fully documented with zero open blockers, enabling smooth transition to the next lifecycle phase
🔷 Rack Decommissioning
· Execute physical decommission activities per assigned MOPs — including cable removal, power disconnects, asset de-tagging, and rack extraction
· Perform device wipe and media destruction in compliance with AWS Secure Media Destruction and EHS policies
· Sort, label, and stage recovered assets (optics, cables, PDUs, hardware) for RMA, redeployment, or secure disposal per AWS Reverse Logistics policy
· Update DCIM/CMDB, IPAM, and port maps post-decom to ensure accurate space, power, and circuit records
· Validate that reclaimed U-space, power, and cooling capacity is accurately recorded in the available pool
🔷 Quality, Safety & Compliance
· Adhere to all site-level SOPs, quality standards, and governance frameworks for cabling, installation, and decommission activities
· Complete all required safety training and certifications; participate in regular EHS audits and team safety briefings
· Contribute to continuous improvement by identifying recurring quality issues, suggesting process improvements, and sharing feedback with the Rack Lifecycle Team Manager
· Use Rack Lifecycle Team tooling (e.g., Boost, MARS, ALM/DCLM) accurately to record work, track assets, and maintain data integrity
🔷 Cross-Team Coordination
· Support coordination with DCO, DCEO, Network Engineering, and facilities teams during active deployment or decom activities under manager guidance to ensure smooth execution
· Participate in daily stand-ups and pre-work briefings; communicate clearly on task status, blockers, and schedule adherence
· Provide accurate, timely updates on task completion and flag risks or delays to the team lead immediately
🔷 Continuous Learning & Development
· Maintain and develop technical proficiency in structured cabling, fiber optics, rack installation, and data center physical infrastructure
· Complete required certifications and training modules including EHS, LOTO, and any Rack Lifecycle Team-specific technical programs
· Proactively seek feedback from leads and managers to improve personal performance and output quality
· Support the onboarding and training of new team members; share knowledge and best practices with peers to build overall team capability and quality standards
· Stay current on AWS infrastructure tooling, cabling standards, and process updates communicated by the Rack Lifecycle Team


A day in the life
As a Rack Lifecycle Tech, your day is on the data center floor. You might start the morning by reviewing your assigned work orders in Boost, checking in with your team lead on priorities, and staging cables and optics for a rack installation wave. By midday, you could be terminating fiber runs at a patch panel, running OTDR tests to validate loss results against acceptance thresholds, or labeling and dressing a freshly installed rack. In the afternoon, you might be updating CMDB records for completed work orders, de-tagging and staging recovered assets from an EOL decom, or helping onboard a new technician by walking them through the SOP. If you encounter a deviation from the approved MOP, you escalate it to your team lead immediately — you don't improvise. Your role is hands-on, technical, and precise — you execute the work that keeps AWS capacity on track.

About the team
Diverse Experiences
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn't followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don't let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world's most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that's why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there's nothing we can't achieve.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it's in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empowers us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and Amazon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship and Career Growth
We're continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. That's why you'll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship, and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Basic qualifications

- 1+ years of computer networking experience
- 1+ years of Linux operating systems experience
- Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field
- Experience in computer networking
- Experience working with Linux operating systems
- Can lift and rack equipment up to 40 pounds
- Experience with computer hardware troubleshooting and repair

Preferred qualifications

- Can work in cramped spaces or in elevated locations while adhering to health & safety guidelines
- Experience dealing effectively with customers during problem resolution and operating efficiently under pressure
- Experience managing work and priorities through a ticketing system
- Experience with cabling infrastructure best practices and methodologies
- Experience working in a data center environment (racking and stacking gear, cable management, hot/cold aisle containment)
- Familiarity with rack decommissioning including device wipe, media destruction, and asset recovery procedures

title: Senior Safety Engineer,  Amazon Robotics (AR) Environmental Health & Safety (EHS)
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Robotics’ (AR) Environmental Health and Safety (EHS) Team is seeking a Senior Safety Engineer to support our automation technology development and manufacturing teams. This role will provide technical safety expertise and leadership associated with innovation and ideation phases as well as the manufacturing and production system by driving a systematic approach to identify, mitigate and manage risk to meet Amazon, regulatory and industry standards.

This role will functionally partner internally with Innovation, Hardware, Design and Functional Safety Engineering, Controls, Manufacturing, System Integration, SW, Program, Deployment and Site EHS teams, and externally with 3Ps, Integrators, NRTLs, etc. Role may require travel up to 15% of the time.

Key job responsibilities
• Establish and communicate safety requirements and specifications for Innovation, R&D labs, Manufacturing/Production System based on Amazon, regulatory, and harmonized industry standards

•Develop and drive safety and compliance roadmap for R&D and manufacturing/production system. Make use of strong skills for building consensus and alignment between internal and external partners on project safety goals, balancing the needs of the many stakeholders involved, including considerations on safety, security, reliability, cost, and maintainability.

•Lead and support innovation and production system teams and 3Ps to deliver safe design for various build, commission and test phases per regulatory requirements such as OSHA/NRTL/Machinery Directive, as well as industry standards such as ISO 12100/ANSI B11/NFPA 79/IEC 60204/ISO 13849/other applicable standards such as ANSI B30.13/EN 528/ANSI RIA R15.06/R15.08/ISO10218/EN.

•In partnership with our Innovation, Manufacturing and Site EHS teams, investigate incidents or unexpected behavior with the technology in our buildings and develop concrete proposals to mitigate and prevent future incidents.

•Develop approaches to risk analysis for robotics and integrated automation systems including unintentional risks they create during testing and manufacturing.

•Build a safety culture that enables and assists our technical engineering teams to develop and deploy safe and compliant products, systems and solutions.

•Identify gaps/opportunities in processes, and organizations (e.g., workflows, risk assessments, controls, etc.) to enable high standards and consistency in application.

•Support the development of solutions that meet Amazon’s high standards for safety, risk reduction, customer satisfaction, efficiency, scalability, simplicity, and operational excellence.

•Maintain and leverage industry partnerships to support safety engineering programs.

•Apply project management skills to manage scope, define technical requests, research appropriate expertise required, identify the relevant teams and members to coordinate resource deployment on tasks, analyze risks and develop mitigation strategies to proactively identify and resolve issues.


A day in the life
Amazon offers a full range of benefits that support you and eligible family members, including domestic partners. Benefits can vary by location, the number of regularly scheduled hours you work, length of employment, and job status such as seasonal or temporary employment. The benefits that generally apply to regular, full-time employees include: 1. Medical, Dental, and Vision Coverage 2. Maternity and Parental Leave Options 3. Paid Time Off (PTO) 4. 401(k) Plan

If you are not sure that every qualification on the list above describes you exactly, we'd still love to hear from you! At Amazon, we value people with unique backgrounds, experiences, and skillsets. If you’re passionate about this role and want to make an impact on a global scale, please apply!

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, or an equivalent engineering science
- 5+ years of increasing responsibilities in EHS or environmental programs in manufacturing, production, or service operations experience
- Deep knowledge and experience in safety risk assessment methodology — including but not limited to Machinery Safety (ISO 12100), Functional Safety (ISO 13849), and Electrical Safety (IEC 60204, NFPA 79)
- Working knowledge of international safety standards including EU Machinery Directive (2006/42/EC), ISO, IEC, ANSI/RIA R15.06, NFPA, UL, and OSHA
- Experience performing or leading structured safety analyses such as FMEA, FTA, or HAZOP for complex automated or robotic systems
- Experience integrating safety requirements into product or system design processes, partnering with engineering teams to deliver safety-by-design
- Experience providing safety engineering support across multiple sites, including coordination of priorities and consistent application of standards
- Experience with OSHA General Industry standards (29 CFR 1910), hazardous waste management (RCRA), and regulatory reporting requirements
- Working knowledge of Industrial Hygiene regulations and occupational safety best practices
- Experience with digital safety management platforms and data-driven EHS programs

Preferred qualifications

- Master's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Safety Engineering, or Systems Engineering
- Certified Safety Professional (CSP), Certified Machinery Safety Expert (CMSE), and/or TUV or equivalent Functional Safety Engineer certification
- Experience with NRTL (UL, CSA, TUV) and Notified Body certification processes
- Experience in safety engineering for robotics, automation, or a related field — including autonomous mobile robots (AMRs), robotic manipulation systems, and/or related technologies

title: Software Development Manager, AWS Infrastructure Supply Chain
descriptionHtml:
Role Overview
As an L6 Software Development Manager in AWS Infrastructure Supply Chain, you will define the strategic vision for your team, establish a roadmap, and successfully deliver software that powers one of the world's largest and most complex physical infrastructure supply chains. You will independently manage a team of SDEs building large-scale distributed systems that enable AWS to procure, manufacture, ship, and deploy hundreds of thousands of server and network racks into data centers globally across AMER, EMEA, APAC, and GOVT regions.

Strategic Ownership
Define the strategic vision for your team, partnering effectively with customers and stakeholders across the supply chain lifecycle — from demand planning and material supportability to manufacturing, logistics, and DC deployment.
Establish a roadmap and successfully deliver software that executes that vision, aligned with the end-to-end supply chain needs spanning systems like S&OP POR, RP3, Build Planner, Fulfillment Planner, and the Infrastructure Control Tower.
Make crisp, independent decisions about what projects move forward and in what priority order, balancing competing priorities across demand forecasting, capacity planning, fulfillment optimization, and observability.
Write narratives, PR/FAQs, and other strategic documentation to drive alignment and decision-making.
Technical Domain
Your team will work on one or more of the following areas:

Real-time observability platforms — powering the Infrastructure Control Tower that tracks 100K+ active demands through stage progression, dwell times, blocker reason codes, and checkpoint milestones.
AI/ML-driven forecasting — demand planning, ETA prediction, and supply-demand matching across 130+ component categories and 1,400+ Superset Fungibility Groups (SFGs).
Optimization engines — capacity planning systems that match server/network demand (converted to kW) against DC power supply at lineup, breaker, site, and meter-site levels.
Multi-agent orchestration systems — coordinating fulfillment across vendors, manufacturing sites, and DC positions in priority order (ML → Network → Non-ML).
Data pipelines — processing millions of events daily across the fulfillment pipeline from Purchase Request through to Handoff.
People Leadership
Independently manage a team of SDEs; hire the right mix of engineers to accomplish team goals.
Assess SDE performance effectively; manage both high and low performers and take effective action addressing employee concerns.
Hire, develop, and promote SDEs, delegating appropriately based on the strength and development objectives of individuals on your team.
Build an effective development process that consistently delivers software with minimal defects and system disruption.
Customer & Operational Excellence
Define metrics to measure customer experience, team development progress, and operational excellence across the supply chain systems your team owns.
Establish customer engagement mechanisms to stay connected to the needs of internal customers — service teams (EC2, S3, EBS), supply planners, manufacturing partners, and logistics operators.

title: Software Development Manager III, S3 Buckets
descriptionHtml:
Are you excited about the incredible opportunity that cloud computing represents? Are you passionate about delivering high-quality services and ready to apply your experience at massive scale? Amazon Web Services' Cloud Storage, Amazon S3, is one of the largest distributed storage systems in the world. We host trillions of objects and serve hundreds of millions of requests per second and we're continuing to grow!

We are looking for a passionate Software Development Manager to lead a team within the S3 Buckets space. As a core component of the broader S3 Index organization, the S3 Buckets team owns two critical areas: S3 Buckets and S3 Access Points. S3 Buckets serve as the foundational logical containers for storing objects, while S3 Access Points streamline and simplify data access for any AWS service or customer application that stores data in Amazon S3

As the leader of this team, you will be tackling complex challenges in data integrity, performance optimization, and system decoupling, ensuring that S3 continues to deliver exceptional reliability and performance at massive scale.

In this role, you will:
* Lead a team of talented software engineers, fostering their growth and development while delivering critical components of S3's architecture
* Own the vision and roadmap for the S3 Buckets Data Plane systems and interfaces.
* Invent new ways to improve the customer experience for S3’s diverse customers.
* Collaborate with your partner teams to invent, design, and develop highly available and scalable distributed systems.
* Build and manage partnerships and cross-org commitments with customers and dependency teams.
* Ensure operational excellence through metrics, monitoring, and continuous improvement

You'll work closely with teams across S3 including Frontend, Index, and Storage teams to continuously improve our systems and deliver exceptional customer experiences.

A successful candidate will feel strongly not only about building good software but about building great teams. The ideal candidate will be able to lead in resource-constrained and performance-sensitive areas, with relentlessly high standards. This role is technical: you'll be expected to contribute to architecture discussions while regularly taking part in deep-dive troubleshooting exercises or technical post-mortem discussions to identify the root cause of complex issues. A strong understanding of distributed systems, data integrity patterns, and experience operating services at scale is a plus.

AWS Utility Computing (UC) provides product innovations — from foundational services such as Amazon’s Simple Storage Service (S3) and Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud (EC2), to consistently released new product innovations that continue to set AWS’s services and features apart in the industry. As a member of the UC organization, you’ll support the development and management of Compute, Database, Storage, Internet of Things (Iot), Platform, and Productivity Apps services in AWS, including support for customers who require specialized security solutions for customers who require specialized security solutions for their cloud services.

Key job responsibilities
Innovating on lightweight processes to allow for quick iteration in a highly ambiguous space.

Driving the day to day sprint work as well as roadmap for your area

Collaborating with other engineering leaders to find solutions to brain-contorting problems

Developing the careers of your people, actively mentoring them

A day in the life
You will cultivate a culture of fast-paced innovation with lightweight processes. You will collaborate with product and partner with teams within AWS to deliver product features. The services you will own and build are the foundation of S3 and you will tackle some of the most difficult problems in S3 head-on. In AWS, if you build it, you own it. This means we hold a high bar for test automation, verification, design, and code reviews to ensure our systems meet high standards we demand in service of our customers.

Our team puts high value on work/life balance. We recognize that the circumstances of our team members vary, and we balance work across the team so that we’re all able to maintain high standards on behalf of our customers, as well as allow for rich and happy personal lives. We maintain a regular on-call rotation across our teams with engineers and managers all taking part to resolve the inevitable issues that arise. We don't like getting paged outside of work hours so we work to ensure our systems are fault tolerant. When we do get paged we work together to resolve root cause so that we don't get paged for the same issue twice.

descriptionHtml:
DCEO (データセンターエンジニアリング・オペレーションズ) 部門では、ファシリティエンジニア・技術者を広く募集しています。本ポジションは、アマゾンウェブサービス（AWS）のデータセンターを支える、施設内の電力設備や冷却設備などを安定稼働させることが責務です。DCEO部門の一員としてサーバーやネットワークなどのIT機器を収容する施設を運用し、お客様のアプリケーションやWebサイトなどを24時間365日安定稼働することで、社会インフラに貢献できる業務です。 弊社は 2006 年の設立以来、クラウドコンピューティングのパイオニアとして、ITインフラの世界に変革をもたらしました。現在は世界中で何百ものデータセンターを運営しており、急成長中の新興企業、大企業、主要な政府機関など、何百万ものお客様をサポートしています。データセンターがあることで、日本だけでなく世界中でクラウドコンピューティングサービスが利用できるようになり、お客様に信頼していただいている弊社の革新的な技術にいつでもアクセスできるようになっているのです。 本ポジションでは、世界最大級のITインフラの維持管理業務に関わる事ができます。入社者にはデータセンターのキャリア形成に必要なトレーニングやスキルを提供します。データセンターでのキャリアにご興味ある方は是非ご応募ください！

Key job responsibilities
• データセンター施設内の機械及び電気設備の保守管理
• お客様のダウンタイムを最小限に抑えるための設備障害対応
• 設備の故障や保守、拡張等に伴う技術的な問題の調査、解決
• データセンターで使われている機器の設置や撤去

A day in the life
• データセンター内のオフィス、サーバー室、空調機械室、電気室等様々な場所を移動しながら、他のメンバーと一緒にお客様のためにクラウドコンピューティングを24時間365日稼働が継続できるよう取り組みます。
• データセンター内の機械及び電気設備の監視および制御を行います。

データセンターエンジニアリング・オペレーションズでは、日々安全とセキュリティ、そしてお客様に最高のクラウド体験を提供することに取り組んでいます。私たちはお客様のニーズとビジネス上の要求を満たすために、施設と設備の運用及び保守を担当しています。

私たちのインクルーシブな文化は、あなたがお客様に最高の結果をもたらすことを可能にします。私たちは従業員の多様性を称えるだけでなく、多様な働き方を称賛しています。

あなたのこれまでのご経験にかかわらず、ご活躍いただけるキャリアパスを用意しています。先輩社員からの知識の共有、メンターシップ、その他のキャリアアップに役立つリソースが準備されており、より総合的なプロフェッショナルへの成長を支援します。またアマゾンでは社員がトレーニングや認定を受けるための支援や、英語学習のサポートを提供しています。
