- Bachelor's degree in engineering or equivalent
- Experience delivering multi-media environmental due diligence, permitting, and compliance projects with specific expertise in CWA 404 and NPDES permitting, groundwater protection, wastewater discharge, and natural and cultural resource evaluations
- 7+ years experience conducting environmental due diligence for greenfield and brownfield sites.
- At least 3 years of project or task management experience for environmental permitting and/or due diligence projects.

title: Onsite Medical Representative
descriptionHtml:
Join Amazon’s mission to become Earth’s safest place to work! At Amazon, we’ve set the ambitious goal to become the benchmark of safety excellence across all industries in which we operate. The Amazon Workplace Health & Safety (WHS) team sets the strategic direction to provide resources, best practices, and safe environments to proactively manage the health and wellbeing of our workforce. To support these goals, Amazon is seeking an experienced and dynamic Onsite Medical Representative (OMR) to join our team. In this position, you will work closely with the WHS Site Manager, WHS Specialist, and occasionally the Injury Prevention Specialist (IPS). This includes attending weekly associate safety committee meetings, greeting all new hires for the site or through daily one-on-one interaction. Additionally, the OMR will participate in weekly case management review meetings as necessary.

As an OMR, you will independently assess and administer first aid as well as offer guidance to Amazon Associates (AAs) on both occupational and non-occupational injuries or illnesses. You should be passionate about learning and advocating health and wellness principles to consistently support AAs on a daily basis. You will refer care to outside medical providers as needed, and learn about OSHA regulations, risk, and analysis.

The OMR will function as a part of the larger team onsite, assisting with all first aid needs and support safety operations as needed.

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:
- Provide first aid support and make referrals to outside medical providers as necessary.
- Minimize the AA risk of injury through awareness, education, and proactive engagement.
- Maintain all records of care provided to AAs.
- Coordinate and maintain the workers’ compensation and return to work programs for AAs with work-related injuries.
- Provide daily activity logs and end of shift reports.
- Engage with AAs and leadership on operations floor to provide coaching regarding observed at-risk work habits.
- Maintain a clean working environment and ensure appropriate medical supply inventory is maintained.
- Participate in training and certification to facilitate first aid, CPR and AED certifications classes.
- Maintain all first aid, CPR, AED credentials.
- Work flexible shifts which could include days, nights, holidays, and/or weekends.
- Assist with random saliva drug testing protocols.
- Maintain effective care delivery in emergencies and assist emergency response at the site.

Additional Job Elements include:
- Lift up to 49 pounds and frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach
- Stand/walk for up to 12 hours during shifts
- Work in an environment where the noise level varies
- Work in an environment that is subject to variable temperatures and weather (delivery stations include outside loading departments)
- Continuously climb and descend stairs (applies to sites with stairs)

For those that do not have an adult First Aid, CPR, AED certification from the American Heart Association or American Red Cross, must obtain within 3 weeks of start date.

Basic qualifications

- High school or equivalent diploma
- Current valid Basic Life Support (BLS) certification by an approved emergency cardiac care (ECC) provider; AND must have one of the following:
- Current valid Emergency Medical Technician (EMT) OR Paramedic Certification from the Department of Health OR the National Registry of Emergency Medical Technicians (NREMT); OR
- Current active Athletic Trainer Certification, by either the Board of Certification (BOC) or equivalent State Certification.

Preferred qualifications

- Certified to teach first aid, CPR, and AED training from American Heart Association or American Red Cross
- Proficient in Microsoft Office
- Experience with an industrial wellness program
- Experience managing musculoskeletal disorders, ergonomics, and coaching on body mechanics
- Demonstrated work experience with OSHA regulations and Workers Compensation
- Proficient in digital recordkeeping
- In the last year, six months job experience in the Military as a Combat Medic (U.S. Army), Field Medic (U.S. Army), Healthcare Specialist (U.S. Army), Hospital Corpsman (U.S. Navy), or Aerospace Medical Service Technician (U.S. Air Force)

title: Forward Deployed Engineer, AWS Forward Deployed Engineering
descriptionHtml:
A Forward Deployed Engineer II (FDE II) embeds directly inside a strategic enterprise customer to independently design, build, deploy, and run AI-powered production systems alongside the customer's engineering team. FDE IIs write production-grade software and own delivery of complete AI workstreams end-to-end — from requirements gathering through production deployment — combining the technical rigor of an AWS SDE with the urgency and ownership required to deliver measurable customer business outcomes.

FDE IIs are autonomous contributors. They deliver working features spanning the full software lifecycle. They design cohesive implementations for ambiguous problems, making design trade-offs with appropriate guidance. They take on projects where the business problem is understood but implementations are not fully fleshed out, balancing constraints and limiting short-term workarounds. They coach others on producing high-quality code and train new team members.

Key job responsibilities
Embed within customer engineering teams. Work with customers, stakeholders, and peers to understand the business and customer value of the systems you build. Understand the customer's business processes, technical architecture, and operational constraints. Translate customer requirements into technical designs for AI-enabled production systems within your workstream. Requires 30–50% travel.

Build production AI applications. Design and develop production-grade software powering AI and agentic workflows — retrieval pipelines, workflow automation, API orchestration layers, data integration. Solve difficult problems with visible risks or roadblocks, bringing clarity and identifying simple designs for solutions. Integrate foundation models, customer data sources, and existing applications into cohesive AI experiences. Optimize for latency, reliability, and cost.

Own production for your workstream. Be a significant contributor to the full software development lifecycle including scoping, design, code, testing, deployment, operations, and maintenance. Troubleshoot production incidents across AI models, distributed systems, and application services. Ensure root causes of operational issues are identified and resolved. Implement monitoring, evaluations, guardrails, and CI/CD that keep AI systems healthy. Don't settle for the status quo — routinely identify and execute on opportunities to improve operations.

Mentor and uplift. Actively mentors and trains new team members on how systems are constructed, operated, and fit into the bigger picture. Coach others on producing high-quality code through mechanisms such as code review. Be active in the code review process, providing meaningful feedback to others.

Accelerate customer adoption. Identify opportunities to expand AI adoption within your customer engagement. Codify reusable patterns and accelerators that benefit future customer deployments and feed back into AWS services. Make enhancements that improve your team's software and processes.

A day in the life
You start your morning reviewing deployment metrics from a recent release, then join a design review where you help shape the architecture for an upcoming feature. After lunch, you pair with a teammate on a tricky integration problem, walking through trade-offs together before settling on a clean approach. Later, you onboard a new team member by guiding them through how your services are constructed and operated. Your work balances building new capabilities with strengthening the foundations that keep your systems running reliably.

Amazon is seeking a collaborative electrical maintenance professional for our Amazon Web Services Team.
This engineering operations technician position serves as the on-site maintenance technician and operator for an AWS data centre.
The Data Centre Engineering Operations Technician (EOT) is responsible for operating and maintaining all electrical, mechanical, emergency generator, and fire/life safety equipment within the data centre. The EOT serves as a technical resource to support Amazon within its data centres. Data centre equipment that supports mission-critical servers must maintain better than 99.999% uptime. title: TOM Area Manager, ATS
descriptionHtml:
At Amazon, we’re working to be the most customer-centric company on earth. To get there, we need exceptionally talented, bright, and dependable people. Amazon is seeking Transportation Area Managers to work throughout the country. Amazon is one of the most recognizable brand names in the world and we distribute over a billion shipments each year to our loyal customers.

Four key areas that you’ll always focus on are the safety, quality, customer experience, and productivity of your department. Key responsibilities include:
• Collaborate with site leadership on quality and Customer Experience metrics, including the root cause analysis of problem areas
• Streamline logistics in the operation through the implementation of standard work and team leadership
• Support and commit to all safety programs and OSHA compliance to ensure a safe work environment for all associates
• Proactively identify and lead process improvement initiatives and Lean tools

Key job responsibilities
Transportation Operations Management (TOM) oversees trailer yard operations at 13 Fulfillment Centers (FC), 3 Sort Centers (SC) and 1 Cross Dock (IXD) across Mexico, ensuring yard safety, efficient trailer movement, and guard shack operations management. TOM is the main focal point between Site Operations and Transportation Network.

TOM is part of Amazon Transportation Services (ATS), a high-powered dynamic team shaping the middle-mile transportation execution and developing innovative transportation management concepts to improve and enhance the ATS Network to ultimately drive the best customer experience in a reliable and cost-efficient manner, every time.

Key job responsibilities


Lead and supervise a team focused on yard operations, aligning Fulfillment Center operation with transportation execution.

Plan and manage yard capacity and trailer pool for designated site.

Carry out supervisory responsibilities in accordance with the organization’s policies and procedures.

Drive high safety standards for all yard operations, ensuring safe work environment for Amazon and non-Amazon workers.

Audit and ensure compliance to all standard work, Workplace Health and Safety (WHS) and environmental regulations

Meet and exceed operational goals.

Own area performance metrics and communicate them to TOM and site leadership

Every morning, the day start with a review of site key transportation metrics – the lifeblood of our operations: Safety Yard Events and On Time Departure [OTD]. title: Operations Manager
descriptionHtml:
Job summary
Our WW Operations network delivers millions of packages and smiles to Amazon customers every day. We are looking for motivated, customer-focused individuals who want to join our team as an Operations Manager. In this role, you will lead and develop a team of salaried and hourly talent. You will be responsible for engaging your team during their shifts to maintain the highest levels of safety, quality, attendance, and performance. You will also play a key role in maintaining our customer expectations to ensure customer orders are delivered at the right time, to the right location.

Our Operation’s workflow has three major components: First mile - where the product is housed and ready for order; Middle mile - where the order is hauled to your area; and Last mile - when the product is delivered to the customer’s door. title: Sr Technical Program Manager, AWS Analytics Engineering
descriptionHtml:
AWS Analytics Engineering (AAE) is seeking a Senior Technical Program Manager to lead delivery and cross-organization coordination for the Foundational Data Technology (FDT) organization. FDT is the central org within AAE that supports AWS Product Analytics — owning the foundational datasets, data platform infrastructure, service transformations, reporting operations, and data content and stewardship that power AWS revenue reporting, usage analytics, and product intelligence.

You will own the delivery strategy across FDT's core programs — Unified Revenue, Unified Actuals, Unified Usage — and a portfolio of internal initiatives including security, compliance, infrastructure modernization, and central engineering programs. This is a cross-organizational role. You will work across AWS Sales, Finance, Product, and CP Platform organizations to drive discussions, seek alignment, and ensure FDT's data products meet the needs of stakeholders across the AWS business. Within AAE, you will partner with data engineering managers across five sub-teams to drive programs, remove blockers, and hold teams accountable to commitments.

You will represent FDT in leadership meetings, present program status and strategy to Director and VP-level audiences, and serve as the primary point of contact for cross-org partners. You will partner directly with the AAE Director and Principal Engineers to shape how the team delivers against its roadmap.

The ideal candidate brings deep understanding of data — including data modeling, pipeline architectures, and analytical workflows — and can step up to perform basic data analysis using SQL or AI-assisted tools when needed to validate assumptions, investigate discrepancies, or support deep dives. Are you experienced in Critical Infrastructure Commissioning and looking for a fast paced environment to work in? As a Data Center Commissioning Engineer (CxE), you will be part of highly creative, efficient team tasked with tackling fascinating and challenging problems building and supporting the operations of Amazon owned data centers. The Amazon Commissioning team (ACx) understands, evaluates, defines and manages the expectations of construction quality in accordance to engineering designs to meet the customer requirements. The CxE is responsible for supporting vendors, contractors, and other teams involved in the construction and commissioning of various systems such as:

-Medium and low voltage power systems
-Generators
-UPS
-HVAC (Air Handlers / Exhaust Fans / VFD)
-Chilled Water Systems
-Building Management systems (BMS)
-Electrical Power Monitoring Systems (EPMS)
-Testing and balancing
-Pumps and Hydronic systems

Physical Requirements
Walk job sites in uneven terrain
Work at heights and from ladders
Regularly walk, use hands and fingers, reach with hands and arms, stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl
Lift and/or move up to 49 pounds; and participate in group lifts for 50 pounds or more
Carry objects weighing up to 49 pounds for short distances
Work shifts longer than eight hours in duration with potential for night and weekends
Perform physical tasks throughout the day without becoming overly tired
Ability to manipulate small wires and objects easily
Work in a noisy environment
Work in environments that are colder or hotter than a normal office environment

Additional Job Requirements
· Ability and willingness to travel domestic and internationally for up to 80% of the year.
· Hold a US passport or have the ability to acquire one.
· Required to provide personal transportation for meetings and job visits away from the office; reimbursed.

U.S Citizenship Required

Key job responsibilities
The Commissioning Engineer (CxE) provides testing and validation oversight of AWS data center electrical and mechanical infrastructure. CxEs review design documents, lead Factory Witness Testing (FWT), and manage third-party commissioning vendors in the performance of onsite pre-functional, functional, and integrated systems testing. They take Ownership of their projects’ successes by Diving Deep to resolve technical issues and having Bias for Action to address everchanging schedule and coordination demands onsite. Additionally, CxEs communicate lessons learned and continuously collaborate on program improvements.

The CxE shall provide multi-discipline input into the scheduling, test script development, designing, and planning of projects. In addition, the CxE will be required to review component submittal packages, lead Factory Witness Testing (FWT), perform system level and integrated system testing. During commissioning the CxE will continuously audit activities to ensure compliance with environmental, quality, and safety requirements. Additionally, the individual will be responsible for comprehensive weekly reporting of status of all ongoing projects and lessons learned to continually improve the quality of our program. This position will include coverage of multiple inflight projects and short timelines.

A day in the life
On a typical project, the CxE works across AWS engineering, capacity delivery, operations, and contractor teams to coordinate site activities, prioritize tasks, and ensure each issue has clear path to resolution. The CxE manages the project commissioning vendor whose primary scope is to identify issues, determine criticality, propose solutions, and document their findings. If project turnover is at risk, the CxE escalates to the appropriate stakeholders. Upon project completion, the CxE will communicate lessons learned to help peers on similar projects in flight and participate in initiatives that drive improvement to the commissioning program.

About the team
The AWS Data Center Commissioning Team (ACx) is a wholly independent business within the DCGS organization. This team of veteran professional Electrical Engineers, Mechanical Engineers, Controls Engineers, Architectural Engineers, Project Managers, Operators and seasoned Amazonians are uniquely positioned to provide deeply detailed engineering and operational review and testing of equipment designs, operational functionality and construction practices. We are focused on ensuring the rapid delivery of a quality product while maintaining full transparency, recording metrics of manufacturer/contractor/equipment issues pre-PFHO, and identifying opportunities for all our peers and customers.

title: Responsable Facility Management (F/H), Maintenance, Robotique & Systèmes Automatisés
descriptionHtml:
Construisez l'avenir d'Amazon dès la première pierre.
Nous lançons un nouveau site fin 2027, et tout reste à bâtir. Dès le premier jour, vous serez au cœur de l'action : de la mise en service des installations CVC, incendie et air comprimé à l'aménagement des espaces verts, en passant par la définition des premiers standards de maintenance, vous poserez les fondations techniques de ce qui deviendra un maillon essentiel de notre réseau logistique.

Au sein de l'équipe RME (Reliability Maintenance Engineering), vous intégrerez le moteur de l'innovation chez Amazon. Notre mission ? Faire en sorte que chaque infrastructure, chaque installation technique, chaque espace évolue au rythme d'Amazon pour garantir que des millions de clients reçoivent leurs commandes à temps, chaque jour.

En tant que Responsable Facility Management, vous aurez l'opportunité unique de construire, dès l'origine, l'organisation Facility Management du site : Vous piloterez l'ensemble des installations techniques du bâtiment et dirigerez une équipe de 30 experts techniques pluridisciplinaires en gestion directe, tout en supervisant plus de 20 prestataires externes.

Vous évoluerez dans un environnement où l'excellence opérationnelle n'est pas une ambition, mais une exigence, et où chacune de vos décisions impacte directement la sécurité et la satisfaction de vos équipes et de nos clients.

Si vous êtes passionné(e) par les projets de création de site, le pilotage multi-technique de bâtiments, le management d'équipes et de prestataires, et l'amélioration continue au quotidien, alors ce poste est fait pour vous.

Key job responsibilities
Participer à la mise en service du site : Contribuer à la réception, aux tests et à la mise en route des installations CVC, incendie, air comprimé et espaces verts avant l'ouverture officielle du site fin 2027
- Assurer la santé et la sécurité de votre équipe et du bâtiment : Déployer dès l'origine une culture de sécurité exemplaire (protocoles LOTO, Safety Curriculum, toolbox talks), garantir la conformité des installations incendie, CVC et air comprimé, et instaurer l'objectif zéro incident grave
- Piloter la gestion multi-technique du bâtiment : Superviser les systèmes CVC (Chauffage, Ventilation, Climatisation), les installations de sécurité incendie, les réseaux d'air comprimé, ainsi que l'entretien des espaces verts, en garantissant leur disponibilité et leur conformité réglementaire
- Construire et développer vos équipes : Recruter, coacher et manager directement une équipe de 30 techniciens et superviseurs dès les premiers mois du projet, et créer une culture d'équipe forte dès le lancement du site
- Mettre en place la gestion des prestataires : Sélectionner, superviser et coordonner plus de 20 prestataires externes (maintenance CVC, incendie, espaces verts, air comprimé, etc.), définir les contrats, les SLA et les standards de qualité et de sécurité Amazon dès l'ouverture
- Garantir l'excellence opérationnelle : Mettre en place les processus de maintenance préventive et corrective, et piloter la disponibilité technique des équipements et installations du bâtiment dès les premiers jours d'activité
- Piloter l'amélioration continue et l'innovation : Analyser les données de performance des installations, identifier les opportunités d'optimisation énergétique et opérationnelle, et mener des projets Kaizen/QCC en lien avec les équipes européennes
- Gérer les budgets et les projets : Élaborer et suivre le budget Facility Management dès la phase de lancement, piloter les projets d'amélioration des infrastructures, et collaborer avec les équipes internes (GES, GPO, Central RME) ainsi que les parties prenantes externes

A day in the life
Vous serez basé·e sur le futur site, au cœur du projet de création depuis ses premières étapes jusqu'à son ouverture fin 2027. Vous participerez à la mise en service des installations techniques du bâtiment, coordonnerez vos équipes internes et vos prestataires externes pour garantir le bon fonctionnement des systèmes CVC, incendie, air comprimé et espaces verts. Vous collecterez des données, résoudrez les problèmes techniques et contractuels, et élaborerez des plans d'action pour construire, dès l'origine, la performance et la conformité du bâtiment. Après la sécurité, la fonction la plus importante de votre rôle consistera à bâtir et diriger votre équipe de 30 personnes et à mettre en place la supervision de l'ensemble de vos prestataires, en veillant à leur performance, leur conformité et leur développement.

About the team
Notre équipe d’ingénieurs RME (Reliability Maintenance Engineering) veille à ce que nos équipements fonctionnent au mieux. Guidés par des responsables expérimentés, nous sommes une équipe à l’esprit analytique. Nos collaborateurs·trices possèdent à la fois des connaissances techniques poussées et un bon esprit d’équipe. Nous travaillons ensemble pour assurer l’entretien, le dépannage et la réparation des ressources de notre réseau mondial de centres d’expédition. Certains de nos employé·es occupent des postes à responsabilités et sont chargés de superviser l’équipe dans son travail sur des technologies passionnantes, dont certaines n’existent que chez Amazon.

De l’installation de systèmes d’emballage automatisés à la supervision de la maintenance générale d’un site, en passant par la réparation d’équipements de distribution essentiels, notre équipe assure le bon fonctionnement de la plupart des éléments techniques d’Amazon. Nous veillons, par exemple, à ce que les bâtiments soient conformes à la législation, afin d’assurer la sécurité de tous et le fonctionnement à plein régime de nos sites. Les possibilités d’évolution sont nombreuses, tant au sein de l’équipe RME qu’à l’échelle d’Amazon.

Tout ce que nous faisons vise à réduire les temps d’arrêt dans les principaux sites logistiques d’Amazon, afin que les clients reçoivent leurs commandes à temps. Nous travaillons souvent tôt ou tard pour effectuer les tâches de maintenance avec un minimum de perturbations, y compris en équipes de nuit. Si nous voyons qu’il existe une méthodologie plus aboutie pour faire les choses, nous avons les compétences nécessaires pour développer et introduire des processus nouveaux ou des technologies de pointe, comme Amazon Robotics ou notre robot de tri ultra sophistiqué.

Basic qualifications

- Une expérience préalable en Facility Management ou gestion multi-technique de bâtiments (CVC, incendie, air comprimé, espaces verts)
- Une expérience préalable dans le management direct d'une équipe (idéalement 20+ collaborateurs)
- Une expérience préalable dans la gestion et la coordination de prestataires externes multiples
- Une expérience préalable dans des projets de création ou d'ouverture de site est un plus
- Parfaite maîtrise du français et niveau courant anglais à l'oral et à l'écrit
- Connaissance des réglementations statutaires telles que les contrôles de conformité et les protocoles de sécurité incendie et des installations techniques

Preferred qualifications

- Connaissance approfondie des systèmes CVC, des installations de sécurité incendie et des réseaux d'air comprimé
- Expérience dans la gestion de contrats de prestations et le pilotage de SLA
- Expérience dans la mise en service (commissioning) de bâtiments ou d'installations techniques
- Connaissance des outils d'analyse de données et des systèmes de gestion technique du bâtiment (GTB)
- Expérience préalable dans la gestion de projets ou des processus Kaizen, Lean, Six Sigma
- Connaissance des systèmes de gestion de la maintenance assistée par ordinateur (GMAO)

Amazon est un employeur engagé pour l'égalité des chances. Nous sommes convaincus qu'une main d'oeuvre diversifée est essentielle à notre réussite. Nous prenons nos décisions de recrutement en fonction de votre expérience et de vos compétences. Nous apprécions votre envie de découvrir, d'inventer, de simplifier et de construire. La protection de votre vie privée et la sécurité de vos données constituent depuis longtemps une priorité absolue pour Amazon. title: Delivery Consultant - Data , Professional Services, AWS Industries
descriptionHtml:
The Amazon Web Services Professional Services (ProServe) team is seeking a Delivery Consultant specializing in Data to join our AWS Industries practice. You will be at the center of the most consequential shift in enterprise technology: making organizations truly AI-ready. Every agentic AI system, every foundation model grounded in enterprise knowledge, and every GenAI application that moves from prototype to production depends on the data layer beneath it - and that's what you build.

You will design and implement modern data platforms (lake, lakehouse, mesh), architect data pipelines that transform raw, fragmented data estates into governed, AI-ready assets; and design and implement enterprise RAG architectures, vector stores, semantic ontologies, and knowledge graph architectures that allow foundation models and AI agents to reason accurately, access data securely, and execute autonomously within regulated environments. You will work hands-on inside customer environments with complex data lineage, legacy systems, and Build production-grade data solution that serve multiple downstream consumers, from ML model training to agentic orchestration layers.

The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes when using AWS services. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud computing and AI transformation initiatives.

This role requires approximately 50% co-location on site with customer, AWS and partner teams within the U.S.

10044
221100

Key job responsibilities

- Design and implement production-grade data pipelines, data lakes, and lakehouses within an enterprise environment, contributing to data mesh patterns and integrating with legacy systems and existing data governance frameworks
- Build data products that serve multiple downstream applications and use cases — from AI/ML model training to agentic AI systems — ensuring data quality, lineage, and reliability at scale
- Operate with a high degree of autonomy within fast-moving delivery engagements, making sound judgment calls on data modeling, pipeline design, and architecture without waiting for perfect specifications or constant oversight
- Navigate complex data access, security, and privacy requirements in a regulated Telco environment
- Help build contextual knowledge layers — ontologies and knowledge graphs — leveraging AWS Context, Amazon Bedrock Knowledge Bases, and custom ontology extensions to equip AI agents with the vocabulary and guardrails to reason accurately and execute autonomously
- Collaborate across organizational boundaries to secure data access, understand source-system context, and resolve data quality challenges with teams across customer IT, business, and partner organizations
- Deliver iteratively when requirements are ambiguous, translating incomplete business needs into well-architected data solutions that can evolve as customer understanding matures
- Apply AI-DLC (AI-accelerated Development Life Cycle) methodologies to data delivery, redesigning data workflows to become AI-native for accelerated scale and pace

title: Inventory Control & Quality Assurance Area Manager
descriptionHtml:
Do you aim to have a dynamic impact on the world? Are you up for creating solutions and solving tomorrow’s problems today? Then we have the opportunity for you! We are looking to hire an ICQA Area Manager to be part of our fulfillment center Inventory Control and Quality Assurance (ICQA) team. Our fulfillment centers (FC) sit at the heart of Amazon’s rapidly growing operations network: they are where we manage our fast-moving inventory. In each fulfillment center, our teams stow deliveries, pick products, package them up and ship them out; each of these groups have played their part in taking us where we are today. These fulfillment centers are fast-paced and high reward environments, where adherence to policies and procedures is key. We need a leader that ensures we deliver as reliably as ever to our customers, while making sure our teams deliver on customer obsession.

Key job responsibilities
- Lead and supervise a team of hourly Associates (including Team Leads and Data Analyst) assigned to inventory control, quality assurance and problem solve operations within the fulfillment center
- Support safety programs and compliance to ensure a safe work environment for all associates. Work with Operations and other Support teams to establish, influence and adhere to policies and procedures
- Coordinate inventory control, quality assurance and problem solve operations in accordance to network strategies and ensuring compliance and consistency with SOX
- Conduct shift planning and forecasting, alongside assigning and directing work. Oversee projects to streamline processes, increase quality and optimize productivity
- Ensure KPIs are reviewed on a daily, weekly, or monthly basis and perform quality analysis on any behaviors/processes that could impact inventory integrity and Customer esperience
- Gain expertise in key fulfillment center process paths and its exceptions handling in order to drive processes continuous improvement alongside the operations management team
- Support in interviewing and training fulfillment center managers and associates, developing talent and hiring the next generation of managers

A day in the life
You'll work shifts at one of our fulfillment centers, overseeing inventory control, quality assurance and problem solve operations. Your day typically starts with a team huddle, where you'll review previous shift performance, set daily goals, and address any ongoing issues.Throughout your shift, you will conduct inventory discrepancies analysis, oversee the resolution of receiving issues, and coach team members on accuracy improvement.You'll regularly analyze data, looking for trends and opportunities for process improvement, collaborating with other partners in FC operations or in central teams that own Catalogue, Procurement, Supply Chain, Process Engineering, Loss Prevention and Program Management. You'll need to make quick, informed decisions to keep operations running smoothly.Throughout your shift, you'll be on the floor, observing processes, coaching team members, and ensuring safety standards are maintained in you area. You'll also dedicate time to developing your team members, providing feedback, and identifying training needs. By shift end, you'll prepare a handover for the next shift, summarizing key events, ongoing issues, and priorities. You'll leave knowing you've contributed to maintaining inventory accuracy, resolving inbound challenges, and ultimately ensuring customer satisfaction through efficient and accurate fulfillment operations.

About the team
The EU ICQA mission is to prevent and remove customer-facing defects with the goal to provide a world class service to our customers, at the lowest possible cost. The Vision of ICQA is to exceed customers’ expectations, both buyers and sellers. We drive defect-free order fulfillment by operating in the most efficient and accurate way through the creation and implementation of quality standards in our FC processes (receive, stow, count, pick, pack & ship) up to our sellers and customers. We lead with empathy to create a safer, more productive, higher performing and more diverse work environment. We commit to empower and support our team members to grow and achieve their aspirations.

- Bachelor's degree in relevant field of operations
- Experience using MS Office suite (particularly Excel)
- Experience leading teams
- Knowledge of advanced English at CEFR level B2/C1
- Relevant experience in performing data analysis and understanding data sets and tools

- Experience in complex problem solving, and working in a tight schedule environment
- A resilient, focused problem solver and self-starter, with the ability to multi-task and prioritize in a complex and ambiguous environment
- Strong commitment to employee development, as well as an exceptional level of dedication, motivation to team management
- Proven ability to influence peers or stakeholders, with varying levels of seniority, within Ops organization
- A focused problem-solver and self-starter, with the ability to multi-task and prioritize in a complex environment

title: Quality Audit Representative, ICMRS Auditing
descriptionHtml:
NOC (Network Operations Center) is the centralized command and control center for ‘Transportation Execution’ across the Amazon Supply Chain network supporting India. It ensures timely tracking procurement and movement between various Amazon hubs. In case of any exceptions, NOC steps in to resolve the issues by keeping the stakeholders informed on the proceedings. Along with this tactical problem-solving NOC is also charged with understanding trends in network exceptions and then automating processes or proposing process changes to streamline operations. This second aspect involves network monitoring and significant analysis of network data. Overall, NOC plays a critical role in ensuring the smooth functioning of Amazon transportation and thereby has a direct impact on Amazon’s ability to serve its customers on time.

Key job responsibilities
Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:
1. Watch CCTV camera recordings from Amazon operations sites and check whether the activities on video follow the correct process, by answering a set of defined audit questions for each site.
2. Use the camera viewing software to find and open the right camera for a given location and time, and look closely at the footage to spot any process gaps or incorrect handling.
3. Complete the number of audits assigned for your shift each day, keeping both speed and accuracy at the expected level.
4. Build familiarity with how each site is laid out, how packages move through it, and how the cameras are named and positioned, so that you can quickly locate the correct footage to review.
5. Record your findings in the audit system, take screenshots as proof wherever a process is not being followed, and save that proof in the right place within the required time.
6. Follow the step by step checks defined for each audit question, and raise anything unclear or unusual to your team lead or manager.
7. Share your audit results on the schedule set for each audit type, whether that is daily, weekly, or once in two weeks.
8. Treat all video footage and findings as confidential, and follow the rules on data privacy and camera access at all times.
9. Take part in the training and practice when you join, including watching experienced auditors at work and then being observed yourself, and learn to handle more than one type of audit.
10. Meet the quality standards set for audit accuracy, and take part in the review sessions that check and improve the quality of audits.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- Experience with the Microsoft Office Suite including Word, Outlook, and Excel
- Experience that includes strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and effective communication abilities, or experience in managing and troublshooting network

Preferred qualifications

- Experience managing contract security and physical security operation programs such as access control/intrusion detection and CCTV surveillance systems
- Experience working with customers with a passion for delivering exceptional service, or experience that includes strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and effective communication abilities
- Experience working in a fast-paced and ambiguous environment
- Experience prioritizing and managing multiple responsibilities

title: Head of Specialists, Global Financial Services, WWSO Industries
descriptionHtml:
This position is part of the AWS Specialist and Partner Organization (ASP). Specialists own the end-to-end go-to-market strategy for their respective technology domains, providing the business and technical expertise to help our customers succeed. Partner teams own the strategy, recruiting, development, and growth of our key technology and consulting partners. Together they provide our customers with the expertise and scale needed to build innovative solutions for their most complex challenges.

The ASP Specialist Organization is hiring a Head of Go-To-Market Specialists for the Global Financial Services (GFS) customer segment. The Specialist team for GFS is responsible for working with customers to accelerate their adoption of AWS for complex solutions, services, and workloads in domains that include Gen AI, High Performance Computing, large scale data processing and analytics, high performance storage, application and data modernization, and others.

AWS is looking for an accomplished leader with experience across product, business, and technology that has worked with large Enterprises and high-growth organizations in the Financial Services customer segment to accelerate their cloud-native journey for the role of Leader of Specialist Organization for GFS. In this capacity, the leader will be the single-threaded owner for specialists and work alongside the leadership team of the GFS industry team at AWS, look around corners to prioritize investments and will lead a team of Specialists and Solutions Architects that provide expertise across multiple domains. The Specialist team that this person will lead also acts as an aggregation point for feedback and input from all the customers in GFS that directly feeds into the roadmap for product and services team at AWS. While leading a team of technical, product, and business experts, you will lead domain-based discussions with C-level business and IT executives, IT leaders, architects, developers, and various lines of businesses. You will play a critical role in taking the voice of the customer and sharing it back to the Worldwide Specialist Organization (WWSO) team to ensure customer feedback is amplified to effectively influence our technology roadmaps and Go-To-Market plans. This role will contribute to the overall performance of the business globally measured by revenue growth, net new customers, and product and service influence. You will have overachieved throughout your career and built strong, deep relationships with F1000 and/or G2000 organizations.

The ideal candidate will possess both a business background that enables them to drive an engagement and interact at the CxO / VP level, as well as background that enables them to easily interact with IT operations leaders, software developers, and infrastructure and applications architects. They should also have a demonstrated ability to think analytically about business, product, and technical challenges, with the ability to build and convey compelling value propositions, and work across the business to set vision, objectives and to build consensus. A keen sense of ownership, drive, and desire to dive deep is a must.

In this role you will be accountable for:

- Leading the creation of the GFS GTM plan, as well as oversee tactical execution, of insight-based programs and go to market activities with a focus on expanding AWS market share within top customers, segments, and verticals
- Using your business acumen to drive revenue, develop sales programs and identify new markets and opportunities. You would work directly with the most interesting and demanding customers to understand their requirements and turn them into reality
- Partnering with AWS services and industry teams to identify workloads that impact our AWS solutions
- A background in mapping the application of technology to customer business scenarios that help our customers understand how to improve their operational outcomes through the use of AWS solutions
- Your excellent verbal and written communication skills will allow you build sales enablement tools, evangelize our platform with our enterprise and mid-market customers as well as our valued partners and serve as the primary Executive Briefing Center representative of the WWSO business
- Act as a trusted business advisor while deep diving into data, creating high impact programs, and tracking progress while tuning for desired results
- Be a leader of global, decentralized teams. You will guide cross functional teams to drive AWS adoption in the key workloads that use the WWSO portfolio
- Define, drive, measure, manage and coach on workload focused goals across the business


About the team
Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve

- Experience developing strategies that influence leadership decisions at the organizational level
- Experience influencing innovation through a partner ecosystem with either solutions or programs that have demonstrated success at enterprise customers
- Experience in the financial services industry

Preferred qualifications

title: Packaging Manager, World Wide Grocery Stores - Private Brands NA
descriptionHtml:
The World Wide Grocery Private Brands team is looking for a Packaging Manager to join our team. This role serves as the technical owner and packaging authority for a set of categories within our PB business. In this role, you will own the end-to-end packaging strategy for your categories across both Amazon and Whole Foods Market (WFM) branded products, with limited guidance. You will be the end-to-end packaging owner for your assigned food categories, responsible for new product commercialization, cost reduction, sustainability, and omnichannel performance. Our product packaging must work across all Grocery channels, including WFM stores, Amazon Fresh, and Same Day Grocery. You will work backwards from customer needs to optimize packaging that protects product quality, reduces damage, and meets financial targets.

You will develop deep expertise in the materials within your categories, and build relationships with Private Brand suppliers and their packaging partners. You will work within supplier capabilities to optimize packaging solutions, partnering with Sourcing Managers to influence decisions and drive improvements over time.

As this role supports both Whole Foods Market and Amazon Private Brands, you must be a strong champion for both brands' distinct missions and values. This means being passionate about WFM's commitment to nourishing people and the planet, while embracing Amazon's mission to make delicious food accessible and affordable for everyone.


Key job responsibilities
Category Ownership & Commercialization
- Own packaging deliverables for your assigned category portfolio (e.g., Snacks; Beverages & Meals; or Meat, Seafood & Frozen), including specification development, sample coordination, and testing for new product launches.

- Build relationships with Private Brand suppliers and their packaging partners to understand capabilities, identify opportunities, and drive improvements.
Omnichannel Performance

- Ensure packaging performs across all Grocery channels (Whole Foods Market stores, Amazon Fresh delivery, and Core e-commerce fulfillment) so products can be sold omnichannel.
- Evaluate and improve existing packaging formats with suppliers to reduce damage, lower shipping costs, and improve the customer experience.
- Assess and improve outer packaging and shippable containers appropriate for e-commerce, reducing shipping costs, ensuring undamaged product, and minimizing waste for consumers.
Cost Reduction & Sustainability
- Leverage deep material and substrate expertise within your categories to identify cost reduction and plastic reduction opportunities.
- Continually find ways to drive cost out of our packaging efforts while maintaining product quality and customer experience.

Quality & Continuous Improvement

- Perform lab testing with the ability to translate and articulate overall impact and opportunities that drive value for the business.
- Analyze customer needs and feedback to develop optimal product packaging, leveraging the unique opportunities being an online brand can provide.
- Maintain accurate packaging specifications across your category portfolio.
Cross-Functional Partnership
- Provide packaging expertise across cross-functional teams, evaluate supplier packaging proposals, and advise senior management on packaging trends and solutions.
- Influence packaging decisions across the Sourcing Organization without direct authority.

About the team
Amazon Grocery is one of the fastest growing grocers in the US. Whole Foods Market is expanding, our perishables business is accelerating with Same Day Grocery delivery, and customers are increasingly turning to Amazon for their everyday grocery needs. This is a builder's role on a team that is defining what grocery packaging looks like at scale. The way people buy groceries is evolving, and packaging must evolve with it. If you want to build something from the ground up within one of the fastest growing businesses at Amazon, this is the role for you.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of product management experience
- Experience managing technical products or online services
- Experience in product, program, or project management in leading cross-functional teams in delivery of major new products or services
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent

title: Head of Business Affairs, Japan, Amazon MGM Studios Business Affairs
descriptionHtml:
Amazon MGM Studios is seeking a senior Business Affairs leader to drive deal-making for original film and television content in Japan — one of the world's most dynamic entertainment markets. This is an opportunity to shape the future of Japanese storytelling for a global audience on Prime Video.

As the development and production arm of Amazon, Amazon MGM Studios produces original content for Prime Video customers worldwide. In this role, you will be a leader on the business affairs team for all scripted and unscripted deals in Japan, reporting to the Head of International Business Affairs. You will bring significant experience negotiating original content development (e.g., original scripts, book options, underlying rights, overalls) and production matters (e.g., actor, writer, director, producer, and production company agreements). A comprehensive working knowledge of international film and television industry business models, development, and production methodologies is essential.

The ideal candidate understands what is market and what isn't, and can develop creative solutions to challenges that arise when blending traditional studio work with a global streaming service.

Key job responsibilities
- Lead all business affairs activities for Amazon MGM Studios Japan across scripted and unscripted original content
- Negotiate development deals including original scripts, book options, underlying rights, overall deals, and first-look arrangements
- Structure and negotiate production agreements with actors, writers, directors, producers, and production companies
- Manage, mentor, and develop a team of business affairs professionals, ensuring operational excellence and professional growth
- Advise senior creative and production executives on deal structures, risk assessment, and market-competitive terms under time-sensitive conditions
- Partner with Legal, Finance, Creative and Production to ensure deals align with corporate parameters and business objectives
- Monitor and advise on evolving market trends, competitive deal terms, and industry practices in the Japanese entertainment landscape
- Collaborate with the international Business Affairs team to ensure consistency and share best practices across territories
- Manage a varied, high-volume workload efficiently while maintaining composure in high-pressure situations

A day in the life
Your week might begin reviewing term sheets for an upcoming original series, followed by a negotiation session with a major Japanese production company. By midday, you're advising a creative executive on deal structure options for a new film project, then jumping on a call with the international Business Affairs team to align on global deal standards. Between meetings, you're coaching a team member through their first complex talent negotiation. No two days look the same — but every day involves creative problem-solving, strategic thinking, and close collaboration across Amazon MGM Studios.

About the team
The Amazon MGM Studios Japan Business Affairs team is part of the broader International Business Affairs organization. We work at the intersection of creative ambition and business strategy, partnering with development, production, legal, and finance teams to bring original Japanese content to Prime Video's global audience. Our team values collaboration, intellectual curiosity, and a passion for entertainment.

- 7+ years of entertainment industry deal negotiation experience
- Experience in negotiating complex agreements with an understanding of legal terminology and reasoning
- Speak, write, and read fluently in Japanese
- Speak, write, and read fluently in English
- Experience managing a team

Preferred qualifications

- J.D., MBA, or equivalent advanced degree
- Experience in content negotiation, acquisition or business development
- Experience in a studio, production company, streamer or television network

title: Applied Scientist, Prime Video Sports Personalization, Prime Video Sports Personalization
descriptionHtml:
Come build the future of entertainment with us. Are you interested in helping shape the future of movies and television? Do you want to help define the next generation of how and what Amazon customers are watching?

Prime Video is a premium streaming service that offers customers a vast collection of TV shows and movies - all with the ease of finding what they love to watch in one place. We offer customers thousands of popular movies and TV shows from Originals and Exclusive content to exciting live sports events. We also offer our members the opportunity to subscribe to add-on channels which they can cancel at any time and to rent or buy new release movies and TV box sets on the Prime Video Store. Prime Video is a fast-paced, growth business - available in over 240 countries and territories worldwide. The team works in a dynamic environment where innovating on behalf of our customers is at the heart of everything we do. If this sounds exciting to you, please read on

We are seeking an exceptional Applied Scientist to join our Prime Video Sports personalization team in Israel. Our team is dedicated to developing state-of-the-art science to personalize the customer experience and help customers seamlessly find any live event in our selection. You will have the opportunity to work on innovative, large-scale projects that push the boundaries of what's possible in sports content delivery and engagement. Your expertise will be crucial in tackling complex challenges such as information retrieval, sequential modeling, real-time model optimization, utilizing Large Language Models (LLMs), and building advanced recommender systems.

Key job responsibilities
We are looking for an Applied Scientist with domain expertise in Personalization, Information Retrieval, and Recommender Systems — or strong general ML fundamentals — to develop new algorithms and end-to-end solutions. As part of our team of applied scientists and software development engineers, you will research, design, develop, and deploy algorithms into production pipelines. You'll work with state-of-the-art technologies in recommender systems and search, and tackle unique challenges like temporal information retrieval to improve real-time sports content recommendations. As a technologist, you will also drive the publication of original work in top-tier Machine Learning and Recommender Systems venues.

About the team
We're the Sports Science team behind personalization for live sports on Prime Video. We build custom deep learning models that predict what each customer wants to watch across live and upcoming events -- powering relevance and ranking at scale for one of the most dynamic, real-time personalization problems at Amazon. Our work spans the full stack: engineering, Transformer-based architectures, calibration, and low-latency serving in production. We own our models end to end, from research to deployment. If you're excited about applied science that ships and reaches millions of customers, come build with us.

Basic qualifications

- Experience in building models for business application
- Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language
- Experience applying theoretical models in an applied environment
- Master's degree in computer science, computer engineering, or related field

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in professional software development
- Experience in patents or publications at top-tier peer-reviewed conferences or journals
- PhD in computer science, computer engineering, or related field

title: Associate Solutions Architect Internship 2027
descriptionHtml:
Join Amazon Web Services (AWS) as an Associate Solutions Architect Intern and launch your career in cloud computing. Available to work full-time for either 3 or 6 months during 2027, you'll gain hands-on experience designing cloud and generative AI solutions, learning from experienced architects, and working on real AWS projects that impact millions of customers worldwide.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world's leading cloud computing platform, helping millions of customers — from startups to global enterprises — build and run applications without managing physical servers. We're seeking motivated individuals for our Associate Solutions Architect Intern program, a structured learning experience designed to develop the next generation of Cloud Solutions Architects.

This internship serves as a pathway to our Solutions Architect Graduate Program, offering you the opportunity to build foundational knowledge in cloud computing, AWS services, and solutions architecture principles in a supportive, education-first environment. You'll learn to understand customer requirements, build working cloud and AI solutions, and communicate technical recommendations effectively while being mentored by experienced Solutions Architects.

Key job responsibilities
Complete a structured training curriculum to build cloud architecture foundations and develop expertise in AWS services
Analyze customer requirements and learn to translate them into technical solution recommendations
Participate in solution design sessions and observe customer engagements with experienced Solutions Architects
Work on a real AWS project, applying architecture principles and building hands-on experience with AWS services
Develop communication skills by learning to present technical concepts effectively to diverse audiences

A day in the life
As an Associate Solutions Architect Intern, you'll engage in a mix of structured learning and practical application. Your day might include attending training sessions on AWS services and the Well-Architected Framework, then applying those concepts to a real project you're building on AWS. You'll participate in solution design discussions, observing how experienced architects translate customer needs into technical recommendations. You might shadow customer engagements to see how solutions are presented to diverse audiences, then return to work on your own project, experimenting with AWS services and architecture principles. Throughout your internship, you'll develop presentation skills by communicating technical concepts to colleagues and mentors, receiving feedback that helps you grow as a solutions architect.

About the team
We are the EMEA Student Programs Team within AWS, dedicated to nurturing emerging talent in cloud computing. Our team collaborates across the organization to create meaningful internship experiences that bridge the gap between academic learning and real-world cloud architecture. We work with experienced Solutions Architects who are committed to mentoring the next generation of cloud professionals. Together, we're building a community of architects who understand how to solve complex business problems through innovative cloud solutions. When you join us, you'll be part of a team that values your growth, supports your learning journey, and helps you develop the skills needed to succeed in cloud consulting and solutions architecture.

Basic qualifications

- Currently enrolled in penultimate or final year of a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related technical field, graduating in 2027 or 2028
- Speak, write, and read fluently in English at C1 level or above
- Speak, write, and read fluently in Swedish at C1 level or above
- Experience with at least one modern programming language (such as Python, Java, C++, or JavaScript)
- Right to work in Sweden for the duration of the internship
- Understanding of basic IT systems, software development, or system architecture concepts

Preferred qualifications

- Knowledge of networking fundamentals, including security, storage, or databases (relational and/or NoSQL)
- Understanding of operating systems (Unix, Linux, and/or Windows)

- Experience with systems administration (Linux/Windows), network administration (DNS, IPsec, BGP, VPN, load balancing), or programming (Node.JS, Java, Ruby, C#, Python, or PHP)

descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is an initiative to launch a constellation of Low Earth Orbit satellites that will provide low-latency, high-speed broadband network connectivity to unserved and underserved communities around the world.

Have you wanted an opportunity to secure an advanced satellite broadband telecom service? The Leo Security team owns the security of product and operations of Amazon Leo end-to-end. We provide the necessary infrastructure and mechanisms to ensure the security of our satellite constellation and to protect the integrity and confidentiality of our customer data. Our team drives the security validation of of several mission-critical systems and mechanisms. You will work in a start-up like environment, backed by Amazon’s infrastructure to bootstrap security mechanisms, and help instill the security culture in the organization.

Export Control Requirement

Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Key job responsibilities
Help us protect not only Amazon’s Leo product and environment but all of our customers as well! You will be responsible for managing a team of security engineers and technical program managers evaluating the risks related to Amazon Leo, specifically on its embedded devices and firmware, identifying blockers for builders, and creating metrics to demonstrate your team’s performance. You will help set the direction for a team of security professionals that is responsible for Amazon Leo's devices and firmware. This role combines long term strategic planning to raise the bar on security across the enterprise with the excitement and challenge of quickly reacting to new threat scenarios.

As a security engineering manager at Amazon, you will be expected to speak authoritatively on behalf of your team and your technical knowledge should demonstrate both depth and breadth. You will be responsible for your team’s organizational structure and how that team works within the context of the larger Amazon Security team. Leveraging the strengths of individual team members, delegating tasks appropriately and managing delivery of long term projects will all be critical tasks for this role. A security manager has deep knowledge in their domain and is a sought after thought leader across the organization. They have both management and technical expertise and actively participate in the organization’s planning processes.

Highlights of responsibilities:

* Team management, growth, and organization
* Professional development of team members
* Project management
* Metrics and projections
* Set vision, define strategy and roadmap and drive the execution of security initiatives
* Recruiting
* Process Improvement
* Work across Amazon Security and Project Kuiper organizations to partner on solutions

A day in the life
In this role you'll lead a team of engineers and TPMs, you'll build their careers and help solve complex security problems. You'll help identify trends in the findings your team generates or processes and will work with partners to remove these bug classes at source. You influence the security strategy of partner teams to optimize security outcomes for our customers. You'll participate in hiring, development, training, and team leadership. You'll own a part of the team and will be encouraged to grow your ownership and role.

About the team
Diverse Experiences
Amazon Security values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why Amazon Security?
At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon’s products and services. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores.

Inclusive Team Culture
In Amazon Security, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Ongoing DEI events and learning experiences inspire us to continue learning and to embrace our uniqueness. Addressing the toughest security challenges requires that we seek out and celebrate a diversity of ideas, perspectives, and voices.

Training & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, training, and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

Export Control Requirement:

- 5+ years of progressive work within a software security team or related operating environment experience
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field
- Knowledge of information security technologies such as security design review, threat modeling, risk analysis, and software testing techniques
- Experience in managing and developing teams

- Experience applying threat modeling or other risk identification techniques or equivalent

title: Sr. Technical Program Manager, SCOT- Fulfillment Optimization, Planning
descriptionHtml:
Here’s a fun one: when you order something on Amazon, there are practically thousands of ways we could get it to you. Which Fulfillment Center ships it? Which carriers carry it? Which items get tucked into the same box? Now scale that puzzle to billions of items shipped annually, worldwide. That’s our playground.

At Amazon’s Supply Chain Optimization Technologies (SCOT), we’re tasked with fulfilling customer orders in the smartest way imaginable — getting every order out the door, across the globe, on time, and brilliantly optimized. It’s big, it’s bold, and it’s a genuinely delightful set of problems to wake up to.

Want the big picture? Take a two-minute tour here: http://bit.ly/amazon-scot.



Key job responsibilities
Program leadership: Drive complex, cross-functional technical programs end to end — from fuzzy idea to delivered impact — across science, engineering, and ops teams.

Roadmaps & mechanisms: Build and own roadmaps, operating cadences, and the mechanisms that keep everyone aligned and accountable.

Cross-team alignment: Partner with scientists, software engineers, and business stakeholders to translate optimization goals into clear, executable plans.

Risk management: Spot risks and dependencies early, clear roadblocks, and keep programs humming even when the terrain gets tricky.

Metrics & goals: Define success metrics, track progress against goals, and keep a clear-eyed view of what’s working (and what needs a nudge).

Executive communication: Craft crisp, compelling updates for senior leaders — turning complexity into confident, decision-ready narratives.

A day in the life
You kick off the morning scanning program dashboards over coffee — simulations ran overnight, and the results are in. title: Senior Channel Team Lead, On the Road, AMZL
descriptionHtml:
※本ポジションの所属地は、以下のいずれかから選択頂けます。
・筑紫野デリバリーステーション 福岡県筑紫野市

※こちらのポジションは、西日本の小規模デリバリー複数ご担当いただきます。担当エリアや業務状況により、週1～3日程度の出張（日帰り・宿泊を伴う場合有）が発生する可能性があります。ただし繁忙期には出張の頻度が増える可能性があります。

Amazonは、フルフィルメントセンターからデリバリーステーションまで一貫した物流ネットワークを構築・運営しています。デリバリーステーションは、お客様に高品質なサービスを提供するラストマイル配送を担っている部門です。
今回募集するSr. Channel Team Leadは、西日本に所在する小規模デリバリーステーションの運営サポート・成長を牽引する中核ポジションです。配送パートナーと密接に連携し、オペレーション管理、品質の継続的な改善、および複雑な課題解決を主導的かつ戦略的に実行することで、カスタマーエクスペリエンス向上・パートナーサクセスに貢献します。
物流・オペレーション未経験の方も歓迎しており、入社後はOJT・トレーニングを通じて、課題解決・プロジェクト推進など、必要なスキルを段階的に習得できる環境が整っています。



Key job responsibilities
■ 業務内容 ■
①オペレーション
西日本に所在する複数のデリバリーステーション（3～4拠点）における年間目標（安全・品質・生産性）の達成に向け、改善活動の計画立案、実行、および進捗管理を一貫して行い、目標達成に対する責任を負います。
日々の配送オペレーションにおける課題（需要変動、システムトラブルなど）に対し、Amazonのポリシー・コンプライアンスを遵守しながら、配送パートナーと協働して解決を主導します。
必要に応じ、現状の包括的な分析と客観的な判断基準をマネージャーに明瞭に説明し、適切な戦略的意思決定を促進します。

②プロジェクト
プロセス・システム・テクノロジー導入プロジェクトにおいて、社内の関連部門と連携し、現場導入のプロジェクトチームの一員として役割を実行します。
また、マネージャーの支援を受けて、他部門を巻き込む改善プロジェクトのリーダーとしてプロジェクトマネジメントを行います。

③ レポーティング・情報共有
配送パートナーのパフォーマンスを現場とデータの両側面から分析し、マネージャーへレポーティングを行います。
課題・リスクを分析し、改善案を立案します。また、データドリブンな意思決定を支えるため、各種メトリクスのトレンド分析を通じて本質的な課題を抽出し、定量的な根拠に基づいた優先順位付けを行います。

④ チャネル・パートナーシップマネジメント
配送パートナーに対し、安全・品質・生産性改善のコンサルティングを行い、事業の持続的な成長と安定化を促進します。
配送パートナーのエンゲージメント向上をけん引し、リテンション改善の要となる役割を果たします。

⑤人材開発・文化形成
メンバーの成長を積極的に支援し、会社の就業規則及び各種ポリシーに関する深い理解に基づき、チームメンバーを適切に指導することで、組織の健全性を維持します。メンバーの業務上の懸念事項や課題に傾聴し、必要に応じて適切な専門部署（相談先）と連携するとともに、自律的な問題解決に取り組みます。
リーダーシッププリンシプルを深く理解し、多様性を尊重する組織文化の形成に貢献します。

A day in the life
■キャリアパス■
Senior Channel Team Leadからキャリアをスタートし、Senior Area Manager、Regional Managerとなるキャリアアップのチャンスがあります。また、Amazonでは社内公募制度があり、国内外問わず他部署や異なる職種への異動にチャレンジし、社内で多様なキャリアを築くことができます。Amazonでは自身で学び成長することを推奨し、キャリア開発できるようサポートを行っています。

■会社のカルチャー■
Amazonでは全員がリーダーです。個人の裁量に任される部分が多く、社員の個々の可能性を最大限に伸ばす事を重視しています。様々なバックグラウンドを持った社員が前職で培った多様な経験やスキルを活かして職位や役割に関わらず誰もがチャレンジできる環境です。
Amazonには失敗に寛容な文化があります。まずは試してみることにこだわります。好奇心を持って学びます。時にはリスクを取り、計画通りいかなかったとしても、よりよい成果に繋げられることが私たちの強みだと信じています。

title: UX Designer II, Ops Tech Solution ACES
descriptionHtml:
Do you believe great design is how technology make sense? Are you energized by a studio where UX design is the thread that ties everything together? Interested in creating a single visual system carries across video, animation, interactive 3D, and the knowledge articles people actually read, and where the design decisions you make are tested against real user data?

We are looking for an UX Designer to join Ops Tech Solutions (OTS) ACES team supporting the IT For Me high-output creative studio in Nashville, TN. IT For Me makes technology easier to understand and solutions easier to find. We do it with a deliberate visual framework, a consistent style and interaction pattern that carries across every medium we deliver: from self-service tech videos to interactive 3D hardware guides, redesigned knowledge-base articles, and live events. Our work is not decoration. We design how information is received, measure whether it lands, and iterate to improve it.

This is an experienced UX role on the team. You will own the steady, high-volume work that keeps the studio moving, and you will do it as a designer producing within our visual framework, redesigning knowledge content so it is clearer and easier to use, and helping gather the feedback and usage data that tells us what is working. All while collaborating with senior designers on the most complex, high-end builds. The through-line in everything you make is the IT For Me design system, and your job is to apply it, keep it consistent, and help it improve.

If you are strong creative in the visual design space, curious about how users respond to what you make, organized enough to run a studio, and eager to be challenged within systems-level UX work, motion, and 3D, we want to meet you.

Key job responsibilities
You will own the foundational, high-frequency design and production work that keeps OTS ACES delivering at pace, and you will grow the UX craft by:
• Apply the design system consistently across every deliverable (lower thirds, titles, intros, thumbnails, article layouts, and graphics) so the experience is coherent whatever the medium.
• Partner with senior designers and technical stakeholders to take briefs from intake to delivery, articulate the reasoning behind a design choice, and keep SIM tickets and worklogs current.
• Helping gather and interpret design feedback and usage data: article view and deflection metrics, A/B comparisons, and user or stakeholder feedback, then use what you learn to refine the work and inform the next iteration.
• Build supporting motion and graphic assets in After Effects, Illustrator, Photoshop, and contribute to interactive 3D hardware guides, growing into more advanced motion and 3D work over time.
• Own studio equipment and inventory: track, maintain, and stage cameras, lenses, lighting, audio gear, and accessories so the kit is always shoot-ready, and flag repairs or purchasing needs.
• Produce and edit the studio’s steady-state video content, including interview videos, leadership and PR-style announcement videos, edited in Adobe Premiere Pro and After Effects.


A day in the life
The OTS ACES day is varied and driven by our customers. UX design here is a full loop, not a hand-off. We study how our content is received, through usage data, A/B studies, and direct feedback, and we use that evidence to improve the design and to explain to stakeholders why a given approach works.
You might start working within a knowledge article within our framework and checking last week’s view and deflection numbers to see how a recent redesign is performing, spend the rest of the day in the studio running cameras and audio for a shoot.


About the team

descriptionHtml:

Using this unique insight, the Strategic Sourcing Manager will build and lead sourcing engagements for both existing and newly emerging categories of spend, as well as negotiate multi-faceted partnership agreements for Amazon's high-growth businesses worldwide. Strategic Sourcing Managers own complex categories across multiple business units and regions, often in markets with limited competition and pricing transparency, and lead transformational sourcing initiatives with global scope. Strategic Sourcing Managers are expert practitioners in creating competitive environments, and have a strong bias for decision making rooted in data and analytics. They routinely influence C-level vendor relationships by advising senior Amazon leaders across multiple stakeholder groups on the direction of sourcing projects in support of business unit and corporate goals, and they raise the bar for sourcing peers across the global team.
