title: Principal Applied Scientist, Mission AI Lab, AWS Region Services
descriptionHtml:
Some of the hardest problems in security are waiting on models that do not exist yet. As a Principal Applied Scientist, you will create them. You start from the strongest models in the world and push them to excel at problems no off-the-shelf model has ever seen. This is one of the largest AI infrastructure programs AWS has ever taken on, and you will train on latest-generation GPU hardware, among the first anywhere to put it to work at this scale.

Much of this has no established playbook. There is no benchmark to tell you a model is ready, so you will invent both the method that gets it there and the measure that proves it. The lab is purpose-built for this work and you join at the start, helping shape its technical direction and building the methods and evaluations that carry forward into everything it does next.

This is a hands-on role. You will research the state of the art science, make the calls on how models are trained and evaluated, write code and work alongside the engineers who run the infrastructure, and partner directly with the analysts and operators who depend on the work. You will also explain what the models can and cannot yet do, in plain terms, to the people whose decisions rely on them.

The candidate selected must obtain and maintain a security clearance at the TS/SCI with polygraph level. Upon start, the selected candidate will be sponsored for a commensurate clearance for each government agency for which they perform AWS work.

Key job responsibilities
• Own the end-to-end adaptation of frontier models for complex reasoning tasks, from supervised fine-tuning and post-training through reinforcement learning, delivered as production systems people can rely on in the field
• Define what "good" means for each task, building the evaluation sets, test harnesses, and metrics that measure model quality where no public benchmark exists
• Build and own the data pipelines that turn raw operational data into high-signal training and evaluation sets, including curation, quality scoring, provenance tracking, and strict leakage and contamination controls
• Judge when a problem needs a genuinely new method versus an extension of an existing one, and make the call with evidence
• Choose the training and adaptation methods, including parameter-efficient techniques, that turn serious dedicated compute into the largest gains in capability
• Extend adapted models into new priority domains, owning transferability, generalization, and calibration under real-world distribution shift
• Run data-preparation and human-in-the-loop feedback loops with the analysts who know the problems best, turning their expertise into better data and sharper evaluations
• Package methods and evaluations so they can be reused as the lab's work grows, and shared with Amazon's model teams
• Represent the lab's science in technical reviews and to program and technical leaders, surfacing what the models can do and where the risks are
• Help set the technical bar for the lab, and mentor scientists as the team grows

A day in the life
You start the morning reviewing an overnight fine-tuning run against an evaluation suite you built, checking whether the adapted model beats the base on the metrics that matter most. Mid-morning, you work with the engineers who run the infrastructure to get a large training run moving and squeeze the most capability out of it. After lunch, you sit with domain analysts to turn their feedback into a cleaner, better-labeled evaluation set for a change-detection task, then decide whether the next gain calls for a new method or an extension of one you already have. You close the day documenting that method and evaluation so the rest of the lab can build on it, and writing a short, plain-language readout of what the model can and cannot yet do for the people who depend on it.

About the team
The Mission AI Model Lab is the science team behind AWS's Mission AI program. We take existing models and make them useful for problems that matter to national security, working on dedicated AI infrastructure built for exactly that. This lab is purpose-built and these are among its first scientists, so the people who join now help shape how it works and what it builds. We sit where frontier-model research meets national security delivery, and we value invention on genuinely new problems, evaluation we can defend, and plain talk with the people who rely on what we build.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of hands-on work in predictive modeling and analysis experience
- PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Mathematics, or a related technical field
- Experience working in predictive modeling and analysis
- Experience distilling informal customer requirements into problem definitions, dealing with ambiguity and competing objectives
- Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language
- Experience with leading experienced scientists as well as having a record of developing junior members from academia or industry to a career track in a business environment

Preferred qualifications

- 10+ years of relevant work in industry or academia experience
- Knowledge of problem solving, algorithm design and complexity analysis
- Experience creating novel algorithms and advancing the state of the art
- Current, active TS/SCI US Government Security Clearance
- Experience at a frontier AI lab, national lab, defense AI company, or government research program
- Parameter-efficient fine-tuning (LoRA-style methods) and efficient training within a fixed compute budget

title: Forward Deployed Engineer, AWS Forward Deployed Engineering
descriptionHtml:
A Forward Deployed Engineer II (FDE II) embeds directly inside a strategic enterprise customer to independently design, build, deploy, and run AI-powered production systems alongside the customer's engineering team. FDE IIs write production-grade software and own delivery of complete AI workstreams end-to-end — from requirements gathering through production deployment — combining the technical rigor of an AWS SDE with the urgency and ownership required to deliver measurable customer business outcomes.

FDE IIs are autonomous contributors. They deliver working features spanning the full software lifecycle. They design cohesive implementations for ambiguous problems, making design trade-offs with appropriate guidance. They take on projects where the business problem is understood but implementations are not fully fleshed out, balancing constraints and limiting short-term workarounds. They coach others on producing high-quality code and train new team members.

Key job responsibilities
Embed within customer engineering teams. Work with customers, stakeholders, and peers to understand the business and customer value of the systems you build. Understand the customer's business processes, technical architecture, and operational constraints. Translate customer requirements into technical designs for AI-enabled production systems within your workstream. Requires 30–50% travel.

Build production AI applications. Design and develop production-grade software powering AI and agentic workflows — retrieval pipelines, workflow automation, API orchestration layers, data integration. Solve difficult problems with visible risks or roadblocks, bringing clarity and identifying simple designs for solutions. Integrate foundation models, customer data sources, and existing applications into cohesive AI experiences. Optimize for latency, reliability, and cost.

Own production for your workstream. Be a significant contributor to the full software development lifecycle including scoping, design, code, testing, deployment, operations, and maintenance. Troubleshoot production incidents across AI models, distributed systems, and application services. Ensure root causes of operational issues are identified and resolved. Implement monitoring, evaluations, guardrails, and CI/CD that keep AI systems healthy. Don't settle for the status quo — routinely identify and execute on opportunities to improve operations.

Mentor and uplift. Actively mentors and trains new team members on how systems are constructed, operated, and fit into the bigger picture. Coach others on producing high-quality code through mechanisms such as code review. Be active in the code review process, providing meaningful feedback to others.

Accelerate customer adoption. Identify opportunities to expand AI adoption within your customer engagement. Codify reusable patterns and accelerators that benefit future customer deployments and feed back into AWS services. Make enhancements that improve your team's software and processes.

About the team
Diverse Experiences
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
 
Why AWS
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud. 

Inclusive Team Culture
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship and Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

descriptionHtml:
アマゾンは「地球上で最もお客様を大切にする企業になること」を使命とし、高品質な輸送ネットワーク・サービスの拡大に投資を行っています。物流業界の変化を見据え、従来の型にとらわれない自社独自の輸送ネットワーク・サービスの構築を進めており、これまでにない革新的な幹線輸送ネットワークを一緒に作り上げる意欲的なメンバーを募集します。

アマゾンジャパンの物流輸送企画事業部では、自社輸送網の幹線輸送に関わる事業企画・管理の中核を担っています。社内の事業計画・実行部門、システム開発部門、財務部門に加え、大手を含む運送会社や3PLといった取引先企業と連携しながら、アマゾンの成長を支える幹線輸送ネットワーク・サービスの維持・拡大のための重要な任務を遂行しています。具体的には、幹線輸送のコスト構造の可視化と最適化、輸送拠点や輸送サービスの立ち上げプロジェクトの推進、そして中長期的な幹線輸送戦略の立案と策定を行います。

本ポジションでは、幹線輸送事業における分析・改善、コスト最適化、プロジェクトリードなど複数の業務を、社内外のステークホルダーと調整しながら実行していただきます。データ分析に基づく仮説検証やコスト低減施策の立案・実行を通じて、幹線輸送事業の継続的な改善に貢献していただきます。

Amazonでは、最新のAI Tool, 生成AIを日々の業務の中に積極的に取り入れています。
AI Toolは私たちの意思決定のスピードを加速させ、私たちを本当に重要な「判断」と「議論」に集中させることを可能にしています。Amazon では学習を継続する文化が根付いているため、ご自身のペースでAIに関する知識を深めることができるリソースが用意されています。


Key job responsibilities
アマゾンは「地球上で最もお客様を大切にする企業になること」を使命としています。そのため、高品質な輸送ネットワーク・サービス拡大に投資を行っています。特に物流業界の変化を見据え、従来の型に捕らわれない自社独自の輸送ネットワーク・サービスを構築中です。 アマゾンジャパンの物流輸送企画事業部では、その自社輸送網の幹線輸送に関わる事業企画・管理の中核を担うメンバーを求めています。

幹線輸送の複雑な事業構造を理解し、そのコスト構造を見える化するためのレポーティングを行います。具体的には、週次サイクルでコストの変化を捉え、その要因の仮説を立て、データ分析に基づき仮説を検証、対応策の立案および実行を担うことで、幹線輸送事業におけるコスト低減に貢献して頂きます。

descriptionHtml:
※本ポジションの勤務地は兵庫県尼崎市に位置する物流拠点です。

Amazonでは日本のAmazon Logistics （AMZL）チームの新しいビジネスモデルの革新を担うオペレーションマネージャーを募集しています。AMZLのゴールはお客様に荷物をお届けする物流の最後の区間、ラストマイルにおいて、世界水準のオペレーションを構築することです。Amazonではお客様により速く、正確に、そして効果的な方法でお届けすることで、お客様の期待を上回るサービスを提供することに重点的に取り組んでおり、日本でもAMZLが急速に拡大しています。

Operations Manager, OTRは、担当地域体での新しい配送モデルを開発、管理することが求められます。また、ラストマイル（最終拠点からエンドユーザーへの物流サービス）のオペレーション・チームの一員として、お客様へのラストマイル配送に関する様々な手法を開発し、長期的な配送能力を構築していきます。

===================================
*Working location for this position is a Delivery Station base in Hyogo, Amagasaki.

Amazon is looking for an operation manager to be responsible for innovating a new business model for the Amazon Logistics (AMZL) team in Japan. AMZL's goal is to build world-class operations in the last mile, the last leg of logistics to deliver packages to customers. Amazon is focusing on providing services that exceed customer expectations by delivering to customers in a faster, more accurate, and more effective manner, and AMZL is rapidly expanding in Japan as well.

Operations Manager, OTR is required to develop and manage new delivery models in responsible regions. Furthermore, as a member of the Last Mile (logistics service from final location to end user) operation team, we will develop various methods related to last mile delivery to customers and build long-term delivery capabilities.

Key job responsibilities

title: Senior Sourcing Manager (12-months fixed-term contract), Fleet sourcing
descriptionHtml:
Delivering on Amazon's customer promise depends on having the right vehicles, in the right place, at the right cost. The fleet business powering last mile operations across EU and MENA (Middle East and North Africa) is scaling rapidly into new vehicle types and new geographies, and the Sourcing team needs a Senior Sourcing Manager to help keep pace. In this 12-month fixed-term role, you will own sourcing for assigned fleet categories across both branded (OEM) and variable (rental) last mile fleet — identifying supply options, negotiating terms, and securing committed capacity. On the branded side, you will lead OEM engagement for the MENA region, building the commercial case to secure vehicle capacity. On the rental side, you will grow the supplier portfolio through the Fleet Exchange Marketplace, onboarding new suppliers across EU with a particular focus on southern European markets. If you are a self-starter who enjoys supplier negotiations, data-backed analysis, and working in a business that moves fast, we want to hear from you.

Key job responsibilities
- Own end-to-end sourcing for assigned EU/MENA fleet categories, from identifying supply options to negotiating terms and securing committed capacity across both branded and variable (rental) last mile fleet.
- Lead OEM engagement for the MENA region, preparing commercial cases and running supplier discussions to secure vehicle capacity for Amazon last mile operations.
- Grow the rental supplier portfolio through the Fleet Exchange Marketplace by sourcing new leads and onboarding suppliers onto the platform across EU, with a focus on Italy, Spain, and France.
- Build data-backed sourcing models and analysis to support recommendations to senior leaders, and influence internal stakeholders to secure alignment on sourcing decisions.
- Develop and improve sourcing processes and standards that can scale across markets, mentoring team members and sharing best practices as the programme expands.

A day in the life
You begin by reviewing supplier pipeline data and checking progress on open negotiations. Mid-morning, you join a call with an OEM partner in the MENA region to walk through your commercial proposal and address their questions. After lunch, you shift focus to the Fleet Exchange Marketplace, following up with a prospective rental supplier in Italy to move them through onboarding. Later, you pull together a sourcing recommendation for leadership, pressure-testing your assumptions with a colleague from the capacity planning team before finalizing.

About the team
The Sourcing team sits within the Fleet Strategy and Supply Chain organization, part of Global Fleet and Products at Amazon. We own supplier engagement for the fleet that powers last mile operations across EU and MENA, spanning branded fleet sourced through OEM relationships and variable fleet sourced through a growing ecosystem of rental suppliers. Our closest partners include capacity and fleet planning, supply chain, vehicle engineering, and electrification. We are preparing the fleet model for the next generation of transportation — new vehicle form factors, micromobility, and expansion into new markets — and we are looking for people who want to help build that future.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or above in engineering, project management, operations, logistics, supply chain or related field
- Experience handling multiple competing priorities and complex projects with multiple stakeholders (e.g. definition of accurate network expansion plans, vendor development, quality assurance, design and cost improvement, team and stakeholder engagement)
- Experience in negotiations with global suppliers with a proven track record in cost reduction
- Experience communicating complex information and solutions to senior stakeholders and influencing decisions
- Experience performing ad hoc analysis using advanced Excel, or experience communicating complex information and solutions to senior stakeholders and influencing decisions
- AI fluency — comfortable using AI tools to accelerate analysis, research, and day-to-day workflows, with the judgment to apply them effectively to sourcing problems.

Preferred qualifications

- Speak, write, and read fluently in French
- Speak, write, and read fluently in Italian
- Speak, write, and read fluently in Spanish
- Experience working in an operations, supply chain, transportation, project management or management consulting role
- Experience in logistics

title: Visual Presentation Designer, Prime Video Experience Design
descriptionHtml:
We are searching for a visual presentation designer to create presentations and other visual assets for Prime Video events and leadership support.

Key job responsibilities
● Develop and deliver engaging presentation materials that convey complex information simply and attractively
● Collaborate with Prime Video Leadership and cross-functional teams to integrate insights into cohesive visual stories
● Implement efficient processes for the intake and prioritization of creative work, including pitch decks
● Coordinate project delivery with various stakeholders to ensure availability of presentation materials and resources
● Produce designs and assets for diverse presentations, maintaining high standards and brand consistency
● Assets and presentations may be used for org-wide meetings, employee engagement programs, internal and external conferences and PR events (e.g. Prime Video Engage, Media Tours)


A day in the life
You start your morning untangling an ambiguous creative brief for an upcoming Prime Video townhall, structuring it into a workable design approach and syncing with leadership and cross-functional partners to align on the visual story. By midday you're deep in production, building polished slides and assets in PowerPoint and Figma, pulling from the team's shared template library while using AI-assisted tools to speed up iteration and validating every output against brand and accessibility standards. In the afternoon you present your work in a design review, voice a trade-off on fidelity versus timeline clearly, and commit to the path forward so the materials are ready and on-brand for the event.

About the team
You'll join a group of design practitioners who help each other develop and thrive. You will have a manager and colleagues that care about you, your career, and your skills development and you'll be expected to do the same for your team. You will have autonomy and ownership while contributing to the supportive culture of the group. We gather often to collaborate, ask questions, and grow together, so bring your unique skills and experience and be prepared to share, learn, and grow with us.
Prime Video is a first-stop entertainment destination offering customers a vast collection of premium programming in one application available across thousands of devices.

- 4+ years of design experience

title: Operations Manager
descriptionHtml:
Job summary
Our WW Operations network delivers millions of packages and smiles to Amazon customers every day. We are looking for motivated, customer-focused individuals who want to join our team as an Operations Manager. In this role, you will lead and develop a team of salaried and hourly talent. You will be responsible for engaging your team during their shifts to maintain the highest levels of safety, quality, attendance, and performance. You will also play a key role in maintaining our customer expectations to ensure customer orders are delivered at the right time, to the right location.

Our Operation’s workflow has three major components: First mile - where the product is housed and ready for order; Middle mile - where the order is hauled to your area; and Last mile - when the product is delivered to the customer’s door. Please note that all workflows have slight building variations, but one thing is constant: our vision and dedication to the customer.

- Lift up to 49 pounds and frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach

- Work in an environment where the noise level varies and can be loud

Our fulfillment network launches new Operations sites every year, providing various opportunities for your professional growth. We hire Operations Managers based on location preference and the business’ current openings.

title: Security Engineer I, AWS Proactive Security Team
descriptionHtml:
Are you passionate about protecting systems and data at massive scale? As a Security Engineer I at Amazon, you will help safeguard the applications and infrastructure that millions of customers rely on every day. In this role, you will work alongside experienced security engineers to identify and reduce security risks, conduct threat analysis, and contribute to building secure solutions. You will gain hands-on experience across security domains while making a meaningful impact on customer trust and the overall security posture of the services you support.

Key job responsibilities
- Analyze software and services to identify security requirements, model threats, and pinpoint potential vulnerabilities across your team's scope of responsibility.
- Conduct security code reviews to evaluate source code for vulnerabilities, weaknesses in implementation, and deviations from secure coding practices, recommending specific remediation strategies.
- Contribute to runbooks, automation scripts, and security tooling that improve your team's ability to detect and respond to security issues at scale.
- Collaborate with development teams and peers to embed security into the software development lifecycle, from design through testing and deployment.
- Communicate security risks clearly in written and verbal form to your team, partner teams, and direct leadership, driving actionable outcomes.

A day in the life
Your morning might start by reviewing the results of a recent security assessment and triaging findings with your team. After standup, you could spend time performing a code review for a partner team's new service, flagging areas where input handling needs strengthening. In the afternoon, you might update a runbook based on lessons learned from a recent incident, or write a script to automate a repetitive security check. You will regularly connect with development engineers and more senior security engineers to discuss design decisions and learn new approaches.

About the team
Our team is focused on reducing security risk across Amazon's products and services, ensuring that customers can trust the systems they interact with every day. We work closely with engineering teams to promote secure development practices and build preventive and detective controls. We value curiosity and continuous learning, and we are committed to creating an inclusive environment where every team member's perspective strengthens our security mission.

Diverse Experiences
Amazon Security values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why Amazon Security?
At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon’s products and services. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores.

Inclusive Team Culture
In Amazon Security, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Ongoing DEI events and learning experiences inspire us to continue learning and to embrace our uniqueness. Addressing the toughest security challenges requires that we seek out and celebrate a diversity of ideas, perspectives, and voices.

Training & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, training, and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

Amazon's mission is to be Earth's most customer-centric company, and Amazon Freight exemplifies this commitment. As a shipping service provider supporting small and large businesses, we offer competitive rates and delivery speeds without compromising on customer obsession. The Amazon Freight team drives strategic innovation to transform the shipping experience for our business partners. We leverage Amazon's core strengths in logistics excellence, flexible delivery options, and end-to-end visibility to create competitive advantages for our shippers. We play a critical role in listening to shippers and escalating pain points, enabling Amazon to improve and deliver world-class service while building a scalable and profitable network that brings value to both our customers and Amazon. Our team's dedication to service reliability and innovation directly supports our global tenets of maximizing existing technology while providing value-based pricing that works for shippers and Amazon alike.

As an Amazon Freight Ops Associate in San Jose, Costa Rica (CRI), you will support the Amazon Freight Billing & Payments (B&P) team by reviewing invoices and billing information to ensure charges are accurate and match agreed-upon rates. You will handle shipper billing inquiries, process billing and payment requests, and assist with day-to-day operational tasks that ensure a seamless billing and payments experience. You will work under the guidance of senior team members to resolve billing disputes, invoicing issues, and payment discrepancies, maintain accurate records, and contribute to the team's overall performance goals.


Key job responsibilities
- Review invoices and billing information to ensure charges are accurate and match agreed-upon rates, flagging discrepancies for correction

title: Commissioning Engineer, AWS Commissioning, AMER-West
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Are you experienced in Critical Infrastructure Commissioning and looking for a fast paced environment to work in? As a Data Center Commissioning Engineer (CxE), you will be part of highly creative, efficient team tasked with tackling fascinating and challenging problems building and supporting the operations of Amazon owned data centers. The Amazon Commissioning team (ACx) understands, evaluates, defines and manages the expectations of construction quality in accordance to engineering designs to meet the customer requirements. The CxE is responsible for supporting vendors, contractors, and other teams involved in the construction and commissioning of various systems such as:

-Medium and low voltage power systems
-Generators
-UPS
-HVAC (Air Handlers / Exhaust Fans / VFD)
-Chilled Water Systems
-Building Management systems (BMS)
-Electrical Power Monitoring Systems (EPMS)
-Testing and balancing
-Pumps and Hydronic systems

Physical Requirements
Walk job sites in uneven terrain
Work at heights and from ladders
Regularly walk, use hands and fingers, reach with hands and arms, stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl
Lift and/or move up to 49 pounds; and participate in group lifts for 50 pounds or more
Carry objects weighing up to 49 pounds for short distances
Work shifts longer than eight hours in duration with potential for night and weekends
Perform physical tasks throughout the day without becoming overly tired
Ability to manipulate small wires and objects easily
Work in a noisy environment
Work in environments that are colder or hotter than a normal office environment

Additional Job Requirements
· Ability and willingness to travel domestic and internationally for up to 80% of the year.
· Required to provide personal transportation for meetings and job visits away from the office; reimbursed.
· US Citizenship required

Key job responsibilities
The Commissioning Engineer (CxE) provides testing and validation oversight of AWS data center electrical and mechanical infrastructure. CxEs review design documents, lead Factory Witness Testing (FWT), and manage third-party commissioning vendors in the performance of onsite pre-functional, functional, and integrated systems testing. They take Ownership of their projects’ successes by Diving Deep to resolve technical issues and having Bias for Action to address everchanging schedule and coordination demands onsite. Additionally, CxEs communicate lessons learned and continuously collaborate on program improvements.

The CxE shall provide multi-discipline input into the scheduling, test script development, designing, and planning of projects. In addition, the CxE will be required to review component submittal packages, lead Factory Witness Testing (FWT), perform system level and integrated system testing. During commissioning the CxE will continuously audit activities to ensure compliance with environmental, quality, and safety requirements. Additionally, the individual will be responsible for comprehensive weekly reporting of status of all ongoing projects and lessons learned to continually improve the quality of our program. This position will include coverage of multiple inflight projects and tight timelines.

A day in the life
On a typical project, the CxE works across AWS engineering, capacity delivery, operations, and contractor teams to coordinate site activities, prioritize tasks, and ensure each issue has clear path to resolution. title: Duales Studium - Automation Engineer
descriptionHtml:
Du möchtest verstehen, wie Roboter, Sensoren und automatisierte Anlagen zusammenspielen?

Bei Amazon setzt du dein Wissen direkt in der Praxis ein. Du arbeitest an Anlagen, die Produkte durch eines der komplexesten Logistiknetzwerke der Welt bewegen. Vom ersten Tag an übernimmst du Verantwortung, arbeitest Seite an Seite mit erfahrenen Automation Engineers und siehst den direkten Einfluss deiner Arbeit.

Als Teil von Amazon eröffnet sich dir ein Universum an Möglichkeiten: Zugang zu modernster Technik, vielfältige Karrierewege und ein Umfeld, in dem deine Ideen zählen und du früh gefördert und gefordert wirst.

Während des dualen Studiums besuchst du die Hochschule, um einen Bachelor of Engineering (B.Eng.) mit Vertiefung Automatisierungstechnik zu erwerben. In einem Trainingszentrum erhältst du eine praktische Grundausbildung, und bei Amazon wendest du dein Wissen direkt an, an der Seite von erfahrenen Automation Engineers, die dich fördern und fordern.

Dabei entwickelst du Kenntnisse in Elektronik und Elektrotechnik, Informationstechnik, Programmierung sowie Automatisierungs- und Steuerungstechnik. Gleichzeitig tauchst du in Zukunftsthemen wie Robotik, Smart Systems und IoT ein.

Beginn: 01.08.2027
Standort: Frankenthal
Hochschule: HS Düsseldorf
Ausbildungszentrum: Siemens AG Düsseldorf

Du tüftelst gerne, packst mit an und willst früh Verantwortung übernehmen? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig.

Key job responsibilities
• Hardware Engineering und Konfiguration von Anlagen
• Inbetriebnahme komplexer Infrastruktursysteme
• Arbeit mit Automatisierungssystemen und Prozessvisualisierungen
• Intelligente Fabrikautomation mit Cloud-Konnektivität
• IoT-Anwendungen in der Gebäude- und Anlagentechnik
• Installation elektrischer Einrichtungen
• Prüfung von elektrischen, pneumatischen und hydraulischen Steuerungen
• Zusammenarbeit mit erfahrenen Automation Engineers und technischen Teams an realen Projekten

A day in the life
Deine Ausbildung verbindet Theorie und Praxis von Anfang an. Deine theoretische Ausbildung absolvierst du an der Hochschule sowie in einem Trainingszentrum, während du die praktischen Kenntnisse direkt bei Amazon an deinem Standort erwirbst.

Ein typischer Tag? Du analysierst gemeinsam mit erfahrenen Automation Engineers eine Störung an einer Förder- oder Sortieranlage, tauschst Komponenten aus und bringst das System wieder zum Laufen. An einem anderen Tag konfigurierst du eine Steuerung und nimmst neue Technik in Betrieb. Und dann gibt es die Tage, an denen du an einem Projekt rund um Robotik, Sensorik oder IoT mitarbeitest.

Kein Tag ist wie der andere – mal stehst du an der Anlage, mal suchst du Fehler vor Ort, mal analysierst und optimierst du Systeme am Computer.

Du arbeitest von Anfang an mit erfahrenen Automation Engineers zusammen, lernst von ihnen und übernimmst Schritt für Schritt mehr Verantwortung. Du probierst Dinge aus und lernst Fähigkeiten, von denen du vorher nicht wusstest, dass es sie gibt.

Basic qualifications

- Allgemeine Hochschulreife, Fachhochschulreife / fachgebundene Hochschulreife
- Fließende Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (C1-Niveau)
- Fortgeschrittene Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (B2-Niveau)
- Erste praktische Erfahrungen im Bereich Elektro-/ Automatisierungs-/ Steuerungstechnik oder verwandten Bereichen

Preferred qualifications

- Ausgeprägte Kommunikationsfähigkeit
- Eigeninitiative, Vorbildfunktion und „Hands-on-Mentalität"
- Proaktives Vorantreiben von Veränderungsprozessen und eigenverantwortliche Entscheidungsfindung
- Umgang mit MS-Office (insbesondere Kenntnisse in Excel, Word und PowerPoint)
- Bist du interessiert? Wir freuen uns darauf, von Dir zu hören! Bitte bewirb Dich mit deinen vollständigen Bewerbungsunterlagen auf Deutsch (Lebenslauf, Zeugniskopie – ein PDF mit 5 MB max.). Sollten die Bewerbungsunterlagen nicht vollständig sein, können wir deine Bewerbung leider nicht berücksichtigen! Bitte beachte, dass du im Rahmen des Einstellungsprozesses ein Videointerview über ein externes Tool durchführen musst. Mit der Übersendung Deines Lebenslaufs erklärst Du Dich mit der Speicherung Deiner Daten zum Zwecke der Feststellung der Eignung für dieses und zukünftige Stellenangebot/e in der weltweiten Amazon Konzernpersonaldatenbank, die derzeit in den USA geführt wird, einverstanden.

title: Engineering Operation Technician
descriptionHtml:
Join our dynamic team and become a critical guardian of technological infrastructure! As a Data Center Engineering Technician, you'll play a pivotal role in maintaining the heartbeat of mission-critical technology infrastructure, ensuring seamless operations that power global digital experiences. Your expertise will directly contribute to maintaining an extraordinary 99.999% uptime, keeping the digital world running smoothly and efficiently.

Engineering Technicians are Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting. They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot, Data Center Operation’s Mission Critical Facilities, which includes stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, as well as three phase electrical systems such as: switch gear, UPSs, PDUs, wet cell batteries and associated systems, CRAC, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers/water chemical system, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, & motors.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. title: Sr. Product Manager, Global Compliance, Amazon Compliance Safety Services
descriptionHtml:
Amazon is looking for a Sr. Product Manager to lead compliance product strategy for sellers manufacturing and selling globally from China. You will own the seller compliance experience for the fastest-growing cross-border seller population on Amazon, working directly with Chinese manufacturers, testing labs, certification bodies, and logistics providers to make compliance frictionless for sellers expanding into US, EU, UK, Japan, and beyond.

You will define and execute the product roadmap for compliance capabilities that serve China-based sellers across multiple programs: product safety testing, restricted products documentation, cross-border trade requirements, and regulatory filings. You will work backwards from seller pain points to build experiences where sellers learn their requirements once, test once, and launch globally from day one. This role is based in Shenzhen to be co-located with the seller population, the TIC (Testing, Inspection, Certification) partner ecosystem, and the AGS (Amazon Global Selling) team.

Key job responsibilities
Own the product roadmap for compliance capabilities serving China-origin sellers expanding to global Amazon marketplaces
Partner with local TIC providers (SGS, TÜV, Intertek, Bureau Veritas, domestic Chinese labs) to build integrated testing workflows that reduce seller compliance cost and time
Define requirements for the Forge pilot: consolidated test plans, lab connections, and pre-listing compliance guidance delivered through Seller Assistant
Represent the China seller voice in global compliance product decisions, translating on-the-ground seller friction into product requirements for Seattle-based engineering teams
Work with AGS, Cross-Border, and Global Store teams to identify compliance barriers preventing seller expansion and quantify the GMS opportunity behind each
Drive seller research through direct engagement with manufacturers in Shenzhen, Guangzhou, and Yiwu to validate product assumptions and test prototypes
Own metrics for China seller compliance experience: time to compliance, testing cost reduction, first-time approval rate, and cross-marketplace launch rate
Coordinate with regulatory bodies and industry groups on emerging requirements (EU Digital Product Passport, GPSR, battery regulations) that disproportionately affect China-origin sellers

A day in the life
You start the morning reviewing seller feedback from the latest Forge pilot cohort in Toys, identifying patterns in where sellers get stuck during the consolidated testing flow. By mid-morning you are meeting with a Shenzhen-based TIC partner to negotiate pre-negotiated pricing tiers for the next product category expansion. After lunch you join a weekly sync with the Seattle engineering team to review sprint progress on the Seller Assistant compliance integration, translating seller context from your field visits into prioritized requirements. Late afternoon you draft a product brief for the next China Seller Conference demo, working backwards from a seller who manufactures LED lighting and wants to sell in 9 marketplaces simultaneously. You close the day reviewing cross-border compliance data to identify which requirement gaps are blocking the most GMS for China sellers expanding to EU.

About the team
Amazon Compliance Safety Services (CoSS) builds the systems and experiences that help sellers meet compliance requirements across every Amazon marketplace. Our mission is to make compliance something Amazon handles on behalf of sellers, not something sellers navigate alone. The One Compliance program is unifying the seller compliance experience across product safety, restricted products, cross-border trade, and regulatory filings into a single journey. We are building toward a world where a seller tests once and sells globally from day one. The Shenzhen role is critical because China-origin sellers represent the largest cross-border seller population on Amazon and face the most complex multi-jurisdiction compliance requirements.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of product or program management, product marketing, business development or technology experience
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
- Experience with end to end product delivery
- Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
- Experience as a product manager or owner
- Experience owning technology products

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in influencing senior leadership through data driven insights
- Experience working across functional teams and senior stakeholders

title: Risk Lead Protective Services, Protective Services, Emergency Service Unit (ESU)
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Protective Services' Emergency Services and Global Standards is looking for a highly motivated physical security professional to serve as Risk Lead on the Global Services & Standards team. This is a remote role with about 50% international travel.

The team runs on a Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) model, and this role owns the Risk piece. You'll assess risk in new and existing policies, standards, technology and training across Amazon Security and Amazon's subsidiaries. You'll focus mainly on the support functions ESGS teams provide to their customers and on risks to Amazon employees, operations, assets and data. Your assessments will help senior leaders make informed decisions to protect their portfolios.

What you'll do

Build and lead risk assessments that give senior leaders clear findings they can act on.
Work with Amazon Security, Amazon Corporate Security, Amazon Fulfillment Network Security, subsidiaries and other partners to analyze real-world risk and apply the right physical security controls.
Evaluate new and emerging security technologies and practices that could strengthen Amazon's security.
Lead or support evaluations of physical security measures that Amazon Security is considering.
Help develop, analyze and improve global physical security standards, applying Amazon Global Security Policies and Standards throughout.

About you
You're an experienced security professional who works well with people at every level of the organization. You know physical security principles in depth and how to put them into practice. You have hands-on experience with Crime Prevention Through Environmental Design (CPTED), including its principles, data collection and analysis, how people behave in built environments, and presenting findings in reports and briefings. You consistently plan and deliver high-quality work for internal and external customers.

Key job responsibilities
Build programs driven by data and metrics, and agree on goals, objectives and performance outcomes with business partners.

Create and manage global risk and resilience programs that cover both preparing ahead of time and responding in proportion when incidents happen.
Run analytical deep dives to find vulnerabilities and root causes, and turn the findings into thorough risk reports.

Complete detailed threat and risk assessments, with risk treatment plans and recommendations.

Work with teams across functions to develop standards, procedures and processes that match business needs and help identify and reduce security risks.

Produce risk analysis that feeds reports for Amazon Security's most senior leaders.

Keep up with industry trends and events, and maintain relationships with key industry contacts and manufacturers.

Work independently as a self-starter.

A day in the life
No two days are the same. Some days you'll be traveling to an Amazon site somewhere in the world to run an onsite risk assessment, walking the space and talking with local security teams. Other days you'll work remotely, analyzing data, finding root causes and writing risk treatment plans. You'll work with PS teams, Fulfillment and subsidiary partners to understand their challenges. You'll turn your findings into clear recommendations for senior Amazon Security leaders, and you'll keep up with new security technologies and industry trends.

About the team
About the team R2G2 (Risk, Readiness & Resilience, Governance, and Global Partner Assessments) is part of Global Services & Standards. We're rethinking how we deliver our Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) model to our customers. Our risk programs began with assessments and built a strong foundation.

Now we're ready to expand them to every customer we support. This is a chance to take that foundation, shape where it goes next and see the impact of your work. Join us and help us build!

Diverse Experiences
Amazon Security values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why Amazon Security?
At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon’s products and services. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores.

Inclusive Team Culture
In Amazon Security, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Ongoing DEI events and learning experiences inspire us to continue learning and to embrace our uniqueness. Addressing the toughest security challenges requires that we seek out and celebrate a diversity of ideas, perspectives, and voices.

Training & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, training, and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Information Security, Computer Science, Risk Management, Engineering, Math, Statistics, or a related discipline, or equivalent technology experience
- Experience in an HR, privacy, legal, compliance or risk management role
- Experience owning program strategy, end-to-end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership
- Knowledge of Microsoft Office products and applications at an advanced level

Preferred qualifications

- Experience performing and/or participating in technical assessments in direct support of a major compliance effort (e.g. ISO 27001, ISO 22301, ISO 27701, ISO 9001, PCI, SOC1/SOC 2, HITRUST)
- Experience working with large sets of data and deriving practical insights

As a SysDE III on the NPI team, you will embed with Hardware Development programs from the Alpha phase to influence controls and system architecture *before* solutions are built. Rather than fixing deployment and reliability problems in the field, you will design them out, shaping the automation, firmware, and integration decisions that determine how easily a solution scales across our global network. You are a technical leader who owns the controls architecture of the systems you support, decomposes ambiguous problems into clear workstreams, and partners with Hardware Development, Technical Program Managers, and the Scale and AI teams to deliver solutions that deploy themselves and run with minimal human intervention.

- Embed with NPI programs from Alpha through GA, influencing controls and system architecture for deployability, reliability, and maintainability.

- Build and validate automation and commissioning frameworks (CI/CD for controls code, automated configuration validation, emulators) in partnership with the Scale team.
- Lead reviews of architecture, design, and operations for your solutions, and contribute to reviews of partner-team systems.
- Partner with Hardware Development, TPMs, and the AI team to incorporate self-service deployment and predictive capabilities into solutions from inception.

You work across industrial control platforms (Codesys, Allen-Bradley, Siemens, Beckhoff) and the networked field devices, firmware, and cloud/WMS interfaces. You architect the controls software for a new solution, design reusable control patterns and contribute it to our libraries, write and review structured-text and automation-tooling code, and partner with Hardware to shape a system before it's built. Lead design reviews that surface architectural and scalability risks early, and prototype frameworks, emulators, automated validation, CI/CD for controls code that become the foundation future solutions are built on. You build and engineer solutions that are correct by design.

descriptionHtml:

title: Finance Manager, WW DSP Finance
descriptionHtml:
Amazon's Delivery Service Partner (DSP) program is responsible for delivering packages (and smiles) to households/businesses across the planet. Our finance team closely partners to support this program as part of Amazon's Last Mile delivery business, providing critical decision support and financial planning and analysis. We are seeking a talented Finance Manager to own the financial position on DSP pricing, offers, and program investment for Americas, sizing program investments and delivering the end-to-end financial perspective that enables leadership to make informed decisions on the largest cost levers in the DSP program.

The Finance Manager, DSP Americas, Pricing, Offers & Program Investment, owns rate card economics end-to-end including hourly base rate, seasonal incentives, wage analysis, and route economics, spanning all carriers across US, CA, and LATAM. You will own the financial position on DSP offers and program investments, lead financial analysis for Ignite Live announcements, and provide financial modeling for emerging initiatives and new delivery programs including change management. Core responsibilities include weekly WBR commentary, quarterly and annual planning, seasonal incentive scenario analysis, and OP entitlement sizing, partnering with business and program leadership to inform strategic investments and cost optimization across DSP Americas.

The role operates in an environment where strategy is often undefined, requiring the finance team to build frameworks with minimal predefined operational assumptions. The Finance Manager carries a dual mandate: maintaining rigorous financial controllership on rate card decisions while actively driving cost-to-serve improvement in service of a healthy, sustainable DSP program. These objectives are often in tension, requiring sound judgment to balance immediate cost savings, long-term partner relationship health, DSP and Driver sentiment, and legal compliance risk. The Finance Manager independently partners with senior leaders across multiple organizations to influence strategic decisions, challenge business partner plans, and set financial requirements that hold teams accountable. Strong communication skills and executive presence are essential to influence without authority spanning multiple lines of business.

Key job responsibilities
- Own Americas DSP rate card economics end-to-end including hourly base rate, seasonal incentives, and route and service type level economics

- Own seasonal incentive scenario analysis and financial position for peak and high volume events

- Own the financial position on DSP offers and program investments for Americas

- Deliver weekly WBR commentary and support monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reviews, forecasting, and planning

- Lead financial analysis and data preparation for annual Ignite Live announcements

- Provide financial modeling for emerging initiatives and new delivery programs, establishing measurement frameworks and financial guardrails before scale

- Serve as primary finance liaison and thought leader to DSP Americas Change Management, providing financial sizing, impact assessment, and strategic input

- Partner with senior leaders across multiple organizations to influence strategic decisions and hold teams accountable through data-driven recommendations

- Contribute to the broader Amazon finance community through mentoring, knowledge sharing, and development of best practices

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of tax, finance or a related analytical field experience
- Bachelor's degree in finance, accounting or related field
- 5+ years of dissecting financial data and identifying patterns that support business strategy experience
- 5+ years of contributing to cross-functional initiatives that drive financial performance and strategy experience

Preferred qualifications

- MBA, or CPA
- Experience delivering forecasting, budgeting, and variance analysis, and data interpretation of results
- 6+ years of solving complex business challenges by delivering accurate and timely financial models, analysis, and recommendations that have a proven impact on business (e.g., financial savings, operational improvements, or customer benefits) experience
- Experience working with large-scale data mining and reporting tools (examples: SQL, MS Access, Essbase, Cognos) and other financial systems (examples: Oracle, SAP, Lawson, JD Edwards)

title: Senior Product Manager, Technical, Device Technologies
descriptionHtml:
Device Technologies (DT) provides the infrastructure that lets Amazon's operations teams provision, deploy, and manage the edge devices, robotics, and material-handling equipment they run on. We build the connectivity, observability, and scale underneath them, so builder teams can bring their hardware online and keep it running across Amazon's worldwide operations and the deliveries customers depend on. Our products are in use across fulfillment centers, sortation centers, delivery stations, and grocery sites. We're part of Operations Infrastructure Services (OIS), and we're hiring a Senior Product Manager, Technical to own a product in this portfolio and the customer experience that goes with it.

Our job is to make Amazon's frontline technology self-service and dependable. Operators should set up, recover, and manage their own devices without waiting on us, and a device that fails should be back at work in minutes. You'll set the strategy and roadmap for your area, decide which problems matter most, and work backward from the people who run our sites every day: process-path owners, application teams, and site operators. The work is technical and the stakes are operational — when there's a device issue on-site, packages stop moving.

Key job responsibilities
- Own the vision, strategy, and multi-year roadmap for your product area, working backward from the needs of Amazon's operations customers and the economics of running a global fulfillment network.
- Partner with engineering and science teams to shape functional and non-functional requirements, make architecture trade-offs across reliability, scale, and cost, and hold a high bar for the quality of what ships.
- Move DT's core outcomes measurably forward: empowering builder teams to move fast on their own (self-service), returning devices to productive work quickly when they fail (availability), and lowering the cost to serve each site.
- Decide where AI, including agentic and generative capabilities, genuinely improves the product or the speed at which your team builds, and where it adds risk or complexity that isn't worth it.
- Define the metrics that tell you whether the product is working, instrument them, and use site-level data and operator feedback to decide what to build next.

A day in the life
No two days are the same, but most begin with data from the floor. You might start with overnight numbers from a site rollout: adoption, device health, ticket volume, and the questions they raise about what to prioritize next. By mid-morning you're in a design review, pushing engineering on whether a recovery flow holds up under the conditions of a live building. The afternoon is for writing: a PR/FAQ for a capability you want funded, or a document that works through a trade-off you need leadership to weigh in on. You end the day with your partners in operations and the application teams who build on DT, making sure what you're about to ship will land cleanly in the sites that depend on it.

title: Mechatronics & Robotics Tech
descriptionHtml:
About Maintenance at Amazon

Operations is at the heart of Amazon’s business. We are known for our speed, accuracy, and exceptional service. Our buildings deliver tens of thousands of products to hundreds of countries worldwide, every day. Reliability Maintenance & Engineering (RME) are the business partners that work tirelessly behind the scenes to make it all happen. We drive continuous improvement and maintain all of the Robotics and Material Handling Equipment (MHE) to ensure our customers are met with the Amazon smile. Come join us on our journey!

About the Role

As a Mechatronics & Robotics Technician, you will use your skills to support the Operations Maintenance team in repairing and maintaining material handling equipment and pneumatic systems throughout the building. You will have the opportunity to install, maintain, and repair automated packaging and distribution equipment. In addition to developing your skills, you will mentor junior technicians to grow in their roles.

What Do We Offer?

Amazon offers competitive compensation packages including comprehensive healthcare benefits starting on Day 1, matching 401(k) program, and up to 20 weeks of paid parental leave. But wait, there is more: We provide lightweight fire-resistant daily wear and composite toe safety shoes for your safety!

Here is what you can expect with the Reliability & Maintenance Engineering (RME) selection process for Mechatronics & Robotics Technicians: (Timeframe: Approximately 30-days)

Step 1: Congratulations! You successfully submitted your application!

Step 2: Amazon Recruiting will review your application and invite the most qualified candidate to complete a pre-employment assessment.

Step 3: If you meet the role qualifications, you will receive an invitation from Amazon Recruiting (do-not-reply@criteriacorp.com) to begin your Criteria assessment. You have 5 days to complete.

Step 4: Once you successfully meet the pre-employment assessment requirements, you will be invited to complete a video interview. Your video interview invitation will be from HireVue (interviews@hirevue.com) and you will have 7 days to record your interview.

Step 5: Your video interview will be reviewed by the Amazon Hiring Team and you will be notified of next steps via email within 5 business days.





Key job responsibilities
Key job responsibilities include, but are not limited to:
- You will promote a safe working environment by following all safety procedures
- You will complete preventative maintenance routines with proper documentation
- You will troubleshoot electrical and mechanical problems related to all Material Handling Equipment (MHE) which includes belts, motors, photo-eyes, relays, and more
- You will maintain a positive working relationship across all of the Amazon Operations facility
- You must be able to move up to 49lbs, stand and walk during shifts lasting up to 12 hours, climb ladders and gangways safely, and without limitation, as well as perform regular bending, lifting, stretching, and reaching both below the waist and above the head

Please note that while we strive to accommodate employees' preferences for shift assignments, due to operational requirements and scheduling constraints, we cannot guarantee a specific shift assignment.

Basic qualifications

- High school or equivalent diploma

title: Supply Planning Manager, Technology Materials Planning
descriptionHtml:
Amazon's technology supply chain supports a complex and rapidly evolving portfolio of infrastructure, end-user equipment, and technology products across thousands of locations globally. As the business scales, disciplined and responsive supply planning is critical to ensuring material availability, managing inventory investment, optimizing procurement execution, enabling network efficiency, and delivering predictable outcomes for customers.

We are seeking a Manager, Supply Planning to lead the supply planning capability within Supply Chain Planning. This leader will manage a team responsible for developing and continuously improving supply plans across the existing customer business segments, while establishing scalable mechanisms that can support new businesses, products, and fulfillment models.

The successful candidate will build a supply planning organization that combines strong planning fundamentals with data, technology, and automation. This includes improving material requirement plan quality, integrating demand signals with supply constraints and lead times, optimizing network topology through hub-and-spoke and regional distribution strategies, identifying structural sources of supply risk and excess inventory, and partnering with Product, Data, Analytics, and Technology teams to reduce manual planning activity and enable increasingly intelligent supply planning capabilities.

The ideal candidate combines strong supply chain expertise, analytical depth, customer orientation, business judgment, and people leadership. They must be comfortable challenging assumptions, navigating incomplete or conflicting signals, and influencing stakeholders across Supply Chain, Finance, Technology, Operations, Procurement, and customer organizations.

Key job responsibilities
• Lead, coach, and develop a team responsible for supply planning across Launch, KTLO, and Programs.
• Own the end-to-end supply planning mechanism, including material requirement plan (MRP) creation and execution, order management, inventory performance measurement, and continuous improvement.
• Translate demand plans, supply constraints, lead times, funding availability, and inventory positions into executable material requirement plans at the appropriate product, geographic, and time horizons.
• Establish clear accountability for supply inputs and challenge assumptions, overrides, and changes that are not supported by measurable business signals or supply data.
• Define and improve supply availability, inventory health, Days of Cover, excess and obsolescence, order accuracy, and other metrics that distinguish true supply variability from process, data, and system defects.
• Lead capacity planning efforts to ensure supplier and network capacity aligns with demand forecasts, proactively identifying and mitigating capacity constraints across the planning horizon.
• Design and optimize hub-and-spoke distribution and network topology strategies to improve fulfillment speed, reduce transportation costs, and support regional inventory positioning across global sites.
• Partner with Demand Planning and Enterprise S&OP to incorporate demand uncertainty, quantify supply risks, and support scenario and trade-off decisions.
• Develop segmented planning approaches appropriate for different supply patterns, including new site launches, steady-state replenishment, and program-driven procurement, incorporating network optimization principles to determine optimal stocking locations and replenishment flows.
• Partner with Product, Data, Analytics, and Technology teams to automate material requirement plan generation, order validation, exception management, and planner workflows.
• Advance the use of optimization models, machine learning, and AI to improve supply plan quality and reduce dependence on manual reconciliation and judgment.
• Simplify fragmented supply processes and data sources, with a long-term goal of connecting Planning more directly to real-time inventory positions, supplier capacity, network capacity utilization, and procurement execution.
• Build scalable mechanisms that support new products, businesses, regions, and planning paradigms without creating parallel planning processes.
• Communicate supply outlook, inventory risks, capacity constraints, network optimization opportunities, funding gaps, procurement constraints, and recommended actions clearly to senior stakeholders.


A day in the life
In this role, you may begin the day reviewing inventory positions and open order status with your team, determining whether a supply gap reflects a true constraint or a defect in the underlying data or process. You may evaluate hub capacity utilization and assess whether regional inventory positioning is aligned with current demand patterns.

You may work with Demand Planning to understand the implications of a forecast change on the material requirement plan, partner with Procurement to resolve a supplier lead time or capacity issue, or support Enterprise S&OP with scenarios where supply constraints, network bottlenecks, or funding gaps require a broader business decision.

You may also spend time with Product or Technology teams improving how material requirement plans are generated, automating a repetitive planner workflow, optimizing network flows across hub-and-spoke distribution points, or defining how optimization models and AI can augment planner judgment.

The role balances near-term supply performance with the longer-term objective of creating a scalable, technology-enabled supply planning capability where planners spend less time collecting and reconciling information and more time managing supply risk, optimizing network and inventory investment, and improving the quality of the plan.

Basic qualifications

- Experience working cross functionally with tech and non-tech teams
- Experience in team management
- Experience in cross functional project delivery
- Experience in program or project management
- Experience in supply chain
- Experience defining program requirements and using data and metrics to determine improvements

Preferred qualifications

- Experience managing, analyzing and communicating results to senior leadership

You must thrive in high-pressure situations, think like both an attacker and defender, and drive relevant teams to take the right actions in the right time frames to mitigate risks. They also need to balance technical risks against business needs and be able to articulate risks and mitigations to members of leadership at various levels.

You should have a good mix of deep technical knowledge and a demonstrated background in information security. We value broad and deep technical knowledge, specifically in the fields of cryptography, network security, software security, malware analysis, forensics, security operations, incident response, and emergent security intelligence.

This position requires that the candidate selected be a US Citizen and must currently possess and maintain an active TS/SCI security clearance with polygraph.

Key job responsibilities
You should be able to accomplish most of the following:
- Confidently and intelligently respond to security incidents, and proactively consider how to prevent the same type of incidents from occurring in the future.
- Design and coordinate cohesive responses to security events that involve multiple teams across the organization.
- Build security utilities and tools for internal use that enable you and your fellow Security Engineers to operate at high speed and wide scale.
- Ability to communicate effectively at multiple levels of sensitivity, and multiple audiences.
- Recognize, adopt and instill the best practices in security engineering fields throughout the organization: development, cryptography, network security, security operations, incident response, security intelligence.
- Fulfill regular on-call responsibilities.

A day in the life
Your day opens with a scan of overnight security telemetry across GovCloud and U.S. ADC regions, where you triage alerts and pull threads on anything anomalous. When an incident surfaces, you move fast: analyzing logs, running forensics, and coordinating a cohesive response across multiple teams while keeping leadership informed in clear, risk-framed language. Between investigations, you build tooling that lets your fellow engineers detect and respond at greater speed and scale. You weigh technical risk against business needs, instill security best practices org-wide, and share on-call duty. Thinking like both attacker and defender, you protect the infrastructure our national security customers depend on.

About the team
Diverse Experiences
Amazon Security values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why Amazon Security?
At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon’s products and services. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores.

Inclusive Team Culture
In Amazon Security, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Ongoing DEI events and learning experiences inspire us to continue learning and to embrace our uniqueness. Addressing the toughest security challenges requires that we seek out and celebrate a diversity of ideas, perspectives, and voices.

Training & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, training, and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

title: Onsite Medical Representative
descriptionHtml:
Join Amazon’s mission to become Earth’s safest place to work! At Amazon, we’ve set the ambitious goal to become the benchmark of safety excellence across all industries in which we operate. The Amazon Workplace Health & Safety (WHS) team sets the strategic direction to provide resources, best practices, and safe environments to proactively manage the health and wellbeing of our workforce. To support these goals, Amazon is seeking an experienced and dynamic Onsite Medical Representative (OMR) to join our team. In this position, you will work closely with the WHS Site Manager, WHS Specialist, and occasionally the Injury Prevention Specialist (IPS). This includes attending weekly associate safety committee meetings, greeting all new hires for the site or through daily one-on-one interaction. Additionally, the OMR will participate in weekly case management review meetings as necessary.

As an OMR, you will independently assess and administer first aid as well as offer guidance to Amazon Associates (AAs) on both occupational and non-occupational injuries or illnesses. You should be passionate about learning and advocating health and wellness principles to consistently support AAs on a daily basis. You will refer care to outside medical providers as needed, and learn about OSHA regulations, risk, and analysis.

The OMR will function as a part of the larger team onsite, assisting with all first aid needs and support safety operations as needed.

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

Provide first aid support and make referrals to outside medical providers as necessary.
Minimize the AA risk of injury through awareness, education, and proactive engagement.
Maintain all records of care provided to AAs.
Coordinate and maintain the workers’ compensation and return to work programs for AAs with work-related injuries.
Provide daily activity logs and end of shift reports.
Engage with AAs and leadership on operations floor to provide coaching regarding observed at-risk work habits.

Work flexible shifts which could include days, nights, holidays, and/or weekends.

title: Design Verification Engineer, Silicon and Systems Group
descriptionHtml:
As a Design Verification (DV) Engineer, you will be part of an advanced architecture team that is exploring new hardware designs to improve our devices. In this role, you will be responsible for defining the verification methodology and implementing the corresponding test plan for advanced functional blocks. You will participate in the design verification and bring-up of such blocks by writing relevant assertions, debugging code, test benches, test harnesses, and otherwise interacting with the extended team.

You will work closely with multi-disciplinary groups including Product Design, Audio Technology, Computer Vision, Hardware Engineering, and Software Engineering, to architect and implement complex functional block that enable development of world-class hardware devices. In this role, you will:

· Design world class hardware and software
· Communicate and work with team members across multiple disciplines
· Deliver detailed test plans for verification of complex digital design blocks by working with design engineers and architects
· Create and enhance constrained-random verification environments using SystemVerilog and UVM
· Identify and write all types of coverage measures for stimulus and corner-cases.
· Debug tests with design engineers to deliver functionally correct design blocks.
· Close coverage measures to identify verification holes and to show progress towards tape-out.
· Participate in test plan and coverage reviews
· Integrated 3rd party IPs/VIPs and transactors
· Perform IP/SOC bringup in simulation, emulation and prototyping environments

The ideal candidate should have experience with RTL development environments, fluency in modern hardware description languages and verification methodologies. They should have experience verifying complex IP blocks from scratch that have successfully been integrated in SOCs or other such silicon that have been productized in consumer devices. We are looking for a self-driven individual who can work with architects, HW and SW developers and can quickly resolve blocking issues.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or a related field
- Experience identifying bugs in architecture, algorithms, functionality, and performance with strong overall debugging skills
- Experience verifying at multiple levels of logic from IP blocks to SoCs to full system testing
- Experience using multiple verification platforms: UVM test bench, FPGA, emulator, software environments, and system testing
- Experience with test plan development, building the necessary test bench infrastructure, developing tests and verifying the design
- Experience with industry standard tools and scripting languages (Python or Perl) for automation
- Experience in English-language communication skills, both written and verbal
- 7+ years or more of practical semiconductor design verification including System Verilog, UVM, assertions and coverage driven verification.
- Experience defining verification methodologies
- Experience with writing directed/constrained-random tests

Preferred qualifications

- Master's degree in Electrical or Communications Engineering or a related field
- Experience in system-level debugging
- Knowledge of SoC architecture
- Experience with boot-up and bare metal flows for CPU cores
- Strong programming skills in C and scripting skills in Python and/or Perl
- Experience with high performance industry standard IO interfaces like AMBA AXI4, USB, MIPI etc.
- Experience with PCIE Experience with formal verification
- Experience with transaction level modeling Knowledge of FPGA and emulation platforms
