title: Process Engineer, NA SSD Network, Sub Same Day Process Engineering
descriptionHtml:
Amazon is building the next generation software, hardware, and processes that will run the global network of fulfillment centers that move many millions of units of inventory, and ensure that customers get what they want faster than ever. We do this by building automated solutions to handle things that technology does well, while relying on people to handle things that humans do well.

We are constantly innovating in the ways we are automating and accelerating the delivery of products and packages which includes building custom hardware and applying robotics, autonomy, supply chain optimization, machine learning, manipulation, image processing, and real-time data processing using distributed systems.

Sub Same Day (SSD) Engineering is looking for a Senior Process Engineer with a strong delivery record and proven project management experience to own strategic and tactical, cross-functional operations and technology projects associated with (SSD) facilities.

As a Process Engineer for Amazon, you will work with some of the most talented engineers in the design, development, and delivery of physical distribution systems around the globe.

You will lead initiatives and complex cross-functional projects or programs that focus on the building of new, the alteration of existing, and the closing of end-of-life material handling and technology systems. As a working leader, you are able to take the lead on the implementation and delivery of large system designs and advanced technology in ambiguous and complex problem spaces.

You integrate systems for safety, security, stability, and efficiency. You participate in the full system development life cycle, working within broadly defined parameters, including test plan execution and solution quality needs.

You must be responsive, flexible, and able to succeed within an open collaborative environment. Amazon’s culture encourages innovation and expects engineers to take a high-level of ownership in solving complex problems.

If you are a leader with enhanced focus on Quality, strong problem-solving skills, excellent communication skills, an ability to influence business and technical leaders in a dynamic environment with the desire to contribute to Amazon's next generation fulfillment technology, this opportunity is for you.

Joining our team provides the unique challenge and opportunity to deploy systems that benefit millions of customers.

The ideal candidate will draw upon exemplary leadership skills, program and project management, critical thinking, and problem-solving capabilities.

The candidate should be open to new tasks, innovative, creative, self-directed and a great team player. Candidate should drive continuous process improvement, and collaborate effectively with cross-functional operational and development teams to solve problems and implement new solutions.

Travel expected between 30% and 50%.


Key job responsibilities
- Design Process: Develop new processes or modify existing ones, focusing on equipment, workflows, and material flow, select and specify equipment required for the process, ensuring it meets productivity goals and safety standards, analyze and optimize existing processes to identify areas for improvement to reduce waste, increase efficiency, and minimize costs.
- Ensure quality and safety: Develop and implement testing methods to ensure product standards, ensure processes adhere to safety regulations and standards, and investigate, resolve issues that may arise.
- Collaboration and Communication: partner/ collaborate with critical stakeholders ensuring safety, quality, and efficiency gains, effectively communicate technical information to stakeholders, including technical and non-technical audiences.
- Monitoring and Analysis: monitor process performance, collect and analyze data for further improvement, leverage data analysis techniques to understand process behavior, trends to make informed decisions.
- Utilize emerging technologies: leverage process simulation tools to model and analyses processes, research and implement new technologies to improve process efficiency and effectiveness.

A day in the life
As a Process Engineer, you will work across organizations to find solutions for complex problems, innovating on behalf of our customers. You will be engaged in tactical and some strategic problem solving and decision-making. You will drive efforts, individually or in collaboration to optimize productivity, prioritizing high impact projects. Your strong communication skills will be required when you present documents and findings to senior leadership. Your experience in conducting root cause analysis, will help in implementation of long-term solutions. You will be traveling (upto 50%) to sites to ensure practical outcomes match theoretical ones.

- 5+ years of industrial engineer, operations engineer, manufacturing engineer, or project engineer in a manufacturing environment experience
- 3+ years of maintenance or engineering experience

- Experience in material handling equipment (MHE) or automation environments, or experience in reliability/maintenance environments
- Experience leading cross-functional teams across engineering, operations, and field execution through launch readiness and go-live phases

title: Engineering Operation Technician
descriptionHtml:
Join our dynamic team and become a critical guardian of technological infrastructure! As a Data Center Engineering Technician, you'll play a pivotal role in maintaining the heartbeat of mission-critical technology infrastructure, ensuring seamless operations that power global digital experiences. Your expertise will directly contribute to maintaining an extraordinary 99.999% uptime, keeping the digital world running smoothly and efficiently.

Engineering Technicians are Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting. They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot, Data Center Operation’s Mission Critical Facilities, which includes stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, as well as three phase electrical systems such as: switch gear, UPSs, PDUs, wet cell batteries and associated systems, CRAC, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers/water chemical system, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, & motors.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

NOTE: Amazon does not sponsor for immigration, including for H-1B, TN, and other non-immigrant visas, for this role.
NOTE: Lump sum stipend will be provided to eligible candidates who relocate for this position.


Key job responsibilities
- Daily building rounds to monitor and record information from electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment to ensure 24/7 reliability and availability
- Monitor Building Management Systems (BMS) and Electrical Power Management System (EPMS)
- Assist in troubleshooting of facility and rack-level events within internal Service Level Agreements (SLA)
- Perform rack installs and rack decommissioning within internal SLA
- Perform PM, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and repair of electrical and mechanical equipment
- Technical writing to support change management program
- Monitor daily work requests and manage to resolution, and execute projects from conception to completion
- On-site support of contractors, sub-contractors and vendors, ensuring that all work performed is in accordance with established practices, procedures & local legislation
- Work schedule changes depending on specific site needs. Shifts can be up to 12 hours and may rotate on a predefined schedule. Some locations have on-call rotations.
- Role may support more than one location/site.

Physical Requirements:
- Willingness and demonstrated ability to work in the following physical conditions with reasonable accommodations:
- Regularly lift and/or move up to 39 pounds independently
- Participate in group lifts for 40+ pounds
- Maintain balance and perform construction tasks while on a ladder
- Regularly walk, use hands and fingers, handle or feel, reach with hands and arms, stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl, climb stairs, twist, bend, work above shoulders, grasp, carry, push and pull objects into position
- Work in an environment requiring provided ear protection

This role supports data centers in various operational stages. The position may be assigned to a facility still under development, which could require travel to established locations for training until your designated site becomes fully operational.

Essential Requirements:
- Ability to travel to or commute between data center locations as needed
- Willingness to temporarily work at alternative sites during training periods or until assigned facility is operational
- Travel frequency will vary based on business needs and operational status of assigned facility

Candidates must be able to travel (over 50 miles) or commute (less than 50 miles) to active data center sites as required by business needs

A day in the life
This role acts as Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment preventative maintenance (PM) and troubleshooting, reporting to a site’s Data Center Facility Manager (FM). They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot mission-critical data center facility equipment including stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, 3 phase electrical systems such as switchgear, UPS units, PDUs, and wet cell batteries and associated systems. Mechanical equipment includes CRAHU units, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers, water systems, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, and motors. Additional support equipment is included in the scope of the role which includes fire/life safety equipment, building automation systems, and general facilities equipment.

- 1+ years of electrical facilities maintenance, or 1+ years of mechanical facilities maintenance experience
- 1+ years of Microsoft Office products and applications experience
- Work flexible schedule including weekends, nights, and holidays

Preferred qualifications

- 2+ years of data center engineering experience
- Experience reading and writing procedures, technical documents, and engineering drawings

title: Senior Forward Deployed Engineer (Model Customization and Optimization)
locations: East Palo Alto, CA, United States
descriptionHtml:
As a Senior Forward Deployed Engineer (Senior FDE) on the Custom Model and Optimization team, you are the technical lead embedded inside a strategic customer, accountable for building, optimizing, and running the custom generative AI models at the heart of their business. You set the technical direction for model customization and optimization engagements, deciding what to build, how to measure it, and how it reaches production. You combine the technical depth of an AWS senior engineer with the urgency of a startup builder, using your judgment and ownership to deliver measurable business outcomes in quality, latency, and cost.

Senior FDEs work on the hardest problems where models meet systems: building domain foundation models, post-training frontier-scale open-weight models with reinforcement learning, and migrating large training and inference workloads onto AWS Trainium. They take on problems where the business problem itself is ambiguous, define the approach, and break it into workstreams others can own. They make long-term architectural trade-offs, balance customer urgency against sustainable design, and are trusted by customer engineering leadership as a technical peer. They raise the bar for the team through design reviews, code reviews, mentorship, and hiring, and they shape how AWS builds.

Key job responsibilities
Lead the technical engagement: Embed with the customer as the technical lead for their model customization and optimization program, spanning multiple workstreams. Partner with customer engineering and product leadership to frame the business problem, define success metrics and the evaluation bar, and set technical roadmap that moves from proof of value to production. Communicate trade-offs, risks, and results clearly to executives and engineers alike. Requires up to 25% travel.

Define the customization strategy: Decide the right path to the customer's quality, latency, and cost targets — prompting, distillation, supervised fine-tuning, preference optimization, reinforcement learning (including RL with verifiable rewards and multi-turn agentic RL), continued pre-training, task-specific adapters, or building a domain foundation model. Own the data strategy, synthetic data generation, and evaluation methodology that make those decisions defensible, and drive them to production for patterns such as coding agents, vertical foundation models, and multi-adapter serving.

Architect training and inference systems at scale: Design distributed training and RL post-training systems for large dense and mixture-of-experts models using frameworks such as PyTorch FSDP2, Megatron-LM, Miles, and verl, and production inference architectures using engines such as SGLang and vLLM. Architect RL interaction harnesses using frameworks such as NeMo Gym and OpenEnv, defining how agent workflows, tools, environments, and reward functions connect to training and evaluation. Set parallelism, precision, and serving strategies that balance throughput, latency, memory, reliability, and cost per token, and ensure the designs hold up under production load.

Lead optimization on AWS AI chips: Lead migrations of training and inference workloads to AWS Trainium using the AWS Neuron SDK. Diagnose performance and accuracy-parity gaps against GPU baselines, direct kernel-level optimization where it matters, and work with AWS Neuron and service teams to close capability gaps. Turn benchmark evidence into recommendations that shape customer infrastructure and capacity decisions.

Lead, mentor, and raise the bar: Provide technical leadership to a team of FDEs and scientists on the engagement, breaking ambiguous problems into well-scoped workstreams and unblocking others. Mentor FDE IIs on model systems design and production ownership. Lead design reviews, provide high-judgment code review, and actively participate in hiring and interviewing.

Multiply impact across AWS: Identify patterns across engagements and turn them into reusable fine-tuning recipes, evaluation frameworks, benchmarking tools, and reference architectures adopted by other teams. Influence the roadmaps of AWS services, including Amazon Bedrock, Amazon SageMaker AI, and AWS Neuron, with field evidence. Identify and shape opportunities to expand model customization and optimization within your customer and across similar customers.

Oversee engagement execution: Own the delivery plan, set milestones, track progress against deadlines, and ensure the quality and completeness of all deliverables. Hold yourself and the team accountable for commitments made to the customer, escalate risks early, and adjust scope or resources when timelines are at risk.

About the team
Team

The Custom Models & Optimization team, part of the AWS Forward Deployed Engineering team, partners with enterprises, AI-native startups, and foundation model providers to build, customize, and optimize generative AI models at scale. Our work spans domain foundation models, post-training of open-weight models, and moving training and inference onto AWS Trainium. As embedded engineers within the AWS Forward Deployed Engineering motion, we bring deep model and optimization expertise to customers' most strategic AI workloads, and we turn what we learn into tooling and patterns that scale across AWS.

ABOUT AWS:

Diverse Experiences
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
 
Why AWS
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud. 

Inclusive Team Culture
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship and Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

- 5+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 5+ years of programming with at least one software programming language experience
- 5+ years of leading design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team
- Hands-on experience training, fine-tuning, or optimizing deep learning models
- Experience communicating technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences, including senior leadership

Preferred qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
- 2+ years of experience deploying and operating ML models in customer production environments, working with teams that build and scale end-to-end production systems
- Experience defining evaluation strategy and building evaluation frameworks or benchmarks for generative models
- Experience leading optimization of model training or inference for latency, throughput, or cost, using serving engines such as SGLang, vLLM, or TensorRT-LLM, on AWS Trainium (Neuron SDK), on AWS services such as SageMaker AI, SageMaker HyperPod, or EKS, or by writing custom kernels (CUDA, Triton, NKI)

- Experience leading large-scale distributed training of LLMs, including mixture-of-experts models, on multi-node accelerator clusters, using frameworks such as PyTorch FSDP2, TorchTitan, Megatron-LM/Megatron Core, NeMo, DeepSpeed, or NeuronX Distributed

title: Data Engineer II (1 Year FTC), Supply Chain Optimization Technologies - Planning
descriptionHtml:
**This is a 1 Year FTC contract**

Are you passionate about building data solutions that power decisions at massive scale? As a Data Engineer II at Amazon, you will design, build, and optimize data architectures that turn raw information into reliable, high-quality datasets used by analysts, scientists, and engineering teams. You will work across the full data lifecycle — from ingesting and transforming semi-structured data streams to creating logical data models that drive physical design and enable self-service analytics. This role offers the opportunity to solve complex data challenges, improve how teams discover and trust their data, and directly influence business outcomes through the systems you create.

Key job responsibilities
- Design and implement ETL workflows and data pipelines that extract, transform, and load data at scale, ensuring stability, performance, and efficient resource usage across distributed systems and cloud infrastructure.
- Create and maintain logical and physical data models that accurately represent business requirements, enforce data integrity, and support downstream analytics and reporting needs.
- Write clean, well-documented code using SQL and scripting languages to automate data processes, optimize query performance, and build tools for tracking data lineage and improving data quality.
- Collaborate with analysts, scientists, and software engineers to understand data requirements, balance competing priorities, and deliver usable datasets that provide clear business value.
- Participate in code reviews, design discussions, and operational excellence initiatives, contributing to continuous improvement of team data solutions while mentoring peers on system architecture and best practices.

A day in the life
You will start your day reviewing pipeline health dashboards and resolving any data quality issues before they reach downstream consumers. From there, you might pair with a scientist to refine a data model, write and optimize SQL queries for a new reporting dataset, or evaluate a generative AI tool to accelerate a repetitive transformation task. Afternoons often include design reviews with your team, where you propose improvements to existing architectures or troubleshoot production incidents at their root cause.

About the team
Our team is focused on building reliable, scalable data infrastructure that empowers teams across Amazon to make faster, better-informed decisions. We value collaboration, technical curiosity, and a commitment to simplifying complex systems. As we continue to grow, you will have the opportunity to shape the tools and processes that define how data is managed and consumed. If you are excited about working in an inclusive environment where your ideas directly influence how we build for the future, we would love to hear from you.

Basic qualifications

- Experience in data engineering
- Experience with data modeling, warehousing and building ETL pipelines

- Experience with AWS technologies like Redshift, S3, AWS Glue, EMR, Kinesis, FireHose, Lambda, and IAM roles and permissions
- Experience with non-relational databases / data stores (object storage, document or key-value stores, graph databases, column-family databases)

descriptionHtml:
Als Nachwuchsführungskraft wirst du in unserem 11-wöchigen internen Onboarding Programm auf deine neue Aufgabe als Führungskraft vorbereitet.
Nach dieser umfangreichen Einarbeitung übernimmst du Führungsverantwortung für dein eigenes Team und sorgst dafür, dass unsere Kunden Ihre Waren pünktlich und in guter Qualität erhalten. In dieser Position bist du wichtiger Teil unseres globalen Unternehmens und arbeitest Hand in Hand mit deinen Mitarbeitenden vor Ort. Zudem arbeitest du standortübergreifend an Themen wie Arbeitssicherheit, Prozessoptimierung, Nachhaltigkeit und technischem Fortschritt.

Key job responsibilities
- Sicherstellung der Einhaltung der Arbeitssicherheitsvorschriften und des Umweltschutzes
- Ableitung von Handlungsempfehlungen und konkreten Maßnahmen zur Prozessverbesserung auf Basis von Kennzahlen wie Arbeitssicherheit, Produktivität und Qualität
- Leitung und Weiterbildung eines Teams (bis zu 100 Mitarbeitende)
- Planung und Steuerung der innerbetrieblichen Prozesse
- Teilnahme in übergeordneten Projekten zur Optimierung der Kundenzufriedenheit
- Effektives Ressourcen- und Workflowmanagement
- Zusammenarbeit mit den vor- und nachgelagerten Abteilungen vor Ort

A day in the life
Du arbeitest in einer unserer Schichten (Früh-, Spät- oder Nachtschicht). Dabei ist das Einhalten der Sicherheitsstandards an deinem gesamten Standort für dich höchste Priorität. Als Schichtleitung führst du routinemäßig Teammeetings durch und führst Feedbackgespräche mit deinen Mitarbeitenden und deinen Stakeholdern. Mit Hilfe von Datenauswertungen nimmst Du Einfluss auf die Produktivität und die Qualität deines Standortes. Als wichtiges Mitglied des Teams vor Ort arbeitest Du mit anderen Abteilungen, sowie externen Stakeholdern zusammen und sorgst dafür, dass wir die Anforderungen unserer Kundschaft, ebenso wie unsere eigenen Vorgaben jederzeit erfüllen. Durch die Analyse von Daten mit Führungskräften und die Besprechung der betrieblichen Vor- und Nachteile von technischen Verbesserungen mit den Fachabteilungen trägst du zu „best in class“ Lösungen bei.Als wichtiges Mitglied des Betriebsteams arbeitest Du mit Kolleg:innen aus anderen Teams sowie externen Partnern zusammen und sorgst dafür, dass wir die Anforderungen unserer Kund:innen ebenso wie unsere eigenen Vorgaben jederzeit erfüllen. Das beinhaltet die Analyse von Daten und Leistungskennzahlen gemeinsam mit Führungskräften in Deinem Geschäftsbereich ebenso wie die Besprechung der betrieblichen Vor- und Nachteile von technischen Verbesserungen mit dem technischen Team.

About the team
Die Logistikabteilung bei Amazon (AMZL) ist für die „Last-Mile-Logistik“ zuständig – also die Auslieferung unserer Pakete in Partnerschaft mit Drittanbietern. Wir denken kreativ und realisieren Initiativen zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung, um Millionen von physischen Produkten an unsere Kund:innen zu liefern. Unser Ziel ist es, das Liefererlebnis für unsere Kund:innen so reibungslos wie möglich zu machen und globale Lieferlösungen für unsere neuesten Angebote einzuführen, darunter Amazon Fresh, Prime Now und Amazon Restaurants.
Diese Tätigkeiten werden von zwei Mitarbeitergruppen ausgeführt. Unsere „internen“ Mitarbeitenden bereiten Millionen von Produkten auf den Versand an unsere Lieferteams vor. Unser Team ist menschenorientiert und hilfsbereit. Das ist besonders wichtig, weil viele unserer Mitarbeitenden in Nachtschichten arbeiten. Unser Fokus liegt vorwiegend auf dem operativen Betrieb. An den meisten unserer Standorte wird rund um die Uhr gearbeitet.
Unsere „Außendienst“-Mitarbeitenden arbeiten währenddessen mit Amazon Flex – einem Auftragnehmer-Netzwerk für die Lieferung. Jedes Jahr setzen wir neue Maßstäbe in puncto Kundenerlebnis und bieten neue, innovative Lieferdienste an. Wir suchen nach neuen Möglichkeiten, um branchenweite Logistikherausforderungen zu überwinden, sowie nach neuen Ideen, um unseren CO2-Fußabdruck zu reduzieren. Ein Fuhrpark innovativer Fahrzeuge (einschließlich E-Fahrzeugen) und modernste Technologie unterstützen uns dabei.

title: Air Program Manager, AWS Environmental
descriptionHtml:
Join a diverse, dynamic, and enthusiastic team of environmental compliance professionals who play a leading role in air quality permitting and compliance at Amazon Web Services (AWS), where we have a history of leading the world in innovative technologies and services. As a member of the Environmental team, you will support environmental programs aimed at ensuring compliance with air quality regulations and standards in the Americas while also enabling AWS's growth around the world.

As an Air Program Manager, your primary focus will be serving as the air compliance subject matter expert (SME) across an Americas sub-region, providing programmatic oversight and ensuring alignment of compliance practices across all AWS data centers. You will build regional-level compliance infrastructure (frameworks, standards, tools, and visibility) and provide functional direction to the Regional Environmental Engineers (REEs) who execute compliance at their sites. You will work closely with the Environmental team, engineering, operations teams, vendors, and other partners to ensure consistent application of air quality compliance programs, particularly those related to Tier 4 compliant diesel generators. Your role will involve providing technical expertise on local, state, and federal air regulations and creating strategies for continuous improvement in air compliance management. As the team's air compliance SME, you will support REEs across the region to resolve complex air compliance challenges and drive environmental performance. You will also play a key role in standardizing incident response and reporting protocols related to air compliance events.

The successful candidate will have extensive knowledge of air compliance and regulatory requirements in North America, demonstrated ability to develop and standardize complex compliance systems across multiple jurisdictions, and proven experience leading air quality initiatives that drive environmental performance and sustainability. The ideal candidate will excel at providing strategic guidance while maintaining strong attention to technical details and have a track record of successfully collaborating with diverse stakeholders to implement environmental compliance programs at scale.

Key job responsibilities
- Build and lead regional air quality compliance programs, providing standards and functional direction to in-region engineers across North and South America
- Set and maintain the regional framework for compliance with federal, state, and local air quality regulations related to emergency backup power systems
- Ensure compliance with EPA regulations including 40 CFR 60 Subpart IIII (Standards of Performance for Stationary Compression Ignition Internal Combustion Engines)
- Develop and implement air quality monitoring programs and compliance tracking systems for permitted backup power generation (Tier 2/Tier 4 diesel generators, natural gas, etc)
- Establish standardized emissions testing programs and protocols that engineers and testing firms execute at their sites
- Provide technical guidance on air quality compliance requirements
- Support emergency response planning related to air quality incidents
- Collaborate with the air permitting team and in-region engineers to ensure operational compliance with existing permit conditions
- Stay current with evolving air quality regulations and industry best practices for diesel generator management
- Develop and deliver air quality compliance training for relevant staff
- Establish and track key performance indicators (KPIs) for air quality compliance

About the team
AWS Infrastructure Services (AIS) owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain, and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of increasing responsibilities in EHS or environmental programs in manufacturing, production, or service operations experience, or Bachelor's degree
- 5+ years with air permitting and/or compliance experience at local, state, federal levels

Preferred qualifications

- Experience managing multiple projects and priorities across teams in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment
- Experience that includes strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and effective communication abilities
- Experience developing and implementing environmental compliance programs including regulated waste, water, and air regulations in accordance with applicable laws
- 3+ years with engine specific regulations including 40 CFR 63 Subpart ZZZZ and 40 CFR 60 Subpart IIII

title: Senior Product Marketing Manager, Acquisitions, Carrier Services
descriptionHtml:
We are looking for a driven, analytically rigorous Paid Acquisition Senior Marketing Manager to own and scale our paid marketing efforts across both performance and awareness channels. Paid Search (SEM) remains the primary engine of this role, but you will also take ownership of paid awareness channels — including paid social, 3P publications, and event coordination — designed to drive top-of-funnel traffic and brand consideration. As a senior leader, you will manage and develop a team of marketing professionals, setting priorities, coaching talent, and fostering a culture of experimentation and accountability. This is a high-impact, highly visible role sitting at the intersection of data, creativity, and technology, directly influencing Amazon Relay's full-funnel growth strategy.

The ideal candidate brings a performance-first mindset and is equally comfortable steering paid search campaigns, launching paid awareness initiatives, leading deep-dive data analysis, and orchestrating high-visibility events. You will manage a multi-million dollar marketing budget spanning SEM and awareness channels and will be directly accountable for both top-of-funnel traffic volume and brand reach KPIs. You will also serve as the connective tissue between quantitative insights and strategic decision-making — translating complex data into clear narratives that influence roadmaps and investment decisions.


Key job responsibilities
SEM Strategy & Campaign Management
- Own end-to-end strategy, execution, and optimization of paid search campaigns across Google Ads and Microsoft Ads, covering Search, Performance Max, and DSA campaign types.
- Lead keyword research, match-type strategy, negative keyword governance, and ongoing search term analysis to maximize relevance and minimize wasted spend.
- Develop and test ad copy, extensions, and landing page strategies using a structured A/B testing framework to continuously improve Quality Score, CTR, and conversion rates.
- Maintain rigorous campaign architecture — ad groups, campaign hierarchy, and bidding strategies (tROAS, tCPA, Maximize Conversions) — ensuring scalability as budgets and markets grow.
- Manage and optimize a multi-million dollar annual SEM budget, allocating spend across campaigns to hit efficiency targets while scaling acquisition volume.

Paid Awareness Channel Management
- Plan, execute, and optimize paid awareness campaigns across programmatic display, paid social (Meta, LinkedIn, TikTok), online video (YouTube), and 3P industry publications to drive top-of-funnel reach and brand consideration among target carrier audiences.
- Define and track awareness-stage KPIs including reach, frequency, video completion rate (VCR), brand lift, share of voice, clearly separating them from lower-funnel SEM metrics.
- Collaborate with Creative and Product Marketing teams to brief, review, and iterate on awareness ad creative — including display banners, video scripts, and social ad formats — ensuring messaging consistency across all paid touchpoints.
- Analyze the downstream impact of awareness campaigns on SEM performance — including branded search lift, assisted conversions, and overall funnel velocity — to prove awareness ROI and inform future budget allocation between channels.

Event Strategy & Coordination
- Lead the planning, execution, and post-event analysis of industry events, trade shows, conferences, and sponsored activations that support acquisition and brand awareness goals.
- Develop event marketing strategies that integrate with paid and organic campaigns — including pre-event promotion, on-site lead capture, and post-event nurture sequences — to maximize attendee-to-lead conversion.
- Manage event budgets, vendor relationships, and cross-functional logistics in partnership with field marketing, sales, and product teams.
- Define and track event-specific KPIs such as qualified leads generated, cost per lead, pipeline influence, and post-event engagement to measure ROI and inform future event investment.

Team Leadership & People Management
- Directly manage, mentor, and develop a team of marketing professionals across SEM, paid social, and awareness functions — setting clear goals, providing regular feedback, and conducting performance reviews.
- Build a high-performing team culture rooted in data-driven decision-making, creative experimentation, and operational excellence.
- Identify skill gaps and invest in team development through coaching, training, and stretch assignments to grow individual capabilities and bench strength.
- Serve as a senior voice within the broader marketing organization, influencing strategy, advocating for resources, and representing the acquisition function in leadership forums.

Top-of-Funnel Performance & Budget Accountability
- Own and be directly accountable for top-of-funnel KPIs including impressions, clicks, CTR, search impression share, new user acquisition volume, and CPC benchmarks.
- Manage budget pacing across monthly and quarterly cycles, delivering accurate spend forecasts and proactively flagging risks or opportunities to senior leadership.
- Partner with Finance and Marketing leadership to build data-backed business cases for budget investment and growth modeling.
- Establish weekly, monthly, and quarterly performance reporting cadences with clear variance analysis and forward-looking recommendations.

Data Analysis, Insights & Tooling
- Be the hands-on power user of Google Analytics 4 (GA4) — building dashboards, custom reports, funnel analyses, and attribution models to surface actionable SEM and full-funnel insights.
- Conduct deep-dive data analysis across channels to identify trends, diagnose performance shifts, and uncover growth opportunities — translating complex datasets into clear, executive-ready narratives and recommendations.
- Leverage Google Auction Insights to monitor competitive positioning, identify share-of-voice shifts, and inform bidding and budget decisions in real time.
- Utilize Google Ads Search Term Reports, Keyword Planner, and Performance Planner to identify growth opportunities and validate strategy pivots.
- Implement and audit UTM tagging, conversion tracking, and Google Tag Manager (GTM) configurations to ensure data integrity across all paid search activity.
- Work with Business Intelligence and Data Science teams to integrate SEM and event data into broader marketing mix models and multi-touch attribution frameworks.
- Build and maintain cross-channel reporting infrastructure that connects paid media, event, and awareness performance into a unified view of acquisition health.
- Support Business Insights needs of the larger team.

AEO / SEO Collaboration
- Partner closely with SEO and Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) teams to align paid and organic search strategies, ensuring consistent keyword coverage and avoiding cannibalization.
- Apply understanding of AEO principles — structured data, featured snippets, and AI-generated answer optimization — to inform SEM messaging and landing page strategy.


A day in the life
Amazon offers a full range of benefits that support you and eligible family members, including domestic partners and their children. Benefits can vary by location, the number of regularly scheduled hours you work, length of employment, and job status such as seasonal or temporary employment.

The benefits that generally apply to regular, full-time employees include:
- Medical, Dental, and Vision Coverage

title: Lab Engineer II, Global Materials Science
descriptionHtml:
Join Amazon's Global Materials Science (GMS) organization as a Lab Engineer and be part of pioneering sustainable e-commerce packaging. In this hands-on role, you'll conduct materials testing and characterization that directly supports the development of breakthrough packaging materials. You'll work in state-of-the-art laboratories, operating advanced testing equipment, executing experiments, and generating critical data that enables our team to make informed decisions about materials that touch millions of customer experiences daily.

Key job responsibilities
Materials Testing & Characterization:
- Conduct hands-on materials testing using equipment including tensile testers, burst testers, tear testers, rheometers, and other materials characterization tools.
- Execute test protocols following TAPPI, ASTM, ISO, and ISTA standards as well as internal developed methods.
- Perform testing on packaging materials including paper substrates, adhesives, coatings, and alternative fiber materials.
- Operate and maintain laboratory equipment, ensuring proper calibration and functionality
- Prepare test and store specimens according to specifications and standard operating procedures
- Identify, recommend, and help implement improved lab processes for the team. Learning to create mechanisms.

Data Collection & Analysis:
- Collect, organize, and document experimental data with high accuracy and attention to detail.
- Analyze test results and identify trends or anomalies in materials performance.
- Generate clear and concise test reports summarizing findings and observations.
- Support data-driven decision making by providing reliable, high-quality test results

Laboratory Operations:
- Follow standard operating procedures (SOPs) and work instructions for all testing activities
- Maintain a safe, clean, and organized laboratory environment.
- Participate in laboratory safety programs and equipment maintenance schedules.
- Assist in identifying opportunities to improve testing efficiency and data quality.
- Support inventory management of laboratory supplies and test materials

Cross-Functional Support:
- Collaborate with Advanced Materials Engineers and scientists on experimental design and execution.
- Communicate test results, status updates, and any issues or blockers to team members.
- Support supplier qualification activities by conducting materials testing on vendor samples.
- Assist with sample preparation and testing for field trials and deployment validation.
- Participate in team meetings and contribute to project planning discussions.

Documentation & Continuous Improvement:
- Contribute to the development and refinement of test procedures and SOPs
- Document experimental procedures, observations, and results clearly and thoroughly.
- Identify and recommend improvements to testing methods and laboratory processes.
- Learn and apply materials science principles to understand the significance of test results.
- Seek feedback and continuously develop technical skills and domain knowledge.

Work Environment:
- Primarily laboratory-based work with hands-on equipment operation.
- Standard lab safety protocols and PPE requirements.
- Occasional lifting of materials and equipment (up to 50 lbs), standing, walking, kneeling throughout the day.
- Collaborative team environment with regular interaction with scientists and engineers.

A day in the life
Your day starts in the lab preparing test specimens—cutting paper samples to precise dimensions and conditioning them in the environmental chamber. You're supporting a critical adhesive development project, and today's testing will determine if the new formulation meets performance requirements.

Mid-morning, you're running tensile and burst tests on paper samples, carefully following the test protocol and recording data in real-time. The results look interesting—you notice the tear strength is higher than previous samples and flag this for the materials engineer leading the project.

After lunch, you're operating the rheometer to characterize viscosity profiles of new hot melt adhesive samples from three different suppliers. You meticulously document the temperature ramps and flow behavior, knowing this data will directly inform sourcing decisions.

Your afternoon includes calibrating equipment, organizing test data into clear summary reports, and preparing samples for tomorrow's environmental conditioning tests. You also participate in a team meeting where you present your week's testing results—your data shows one supplier's material consistently outperforms the others.
This is hands-on work that matters. The tests you conduct today generate the data that enables breakthrough materials innovations, supports major procurement decisions, and ultimately improves packaging for millions of customers while advancing Amazon's sustainability goals.

The Global Materials Science (GMS) organization is Amazon's Center of Excellence for packaging materials development and supply chain transformation. Our team represents a fundamental shift in how Amazon approaches packaging innovation—owning the invention, development, and optimization of materials that power our fulfillment network.

Our Mission: We build deep expertise in packaging materials through rigorous research and testing, develop innovative packaging solutions that unlock automation potential and sustainability improvements, and establish robust supply chains that deliver superior solutions at lower cost.

Our Vision: To be the global leader in e-commerce packaging materials science and innovation, enabling the best customer packaging experience at the lowest cost to serve.

What Makes Us Unique: We're not just specifying materials—we're fundamentally understanding them through the materials science triangle framework (processing, structure, properties). Our integrated capabilities span from molecular-level materials characterization, to full packaging system testing, to automation compatibility testing. This end-to-end ownership enables us to innovate faster, unlock step-change improvements previously thought impossible.

Our Impact: We're driving Amazon's transition from plastic to paper packaging, developing breakthrough materials and establishing supply chains that reduce costs while advancing our 2040 net-zero commitment. Our work directly influences automation success, customer experience, and sustainability metrics.

Our Culture: We operate with high technical rigor while moving at startup speed. We embrace calculated risk-taking in R&D, fail fast, and iterate based on data. We believe in radical collaboration—our success requires seamless partnership across engineering, procurement, operations, and sustainability teams. We value both technical excellence and the ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.

Our Team: We bring together materials scientists, chemists, engineers, lab technicians, and program managers who are passionate about solving hard problems. We partner with world-class academic institutions, leading materials suppliers, and internal Amazon teams to push the boundaries of what's possible in packaging materials.

Basic qualifications

- 2+ years of hardware development, test lab, space/aerospace maintenance or hands-on engineering environment experience
- Bachelors Degree or higher in Material Science, Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Paper Science Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or related field.

Preferred qualifications

- Master's degree in Materials Science, Materials Engineering, Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, paper science engineering or related technical discipline
- 2+ years of laboratory experience in materials testing, quality control, or research environment
- Experience with packaging materials or other forest products testing (paper, adhesives, coatings, or polymers) following standard test methods (TAPPI, ASTM, ISO, ISTA, etc.)
- Hands-on experience with testing equipment such as tensile testers, burst testers, thermal analysis equipment, SEM, DMA, etc. and experience with data analysis tools and statistical methods

title: Senior Financial Analyst, AWS Regions Finance
descriptionHtml:
Join our team as a Senior Financial Analyst to support the fast-growing AWS Dedicated Cloud business. As part of the Regions Finance team, you'll drive strategic financial planning and analysis for AWS Infrastructure. This role offers the unique opportunity to own CAPEX planning for an entire region, with visibility across the entire P&L. You'll leverage your financial expertise to influence leadership business decisions and support long-term growth initiatives. This role works to understand the financial impact of high-level business trends (such as customer adoption, GenAI capacity planning, etc.) and synthesize insights to provide the business strategic financial analysis.

Your strong problem-solving skills and leadership communication will be essential as you partner with senior leadership to develop financial frameworks that enable data-driven decision making. You'll analyze complex data sets, identify strategic opportunities, and provide valuable insights that shape the direction of the business. This role is ideal for a finance professional looking to develop into a general finance manager with significant business impact.

Key job responsibilities
- Own financial reporting for AWS Public Sector infrastructure, developing analyses and narratives that support operational and growth business decisions with senior leadership

- Build and maintain comprehensive financial models to support CAPEX analysis to drive strategic long-term value

- Communicate frequently and effectively with business leaders, using timely and accurate financials to help make business decisions

- Independently align financial and operational analyses with business partners, challenging assumptions when necessary and providing recommendations that influence data-driven decision making.

- Identify opportunities and implement large-scale financial solutions to proactively resolve finance issues, improve scalability, and simplify finance tools and processes across teams.

- Dive deep to ensure reporting accuracy and compliance with internal and external policies while promoting strong controllership principles.


A day in the life
In this dynamic role, you'll find yourself tackling strategic financial problems that directly impact business performance. Rather than following a routine, you'll prioritize what's most important each day—whether that's developing financial models for new initiatives, collaborating with leadership on investment decisions, or analyzing P&L components to identify optimization opportunities. You'll leverage data to influence cross-functional partners and present financial insights that drive meaningful business outcomes.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in business, finance, accounting, tax, economics, or a related analytical field
- 4+ years of applying key financial performance indicators (KPIs) to analyses experience
- 3+ years of finance, accounting, or related analytical field experience
- 4+ years of creating process improvements with automation and analysis experience
- 4+ years of identifying, leading, and executing opportunities to improve, automate, standardize or simplify finance or business tools and processes experience
- Experience with advanced use of SQL for data mining and business intelligence
- Can meet export control requirements by being a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum
- Due to the nature of work performed, this position requires that the selected candidate be able to obtain a Security Clearance and thus be a U.S. citizen.

Preferred qualifications

- 4+ years of participating in continuous improvement projects in your team to scale and improve controllership with measurable results experience
- MBA, or CPA
- Experience working with large-scale data mining and reporting tools (examples: SQL, MS Access, Essbase, Cognos) and other financial systems (examples: Oracle, SAP, Lawson, JD Edwards)

title: Principal Forward Deployed Engineer, AWS Forward Deployed Engineering
descriptionHtml:
A Principal Forward Deployed Engineer (Principal FDE) embeds across multiple strategic enterprise customers to define the technical strategy and engineering standards for AI-powered production systems at scale. Principal FDEs write production-grade software, set the technical direction for complex multi-workstream engagements, and create the reusable architectures, patterns, and engineering mechanisms that scale the entire FDE practice — combining the technical depth of an AWS Principal SDE with the strategic influence required to deliver transformational customer business outcomes.

Principal FDEs independently lead software delivery across an organization. They drive clarity where neither the business problem nor technology strategy is well defined. They solve problems with non-technical solutions such as process improvement, culture changes, or staffing and training. They set the standard for engineering excellence, handle escalations, and drive closure with peers, Directors, and stakeholders. They are force multipliers whose impact extends well beyond any single engagement.

This position requires that the candidate selected must be a US Citizen and currently possess and maintain an active Top Secret security clearance. The position further requires that, after start, the selected candidate obtain and maintain an active TS/SCI security clearance with polygraph or commensurate clearance for each government agency for which they perform AWS work.

Key job responsibilities
Define technical strategy across engagements.
- Set the technical direction for the most complex, highest-stakes customer AI programs. Be a key influencer for strategic decisions, bringing technology and industry context to business decisions. Make architecture decisions that span multiple workstreams, services, and organizational boundaries. Requires up to 25% travel.

Build production AI systems and reference architectures.
- Design and build the foundational architectures — multi-agent orchestration frameworks, enterprise-grade retrieval systems, decision intelligence platforms — that become the template for future engagements. Tackle intrinsically hard problems, acquiring expertise as needed. Solve problems that are significantly complex not only because of technical complexity. Remain hands-on, focusing time on code and code reviews that have the most impact.

Own production excellence at scale.

Accelerate customer transformation at the portfolio level.

Raise the bar for the practice.
- Define engineering excellence standards for the FDE organization. Guide the career growth of the most senior technical talent. Participate in performance evaluations and advocate for the careers of others. Help the Principal Engineering community grow through internal reviews, interviews, and promotion assessments. Represent the FDE practice to AWS VP-level leadership and customer C-suite executives. Drive hiring bar and calibration for the FDE job family.

title: AWS Privacy Counsel
descriptionHtml:
As Privacy Counsel for Amazon Web Services, you'll collaborate with legal teams and business leaders to navigate complex global privacy regulations, build privacy into innovative products, and develop strategies that protect our customers while enabling growth. You'll help shape how one of the world's leading cloud computing companies approaches data protection and privacy.

Key job responsibilities
- Advise AWS business units and product teams on privacy requirements, risk mitigation strategies, and best practices for global privacy laws and regulations
- Develop and maintain privacy governance frameworks, policies, and processes that support organizational compliance and scalability across multiple jurisdictions
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams including product, engineering, and business leaders to integrate privacy considerations into new services, features, and business initiatives
- Monitor and analyze evolving privacy laws and regulatory developments to identify implications for AWS operations and provide strategic recommendations
- Support legal proceedings and engagements on privacy-related matters

A day in the life
Your focus will be on advising AWS teams on privacy compliance and strategy across our global operations. You might spend your morning reviewing a new product feature to identify privacy considerations and recommend safeguards, then shift to drafting guidance on how we'll comply with emerging privacy regulations in multiple jurisdictions. You'll partner with product teams to develop features and services, consult with legal colleagues on legal strategy, and guide business leaders on privacy strategy. Your work spans from tactical compliance questions to longer-term strategic initiatives that shape how we build privacy into our services from the ground up.

About the team
We're a collaborative group of legal professionals dedicated to helping AWS innovate responsibly. Our team works across the entire organization—from product development to customer-facing operations—to ensure privacy is woven into everything we do. We serve customers around the world who depend on AWS to handle their data securely and in compliance with applicable laws. Over the coming years, we're focused on staying ahead of the rapidly evolving global privacy landscape while enabling our business to grow and serve our customers. You'll be instrumental in helping us achieve that balance, working alongside colleagues who are committed to both legal excellence and business impact.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of post bar admission legal experience
- Juris Doctor and membership in one state bar or equivalent
- Experience in written and verbal communication skills to communicate with technical and non-technical audiences, including senior leadership
- 3 + years experience focused on privacy and data protection
- Experience representing organizations on data protection or privacy matters across multiple jurisdictions
- Knowledge of global privacy laws and regulations, including U.S. state laws and GDPR
- Demonstrated experience developing privacy governance frameworks, policies, and compliance processes

Preferred qualifications

- Experience working cross functionally across several teams
- Experience advising on privacy legal issues related to cloud computing services
- Ability to exercise sound judgment in mission-critical projects, working independently and often in ambiguous situations
- Understanding of internet services and applications and related technologies
- Ability to set and drive strategy and provide guidance to business teams

title: Sr. Construction Manager, GES NA, Design and Construction
descriptionHtml:
As a Sr. Construction Manager within Global Engineering Services (GES) North America (NA) Design & Construction (D&C), you are Amazon's senior owner's representative responsible for the autonomous end-to-end delivery of complex construction projects — including large-scale new builds, retrofits, and expansions for sortation centers, delivery stations, and auxiliary buildings that power Amazon's logistics network.

You operate with a high degree of independence, executing day-to-day operations autonomously and routinely delivering the right outcomes with limited guidance — even when project strategy is not yet well-defined. You deliver a mix of tactical and strategic initiatives that impact multiple teams and/or geographies in support of significant business objectives. You own design oversight, external partner selection, contract negotiations, and project procurement — and you are accountable for the full performance of your external project management partners, architects, design consultants, general contractors, and subcontractors.

Beyond project delivery, you contribute to developing Amazon's internal and external construction networks, drive best practices across the organization, and are learning to force multiply — elevating the performance of the teams and partners around you. You write effective narratives and present complex decisions and trade-offs to Directors and VPs. You actively recruit, mentor, and develop other construction managers.

This role requires 60% regional travel on a yearly basis. When not traveling, you must have availability to work from a corporate office. Candidates should either live near or be willing to relocate within a reasonable commuting distance of one of the corporate office locations listed. Relocation assistance may be provided.

Key job responsibilities
Safety & Compliance
- Own and enforce Amazon's safety programs and standards across all internal and external project teams; set the standard for safety culture on complex projects
- Lead negotiations with Authorities Having Jurisdiction (AHJ) and regulatory bodies for permitting, regulatory compliance, and approvals
- Proactively identify and eliminate safety and compliance risks before they become project roadblocks

Project & Construction Management
- Oversee end-to-end project management services, design services, and external partner performance for complex projects; contribute to significantly complex projects as part of a team
- Serve as Amazon's senior owner's representative — the primary integrator between construction execution, design, and internal Amazon stakeholders across operations, equipment, IT, and facilities
- Develop project strategies and ensure appropriate resources are allocated to execute in accordance with those strategies
- Oversee design and engineering of complex projects, including design evaluations, design conformance reviews, and value engineering assessments
- Monitor project performance metrics, anticipate roadblocks and risks, manage escalations, and ensure corrective actions are taken
- Resolve complex issues and find a path forward in difficult situations; make trade-off decisions between short-term and long-term needs and defend those decisions to internal stakeholders
- Assess project performance through KPIs for safety, quality, cost, schedule, and sustainability; develop measurable targets and verifiable milestones

Budget, Schedule & Contract Management
- Own project budgets and oversee spend approvals across all assigned projects
Lead external partner selection, contract negotiations, and project procurement functions
- Review, analyze, and approve or challenge cost and time change requests submitted by external project teams
- Review project requests against business need; provide approvals or recommend alternate solutions
- Ensure contracts are fit for purpose, cost-effective, and incorporate appropriate service level agreements

External Partner & Stakeholder Management
- Align delivery from external project managers, architects, design consultants, general contractors, and subcontractors in line with Amazon priorities
- Hold external project managers accountable for timely accomplishment of deliverables; provide guidance and escalate as needed
- Support crucial relationships and lead negotiations of agreements with customers, suppliers, and external partners
- Collaborate with internal teams and influence them to decouple from dependencies; eliminate risks to innovation or customer satisfaction before they become roadblocks
- Partner with teams responsible for facility transition, base building management, and turnover documentation
- Contribute to developing Amazon's internal and external construction networks

Communication & Reporting
- Manage construction meetings effectively; drive detailed discussions and achieve high-level alignment and consensus across increasingly diverse stakeholder groups (legal, regulatory, operations, engineering, finance, external industry groups, etc.)
- Write effective narratives and present complex decisions, trade-offs, and potential solutions to Directors and VPs
- Communicate budgets, schedules, project status, and priorities clearly to internal teams and external partners
- Maintain clear, concise, and transparent communication across all project stakeholders

Process Improvement, Best Practices & People Development
- Drive continuous improvement and create sustainable, repeatable processes and playbooks for the team and region
- Drive efficiencies, streamline workflows, and mitigate excess process and risk
- Learn to force multiply — drive adoption of best practices and elevate the performance of teams and partners

title: Site EHS Manager II
descriptionHtml:
Join Amazon’s mission to become Earth’s safest place to work! At Amazon, we’ve set the ambitious goal to become the benchmark of safety excellence across all industries in which we operate. We're seeking a dedicated Workplace Health & Safety (WHS) Manager to join our mission of creating the world's safest work environment. This role offers an exciting opportunity to directly impact associate wellbeing while driving operational excellence.

As a WHS Manager, you'll be the site's safety champion, leading our Global WHS Program implementation. You'll combine hands-on safety management with strategic thinking to protect our most valuable asset – our people. Your role bridges the gap between safety requirements and operational success, requiring both technical expertise and strong interpersonal skills. Working closely with Operations leadership, you'll drive safety initiatives that make a real difference. You'll conduct comprehensive risk assessments, analyze safety data, and implement practical solutions that protect associates while supporting productivity. Your ability to build relationships and influence positive change will be essential as you help shape our safety culture. You'll lead safety compliance efforts, conduct thorough site audits, and analyze incident trends to target improvements where they matter most. Managing our first aid program and emergency response capabilities, you'll ensure immediate care is always available. Your analytical skills will transform safety data into actionable insights, while your leadership abilities will help engage associates in our safety mission.

Core Impact Areas:
Safety Leadership & Innovation - Transform safety culture through leadership and innovative solutions. Drive continuous improvement initiatives that set new benchmarks in workplace safety. Leverage technology and data analytics to drive preventive safety measures that protect our associates while enhancing operational excellence. Develop leadership plans, communicate expectations, and drive initiatives to create a safe work environment. Measure performance against WHS policies, analyze metrics, and conduct site audits to address non-compliance issues.

Strategic Partnership & Influence - Build partnerships with Operations leadership to integrate safety into every aspect of our business. Use compelling data analysis and risk insights to influence positive change and drive strategic decision-making. Establish yourself as a trusted advisor who balances safety excellence with operational demands. Oversee recordkeeping, workplace organization, and WHS training programs.

For those that do not have an adult First Aid, CPR, AED certification from the American Heart Association or American Red Cross, must obtain within 3 weeks of start date.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree, or 2+ years of Amazon (blue badge/FTE) experience

Amazon Web Services (AWS) offers an exciting, dynamic and challenging environment encouraging creativity and personal development while maintaining AWS computing environments in a secure, scalable, and cost-effective manner.

Mid 2012, AWS S3 web service accepted its 1 trillionth object, currently accepting more than 40,000 objects uploaded every second on a daily basis. - Escalation point and technical trouble shooter for all Systems and problems
- Deep diving into server issues

- Participate in Data Centre power and cooling events

- Help define metrics to increase our customer uptime

title: Senior Solutions Architect, AWS Private Equity
descriptionHtml:
This role can be based in Amsterdam, Madrid, Munich, Milan, Luxembourg, Paris, Stockholm, Zurich, or London.

Would you like to help the largest Private Equity (PE) firms and their portfolio companies leverage new technologies to improve their operations? Would you like to use your IT leadership experience to build relationships with technical leaders, C-level executives, and influencers at all levels across the PE segment?

As a Private Equity Solutions Architect, you will work directly with Private Equity firms, their portfolio companies, and consulting partners to help them adopt new technologies and build new solutions to make the most of the Cloud. You will be at the crossroads of business and technology, engaging with organisations at all stages of cloud adoption. You will provide thought leadership in terms of looking beyond the technology and considering the value that technology creates for our customers. You will practice your creativity by linking technology to tangible solutions and business outcomes. You will educate PE firms and their portfolio companies about the art of the possible, defining and developing cloud-native reference architectures for a variety of use cases. You will have the opportunity to present publicly at AWS conferences and industry events.

The ideal candidate will possess a technical background that enables them to drive customer engagement with business, finance or IT executives at the highest levels of our PE customers. You will have experience working with complex IT environments including applications, middleware, storage, networks, information security, and operations. You will also have a demonstrated ability to think strategically and long-term about the needs of businesses

The Private Equity Solutions Architecture team is a diverse group of technologists from a variety of backgrounds. Practical knowledge of the AWS platform is desired but not required, provided you have a balanced technical foundation and a desire to learn. You will develop deep expertise in AWS technologies, as well as a broad set of tools and methodologies of how applications and services are constructed using the AWS platform.

At Amazon you will be encouraged and rewarded for doing what is right for the long-term success of your customers. We value your passion to discover, invent, and build on behalf of customers. You will enjoy keeping your existing technical skills honed and developing new ones so you can make impactful contributions to architecture discussions with customers.

Amazon has always been, and always will be, committed to diversity and inclusion. We seek builders from all backgrounds to join our teams, and we encourage our employees to bring their authentic, original, and best selves to work.

AWS Global Sales

AWS Global Sales drives adoption of the AWS cloud worldwide, enabling customers of all sizes to innovate and expand in the cloud. Our team empowers every customer to grow by providing tailored service, unmatched technology, and consistent support. We dive deep to understand each customer's unique challenges, then craft innovative solutions that accelerate their success. This customer-first approach is how we built the world's most adopted cloud. Join us and help us grow.

Key job responsibilities
As a Private Equity Solutions Architect, you will work directly with Private Equity Firms and/or executives of their portfolio companies to design technology solutions to solve specific business challenges or accelerate business initiatives.

- Scoping and understand specific use cases to design appropriate AWS-based technical solutions (including, integrations with third party solutions).

- Own the technical relationship with PE firms and the C-suite of portfolio companies and operate as their trusted advisor. The best interests of the customer will shape the guidance you provide.

- Serve as a key technical member of the AWS PE team to help ensure customer success in architecting, building, migrating, or optimizing applications and services on the AWS platform.

- Build rapport with Executives at both PE firms and their portfolio companies leveraging your understanding of enterprise architecture, merger and acquisitions, migration and cost optimization of IT infrastructure and other key technologies

- Establish technical credibility with PE firms and their portfolio companies to lead discussions with CTOs, CIOs, Chief Architects, Senior Developers, etc. from both customer and partners across the PE segment.

- Evangelize and educate key stakeholders with the Private Equity ecosystem about AWS technologies.

- Influence AWS's roadmap of new features and services based on customer feedback.

- Create and capture best practices, technical content and new reference architectures (e.g. white papers, code samples, blog posts).

- Contribute to the growth of the Solutions Architecture organization by hiring, coaching and mentoring others.

- Develop areas of depth in technical domains relevant to your interests and your customer's outcomes.

title: Support Engineer, Identity and Access Management
descriptionHtml:
Amazon's Security Compliance Investigations team protects our most sensitive and regulated data by monitoring and investigating access at scale. We are seeking an experienced Support Engineer to lead complex investigations, set quality standards, and help the team grow.

In this role, you will lead high-stakes investigations that require advanced SQL analysis and pattern recognition across large datasets to determine compliance with data access policies. You will connect patterns others miss, engage stakeholders and their leadership to drive remediation, and establish best practices that keep internal customers compliant. You will own the quality bar for investigation documentation and access-request reviews, refine how the team investigates, and mentor engineers to elevate the capability of the entire team. This is a hands-on, investigation-heavy role for engineers who combine technical depth with sound judgment.

Key job responsibilities
- Lead complex investigations by reviewing SQL and access records to determine what data was accessed, interpreting dashboards and logs to identify patterns across large datasets, and reaching clear compliance determinations with limited guidance
- Own the quality of investigation documentation, clearly articulating impact, steps taken, and case state, and serve as the lead reviewer for content in your area of technical expertise
- Engage stakeholders and their leadership to understand access behavior, drive remediation, and establish best practices that help internal customers stay compliant with data-sharing and data-handling policies
- Evaluate access requests to protected data against policy, assess internal use cases for compliance, and identify recurring issues to improve investigation methods and standard operating procedures
- Act as a subject matter expert and technical point of contact for escalations, mentor other engineers on the team to raise their capability, and use data to identify and drive development of new support mechanisms and tools


A day in the life
You will lead the team's most complex investigations: reviewing SQL and access records to determine what data was accessed, connecting patterns across dashboards and large datasets, and reaching clear compliance determinations. You will engage stakeholders and their leadership to remediate access behavior and set best practices for staying compliant. You will own the review of access requests to protected data, evaluating internal use cases against data-sharing and data-handling policy. Where an investigation calls for it, you will write queries to validate findings across datasets. You will also improve how the team investigates by refining methods and standard operating procedures, and mentor less experienced engineers.

This role includes occasional on-call responsibilities.
