title: Sr. Seller Success Manager, Dealer Groups, Amazon Autos
descriptionHtml:
Are you a relationship builder who thrives on solving complex, multi-stakeholder problems at enterprise scale? Do you want to shape how the nation's largest dealer groups experience Amazon?

Amazon Autos is revolutionizing the vehicle discovery and shopping experience, connecting customers with their ideal vehicle. As a Senior Seller Success Manager at Amazon Autos, you'll have the opportunity to unleash your entrepreneurial spirit and tackle complex challenges alongside industry-leading professionals.

As a Senior Seller Success Manager, you will be the single-threaded owner of Amazon’s largest and most complex dealer group client relationships — accounts that span multiple dealership locations, corporate partner entities, and the nation’s largest dealer groups. You will own the relationship from the corporate suite to the individual store, build the growth strategy that ties them together, and drive the work required to deliver it.

The defining challenge of this role is operating at two altitudes simultaneously. At the enterprise level, you will build relationships with C-Suite executives, Regional Vice Presidents, and Directors to set strategy and unlock expansion. At the rooftop level, you will ensure that strategy translates into execution — that every store is optimized, that product utilization is high, and that performance trends are moving in the right direction. Doing that well takes strong business acumen, the analytical rigor to connect store-level data to enterprise-level insights, the consultative skill to deliver recommendations that dealer leadership acts on, and the ability to navigate complex organizations where priorities differ at every level.

Above all, you must demonstrate a high level of ownership and the ability to thrive in ambiguity. If you're ready to take on a challenging, yet rewarding role in a start-up-like environment, we encourage you to apply for this Senior Seller Success Manager position on the Amazon Autos team.

Key job responsibilities
Collaborate cross-functionally to advocate for dealer needs, capture product feedback, and close the loop with internal teams and dealers.

Drive product utilization and minimize churn. Train dealers, coordinate workshops, and implement targeted retention strategies for at-risk accounts.

Build the systems that drive consistency at scale. Develop playbooks, workflows, and reporting frameworks that reduce variability across all locations within a dealer group. Create reusable mechanisms and best practices that enable the broader team to operate more effectively.

Own group-level issues and escalations end to end. Diagnose root cause rather than routing symptoms, and drive resolution with the accountable team.

Own group-level analytics and performance consultation. Compile group-level scorecards that translate rooftop activity into enterprise-level insights, and consult on optimization tied to each dealer’s goals and market trends.

Build and execute a growth plan for your dealer group. Use performance data to find where the group is under-indexed by market, rooftop, and vehicle condition, and drive it to a measurable outcome. Propose expansion opportunities and growth pilots with clear success metrics.

Build and run the operating relationship with your dealer group. Establish recurring cadences at the corporate and rooftop level, and proactively monitor dealer satisfaction and account health.

Own your dealer group’s performance on Amazon end to end. Build trusted relationships from rooftop General Managers through corporate Directors, Vice Presidents, and C-Suite executives.

A day in the life
Your primary responsibilities include driving sustainable dealer growth on Amazon through data-driven insights and marketplace expertise, partnering with dealer leadership to develop and execute growth strategies, advocating on behalf of dealers while developing customized solutions, and managing escalations to ensure exceptional dealer satisfaction and account health across your portfolio. You will work cross-functionally with internal teams and externally with GM and VP-level dealer contacts.

This role operates at the intersection of strategy and execution. You will manage rooftop-level accounts with operational rigor while simultaneously building the enterprise-wide systems — playbooks, reporting frameworks, standardized processes — that enable scale. You will balance the immediate needs of individual dealership locations with the long-term strategic priorities of corporate partnerships. Within established parameters, you will determine the right frequency to meet with all assigned dealers based on account plans, each dealer's individual needs, and prioritization across your portfolio.

About the team
We are a newly formed rapidly growing team with a vision to create innovative discovery and shopping experiences on Amazon, providing customers better convenience and more selection. We're collaborating with other experienced teams at Amazon to define the future of how customers research and shop for products in the complex automotive space. This role is part of the Amazon Ads org and is focused on vehicle sales.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of digital sales, account management, business development, or partner management experience
- Bachelor's degree in a relevant field or equivalent work experience
- 3+ years of owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership experience
- Experience building and cultivating relationships with internal and external stakeholders

Preferred qualifications

- Experience managing and growing large accounts, product marketing or management consulting roles
- Experience in launching new products
- MBA, or Bachelor's degree or above
- Experience in written and verbal communication skills to communicate with technical and non-technical audiences, including senior leadership

title: Onsite Medical Representative
descriptionHtml:
Join Amazon’s mission to become Earth’s safest place to work! At Amazon, we’ve set the ambitious goal to become the benchmark of safety excellence across all industries in which we operate. The Amazon Workplace Health & Safety (WHS) team sets the strategic direction to provide resources, best practices, and safe environments to proactively manage the health and wellbeing of our workforce. To support these goals, Amazon is seeking an experienced and dynamic Onsite Medical Representative (OMR) to join our team. In this position, you will work closely with the WHS Site Manager, WHS Specialist, and occasionally the Injury Prevention Specialist (IPS). This includes attending weekly associate safety committee meetings, greeting all new hires for the site or through daily one-on-one interaction. Additionally, the OMR will participate in weekly case management review meetings as necessary.

As an OMR, you will independently assess and administer first aid as well as offer guidance to Amazon Associates (AAs) on both occupational and non-occupational injuries or illnesses. You should be passionate about learning and advocating health and wellness principles to consistently support AAs on a daily basis. You will refer care to outside medical providers as needed, and learn about OSHA regulations, risk, and analysis.

The OMR will function as a part of the larger team onsite, assisting with all first aid needs and support safety operations as needed.

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:
- Provide first aid support and make referrals to outside medical providers as necessary.
- Minimize the AA risk of injury through awareness, education, and proactive engagement.
- Maintain all records of care provided to AAs.
- Coordinate and maintain the workers’ compensation and return to work programs for AAs with work-related injuries.
- Provide daily activity logs and end of shift reports.
- Engage with AAs and leadership on operations floor to provide coaching regarding observed at-risk work habits.
- Maintain a clean working environment and ensure appropriate medical supply inventory is maintained.
- Participate in training and certification to facilitate first aid, CPR and AED certifications classes.
- Maintain all first aid, CPR, AED credentials.
- Work flexible shifts which could include days, nights, holidays, and/or weekends.
- Assist with random saliva drug testing protocols.
- Maintain effective care delivery in emergencies and assist emergency response at the site.

Additional Job Elements include:
- Lift up to 49 pounds and frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach
- Stand/walk for up to 12 hours during shifts
- Work in an environment where the noise level varies
- Work in an environment that is subject to variable temperatures and weather (delivery stations include outside loading departments)
- Continuously climb and descend stairs (applies to sites with stairs)

For those that do not have an adult First Aid, CPR, AED certification from the American Heart Association or American Red Cross, must obtain within 3 weeks of start date.

Basic qualifications

- High school or equivalent diploma

- Current valid Emergency Medical Technician (EMT) OR Paramedic Certification from the Department of Health OR the National Registry of Emergency Medical Technicians (NREMT); OR
- Current active Athletic Trainer Certification, by either the Board of Certification (BOC) or equivalent State Certification.

Preferred qualifications

- Certified to teach first aid, CPR, and AED training from American Heart Association or American Red Cross
- Proficient in Microsoft Office
- Experience with an industrial wellness program
- Experience managing musculoskeletal disorders, ergonomics, and coaching on body mechanics
- Demonstrated work experience with OSHA regulations and Workers Compensation

title: Software Development Manager, Network Monitoring and Remediation
descriptionHtml:
AWS operates one of the world’s largest and most highly available networks which continues to grow rapidly in both size and complexity in response to customer demand. Many AWS customers run mission critical workloads that depend on our networks to be always on. Network Monitoring and Remediation (NMR) is responsible for preventing, predicting, detecting and remediating impairments across our network, both physical and logical, before they cause impact to our customers. We own the software systems that actively monitors AWS network by creating synthetic traffic through millions of network devices, and localize the signal so impact is resolved through automated mitigation and remediation. For the detected issues that we haven’t yet automated, we provide a suite of expert diagnostic tools that enable our human operators to quickly determine next steps. Our vision is that any failure in the network is pre-emptively remediated before it can cause customer impact by systems that require no human intervention.


AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the network — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

This is an opportunity to join a high-impact team with enormous potential for growth. We’re on the lookout for a leader who is passionate about people, distributed systems, software platforms, AI and delighting our customers. You will own the design, development, testing, and deployment of your systems and services. You will draw from a breadth and depth of technical expertise to mentor engineers, complete hands-on technical work, and provide leadership on complex technical issues.

As a Software Development Manager in Amazon, you will be part of the larger technical leadership community that plays a critical role in business planning, works closely with senior executives, influences our long-term technical and business strategy, helps us hire talented people, and ultimately enables us to deliver for our customers.

As a Software Development Manager at Amazon you will:
* Lead, mentor, and hire-for a world-class software development team.
* Lead the design, implementation, and deployment of successful highly distributed, large scale services.
* Serve as a lead on demanding, complex, multi-team, cross-functional projects.
* Actively participate in hiring talented people and assisting in the career development of people within and outside your team.
* Play a critical role in the broader business planning; working closely with senior executives to develop business targets and resource requirements.
* Define long-term technical and business strategy and goals.
* Demonstrate high levels of creativity and the right judgment, most of the time.
* Understand business context to decisions made within and across groups.
* Maintain a current understanding of industry and technology trends.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.


Key job responsibilities
- You are interested in being part of a high-bar team with global responsibility for the Network Monitoring software used across all of Amazon’s businesses.
- Solving problems at scale excites you.
- You do not implement specs from analysts and architects – you talk to your customers and design solutions to their problems. You automate and innovate.
- You do not push just one technology agenda – you choose the best tool for the problem at hand.
- You do not throw your code over the wall. You launch it, own it, support it and make it incrementally better for the benefit of your customers.
- You enjoy working in a flexible, fast-paced, collaborative team environment.

About the team
Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Basic qualifications

- Knowledge of engineering practices and patterns for the full software/hardware/networks development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, certification, and livesite operations
- Experience in engineering team management
- Experience in leading the definition and development of multi tier web services
- Experience partnering with product and program management teams

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in communicating with users, other technical teams, and senior leadership to collect requirements, describe software product features, technical designs, and product strategy
- Experience in recruiting, hiring, mentoring/coaching and managing teams of Software Engineers to improve their skills, and make them more effective, product software engineers

title: Marketing Manager, Programmatic Advertising, Amazon Autos
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Autos is reinventing how people discover, research, and buy cars. Programmatic advertising through the Amazon DSP (ADSP) is one of our most important awareness and demand-generation channels, connecting high-intent car shoppers to the Amazon Autos experience across display, online video, and streaming TV at the moments that matter most. The ADSP channel is how we show up programmatically to drive qualified traffic, maximize channel efficiency, and improve the shopper experience end to end.
We are seeking a hands-on, highly analytical Marketing Manager to manage the Amazon DSP channel for Amazon Autos. This is a true channel-manager role: you will help shape the channel strategy, manage and pace a significant media budget, and run the day-to-day setup, pacing, and optimization of our programmatic campaigns. You will be actively managing campaigns in the Amazon Ads / DSP interface, with deep expertise in how to structure, optimize, and scale campaigns and extract the best possible results from every lever the platform offers. The role requires a highly analytical mindset and a curiosity to seek out new possibilities. You will read performance both at a top-line channel level and granularly within the campaign structure, and understand how this translates to on-platform performance. You will balance the art and science of advertising, with deep strength on the technical side of marketing as well as the creative and experimental side, consistently using one to inform the other. You will be accountable for your channel's day-to-day performance, applying learnings across campaigns and audiences, partnering with more senior colleagues on larger or more ambiguous bets and constantly looking for new ways to experiment as Amazon Autos helps blaze a trail within Amazon Ads.
The successful candidate will think strategically and execute rigorously. You must be able to thrive in an entrepreneurial environment and not be hindered by ambiguity or competing priorities. You will anticipate and remove bottlenecks, make tradeoffs with limited guidance, and balance business needs against constraints. You will dive into performance data, incremental business impact, and budget pacing for your channel, which requires strong analytical skills. You Earn Trust with your stakeholders, including but not limited to the Amazon Ads team, Product team, Reporting & Analytics partners, and other lines of business.


Key job responsibilities
- Contribute to the strategy for the Amazon DSP channel and manage a significant, growing programmatic media budget, collaborating with the marketing team, internal Amazon Ads counterparts, and external agencies on larger allocation decisions
- Own day-to-day setup, management, and optimization of ADSP campaigns, hands-on in the Amazon Ads / DSP interface
- Drive performance through continuous optimization (bidding, budget pacing, audience and inventory strategy, and campaign structure) at both a top-line and granular level on the ad platform and in the total traffic funnel
- Design, launch, and read out A/B tests to improve channel efficiency and inform new campaign strategy
- Manage brand lift and creative lift studies to inform future optimizations
- Monitor and analyze campaign performance metrics; troubleshoot and resolve delivery issues, ad-serving errors, and reporting discrepancies
- Conduct creative performance analysis and deliver clear, data-backed feedback to the creative team to strengthen future ads
- Help develop and scale our presence in emerging programmatic surfaces and new ADSP capabilities
- Translate performance data into actionable insights and concise business recommendations, refining them with senior colleagues; generate detailed reports and present findings
- Partner with Supply and Product teams, surfacing feedback that helps inform improvements to Amazon DSP offerings
- Support channel budget planning and OP1/OP2 inputs by scoping spend, flagging efficiency opportunities, and helping recommend where to invest next


A day in the life
You will start your day reviewing performance across your ADSP campaigns (pacing, spend, and conversion trends) and making optimizations directly in the Amazon DSP interface. Mid-morning you might dig into a line item that's underperforming, restructure audiences or adjust bids, and set up an A/B test to validate a new approach. After lunch, you're analyzing creative performance and pulling together feedback for the creative team on what's resonating and what isn't. Later in the week, you might build a readout on channel performance, size an opportunity in a new programmatic surface, and work with your manager on where to invest next. The work moves constantly between hands-on execution and deep analysis, and you'll always have multiple campaigns and tests in flight.

About the team
We're the marketing team at Amazon Autos, responsible for driving broad awareness of a marketplace that's fundamentally changing how people buy cars. You'll work alongside Creative, Analytics, and Product teams who are building something that's never existed in automotive retail. We test constantly, share learnings openly, and push each other to get better. If you enjoy a start-up environment, where you get to build from 0 to 1 and no two days are the same, this may be the role for you.

Basic qualifications

- 4+ years of professional non-internship marketing experience
- Experience using data and metrics to drive improvements
- Experience with Excel or Tableau (data manipulation, macros, charts and pivot tables)
- Experience building and optimizing multiple, simultaneous marketing campaigns
- Experience managing or working within cross-functional marketing and creative teams
- Experience delivering paid media campaigns spanning TV, print ads and digital/social channels
- Experience in audience segmentation and targeting

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in multi-territory campaign management
- Experience in digital marketing and content production timelines and process
- Experience managing and optimizing campaigns within the Amazon DSP/Amazon Digital Ads

descriptionHtml:

We make sure Amazon gets value for money every time it buys non-inventory goods and services for its Fulfillment Centers (FCs) and corporate business. It’s a fast-paced operation that supports growth and change, works with every department and is driven by Key Performance Indicators – and there’s plenty of healthy competition. We work individually and as part of teams, meeting regularly to cement our relationships and approach.

The Global Procurement Central Services AMER (GPCS AMER), reporting into the Global Procurement Organization (GPO), ensures that Amazon gets value for money for non-inventory goods to provide the Fulfillment Centers with the necessary shipping supplies they need to operate smoothly. The team has two divisions: North America (NA) and Costa Rica (CR). GPCS AMER is a 24/7 team (shifts both days and nights) supporting Operations & the Field Procurement team and follows Amazon Corporate guidance for working in our office in Tempe, Arizona. descriptionHtml:
Our logistics teams are changing the way we interact with customers around the globe every single day and solving some of the biggest logistical challenges facing not just Amazon, but the entire industry.

As an Operations Engineer on the Last Mile Engineering team, you will serve as a critical link between field operations and engineering, ensuring that operational pain points are captured, routed, and resolved through structured engineering programs. You will own key feedback mechanisms, reporting tools, and lifecycle processes that drive continuous improvement across the delivery network. This role sits at the intersection of operations and engineering, giving you direct impact on the quality and reliability of Last Mile deployments at scale.

This role is for you if you have (1) Strong analytical and problem-solving skills (2) bility to communicate effectively across technical and non-technical audiences, (3) Comfort working in ambiguous, fast-paced environments where you define the process as much as you execute it

Key job responsibilities
- Source and prioritize engineering problems by filtering operational listening tools, identifying patterns, and escalating high-impact issues to the right engineering programs

- Own and maintain consolidated operational dashboards (e.g., Pulse Dashboard), providing a single-pane-of-glass view into program health, risk, and milestones across the network
- Translate operational pain points into actionable engineering requirements, replacing ad hoc handoffs with a structured, repeatable conduit between Operations and Engineering
- Manage the master lifecycle template and stage-gate criteria that govern how work progresses from engineering through construction, commissioning, and launch
- Build and maintain signal-filtering tools and reporting mechanisms that surface engineering solutions and track program outcomes
- Conduct module audits, root-cause deep dives, and engineering design standard reviews, translating findings into clear, actionable recommendations
- Facilitate cross-functional reviews to align stakeholders on design decisions, process changes, and deployment standards
- Build strong working relationships across Engineering, Planning, Operations, Material Handling, and Equipment teams to establish shared mechanisms and align on standards, processes, and solutions

A day in the life
Every day is a little different, but the throughline is the same: you're the person who makes sure the field's voice reaches engineering — clearly, quickly, and completely. ou're the person on the call who can speak both "ops" and "engineering" fluently — translating a station manager's frustration into a spec an engineer can act on, and explaining back to the field exactly what's being built and why. You own the dashboards that give leadership a single-pane-of-glass view into program health, and you own the tools that make sure the right signals rise above the noise. You'll build relationships across Engineering, Planning, Material Handling, and Operations — not because it's on a checklist, but because solving Last Mile's hardest logistics problems requires all of those voices in the room. If you love connecting dots across complex systems, turning ambiguity into structure, and seeing your work ship at network scale, this is the role where you'll feel it every single day.

About the team
Strategic Programs & Engineering (SP&E) owns end-to-end delivery of last-mile logistics solutions, from strategic concepts through engineered deployment and quality assurance. The portfolio spans 12 programs across three pillars: (1) Micromobility (Walker, e-Bike, Microhub), (2) Strategic Programs (Island Delivery, Pharmacy, Large Package Solutions (LP59-68 / Radian Free) (FAQ1), Smart TDR, Project LabelTrack, Relay Gate Lite), and (3) Performance Engineering and Quality Assurance (PEQA)

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of industrial engineer, operations engineer, manufacturing engineer, or project engineer in a manufacturing environment experience
- Bachelor's degree
- Experience leading cross-functional teams across engineering, operations, and field execution through launch readiness and go-live phases

Preferred qualifications

- Knowledge of AutoCAD, VBA, and SQL at the intermediate level
- Experience communicating technical concepts to non-technical audiences
- Experience with retrofits, launches, or automation deployments
- Experience building launch readiness frameworks, standard work, playbooks, and scalable deployment mechanisms across multiple concurrent sites

title: Senior Technical Program Manager  , Secure Connection Services (SCS) Edge Connectivity Services (ECS)
descriptionHtml:
Are you energized by solving complex technical challenges that span multiple teams and systems? Do you thrive when turning ambiguity into clear plans and measurable outcomes?

The Secure Connection Services (SCS) Edge Connectivity Services (ECS) Team is looking for a Senior Technical Program Manager to own and drive AWS Region expansion programs across the AWS Networking family of services. You will enable dedicated network connectivity options for our U.S. National Security and Department of War customers to AWS Classified regions. You will also work with Defense Industrial Base (DIB) customers to support and expand Amazon's new launched AWS Secret Cloud for Industry (ASCI) service which enables dedicated connectivity to the AWS Secret Region for industry partners. You will build mechanisms and processes to automate and streamline the customer experience, working across AWS engineering, networking, and security teams to simplify access to the AWS classified (Secret and Top Secret) regions.

The Senior Technical Program Manager will own and drive cross-functional programs that have considerable business impact. In this role, you will define program strategy, align stakeholders across engineering and business teams, and deliver results at scale. You will use your technical depth to question assumptions, assess architectural decisions, and ensure the right solutions ship on time. If you are a collaborative, data-driven problem solver who communicates with clarity and builds trust across all levels, we want to hear from you.

This position requires that the candidate selected must be a US Citizen and currently possess and maintain an active TS/SCI security clearance with polygraph. The position further requires the candidate to opt into a commensurate clearance for each government agency for which they perform AWS work.

Key job responsibilities
- Define and manage the lifecycle of complex cross-functional programs, setting clear objectives, success criteria, and roadmaps that align with organizational goals
- Drive alignment across business and technical stakeholders by facilitating crisp decision-making, providing context for technology choices, and prioritizing initiatives based on customer and business impact
- Identify and mitigate risks proactively by overseeing gaps between teams, processes, and system architectures, reducing exposure to common failure modes such as unclear requirements or insufficient testing
- Leverage your technical judgment to evaluate proposals, test assumptions, and make smart trade-offs between time, effort, and feature scope while partnering with engineering leaders to ensure solutions scale appropriately
- Communicate program progress and outcomes effectively through written narratives and executive presentations, building consensus when perspectives differ and escalating with good judgment when needed
- Partner with Business, Product, and Technology Leaders and teams to deliver value for our customers
- Drive visibility and transparency of dates, milestones, and schedule throughout the customer onboarding process
- Build inclusive relationships with partner groups in AWS Region Services, Networking and the World Wide Public Sector teams. Ensuring that these teams focus on our customers and support customer missions

A day in the life
You might start your morning reviewing program metrics and identifying areas that need attention before joining a cross-team sync to unblock a critical dependency. By midafternoon, you could be drafting a narrative that frames a key trade-off for senior leadership, then pivoting to a design review where you pressure-test architectural assumptions with engineers. You will regularly connect with stakeholders across the organization, ensuring priorities stay aligned and your program delivers meaningful results.

The Edge Connectivity Services (ECS) team is focused on building and improving the technology systems that power Amazon's operations at global scale. We value collaboration, clear communication, and a willingness to tackle hard problems together. You will work alongside engineers, product managers, and business leaders who are committed to delivering impactful solutions for our customers. We are investing in new capabilities and looking for a program leader who is excited to help shape our technical direction in the years ahead.

About the team
About AWS

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Why AWS?

Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge-sharing and mentorship. Our senior members enjoy one-on-one mentoring and thorough, but kind, code reviews. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects that help our team members develop your engineering expertise so you feel empowered to take on more complex tasks in the future.

AWS Infrastructure Services (AIS)

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

Diverse Experiences

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Inclusive Team Culture

AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship & Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Basic qualifications

- 7+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
- 5+ years of technical product or program management experience
- 5+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience
- Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules
- Current, active US Government Security Clearance of Top Secret with SCI eligibility or above

Preferred qualifications

- 7+ years of technical product or program management experience
- Experience with network hardware: copper and optical fiber cabling, switches, routers
- Knowledge of NSA Approved Type-1 Cryptography and Communications Security (COMSEC)
- Current, active US Government Security Clearance of TS/SCI with Polygraph

descriptionHtml:

- Define, develop, and oversee end-to-end execution of communications programs spotlighting the services provided to business customers
- Manage reputational issues with internal stakeholders, communications colleagues and members of the media

- Work cross-functionally to plan and execute PR campaigns, in support of clear business goals

We connect Amazon's vision, products, and services with customers, employees, and stakeholders worldwide through clear, consistent, and compelling messaging.
Our team combines deep regional expertise with global best practices to create localized communication strategies that resonate in diverse markets. We work cross-functionally with business leaders, product teams, and regional stakeholders to shape narratives that build trust, drive engagement, and support business growth in international markets.

- 10+ years of recent professional communications or public relations experience
- Bachelor's degree
- Experience in Business English and Japanese skills, both verbal and written
- Background in developing strategic communications, for both proactive and issues use cases
- Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment, leading through ambiguity and bringing high judgement

Preferred qualifications

- Experience equally comfortable building strategic marketing plans and executing at a tactical level
- Experience managing multiple agencies and budgets
- Experience creating and delivering written and oral communications for technical and non-technical audiences

title: Mechatronics & Robotics Tech
descriptionHtml:
About Maintenance at Amazon

Operations is at the heart of Amazon’s business. We are known for our speed, accuracy, and exceptional service. Our buildings deliver tens of thousands of products to hundreds of countries worldwide, every day. Reliability Maintenance & Engineering (RME) are the business partners that work tirelessly behind the scenes to make it all happen. We drive continuous improvement and maintain all of the Robotics and Material Handling Equipment (MHE) to ensure our customers are met with the Amazon smile. Come join us on our journey!

About the Role

As a Mechatronics & Robotics Technician, you will use your skills to support the Operations Maintenance team in repairing and maintaining material handling equipment and pneumatic systems throughout the building. You will have the opportunity to install, maintain, and repair automated packaging and distribution equipment. In addition to developing your skills, you will mentor junior technicians to grow in their roles.

What Do We Offer?

Amazon offers competitive compensation packages including comprehensive healthcare benefits starting on Day 1, matching 401(k) program, and up to 20 weeks of paid parental leave. But wait, there is more: We provide lightweight fire-resistant daily wear and composite toe safety shoes for your safety!

Here is what you can expect with the Reliability & Maintenance Engineering (RME) selection process for Mechatronics & Robotics Technicians: (Timeframe: Approximately 30-days)

Step 1: Congratulations! You successfully submitted your application!

Step 2: Amazon Recruiting will review your application and invite the most qualified candidate to complete a pre-employment assessment.

Step 3: If you meet the role qualifications, you will receive an invitation from Amazon Recruiting (do-not-reply@criteriacorp.com) to begin your Criteria assessment. You have 5 days to complete.

Step 4: Once you successfully meet the pre-employment assessment requirements, you will be invited to complete a video interview. Your video interview invitation will be from HireVue (interviews@hirevue.com) and you will have 7 days to record your interview.

Step 5: Your video interview will be reviewed by the Amazon Hiring Team and you will be notified of next steps via email within 5 business days.


Key job responsibilities
Key job responsibilities include, but are not limited to:
- You will promote a safe working environment by following all safety procedures
- You will complete preventative maintenance routines with proper documentation
- You will troubleshoot electrical and mechanical problems related to all Material Handling Equipment (MHE) which includes belts, motors, photo-eyes, relays, and more
- You will maintain a positive working relationship across all of the Amazon Operations facility
- You must be able to move up to 49lbs, stand and walk during shifts lasting up to 12 hours, climb ladders and gangways safely, and without limitation, as well as perform regular bending, lifting, stretching, and reaching both below the waist and above the head

Please note that while we strive to accommodate employees' preferences for shift assignments, due to operational requirements and scheduling constraints, we cannot guarantee a specific shift assignment.

Basic qualifications

- High school or equivalent diploma
- 1+ years of Microsoft Office products and applications experience
- Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays
- 2+ years of automated conveyor systems and controls experience, or certification from Amazon's Mechatronics and Robotics Apprenticeship Program
- 2+ years of conducting predictive and preventative maintenance procedures experience
- 2+ years of reading blueprints and electrical schematics experience
- 2+ years of demonstrating safety standards experience
- 2+ years of troubleshooting and diagnostics of material handling equipment (MHE) experience

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with robotic operation and maintenance
- 2+ years of electrical and electronic principles experience
- Associate's degree in Mechnical or Electrical
- 2+ years of Mechanical or Electrical apprenticeship experience

Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

The starting pay for this position is listed below, including the base pay rate plus the highest available shift differential which applies depending on the shift you select. title: Channel Team Lead, Hub Delivery

This is a leadership role that combines field execution with strategic vision, ensuring that ADEs achieve activation, and performance targets while maintaining Amazon's high delivery standards. The Channel Lead will serve as coach, problem-solver, and results driver, enabling their team to succeed in a dynamic, goal-oriented environment.

1. Lead, mentor, and develop a team of ADEs, ensuring consistent execution of Amazon's Hub Delivery model
2. Provide hands-on coaching in prospecting, onboarding, and performance management
3. Foster a culture of accountability, commitment, and field excellence
4. Monitor team KPIs across operations, activation, and delivery quality
5. Identify systemic issues within territories and implement corrective action plans
6. Partner with Operations, Last Mile, and Program teams to resolve systemic issues impacting delivery quality

title: Project Management Degree Apprentice - 42 month Fixed Term Contract
descriptionHtml:
Do you enjoy working collaboratively to solve complex challenges and deliver meaningful change? Are you ready to help lead projects that make a real impact across one of the world's most dynamic organisations? If so, we have an exciting opportunity for you to join Amazon as a Project Management Degree Apprentice.

As a Project Management Apprentice, you'll help deliver real projects that improve processes, enhance customer experience, and drive innovation across Amazon's diverse business lines - all while earning your fully funded BSc (Hons) Degree in Project Management. You'll work alongside experienced project professionals, using recognised methodologies and quality frameworks to bring ideas to life.

Throughout your apprenticeship you'll build a broad, adaptable skillset - stakeholder engagement, governance, financial control, and risk management - and grow from supporting projects to helping lead them. We move fast, fail fast, and fix faster, so you'll be encouraged to contribute ideas and take ownership early.

A day in the life can involve:

- Participating in planning sessions to align on project goals, milestones, and priorities

- Identifying risks early and collaborating on practical ways to mitigate them

- Tracking progress with data and reporting tools, and recommending improvements

Here at Amazon, it's in our nature to learn and be curious. Within this apprenticeship you'll put newfound knowledge into practice every day, supported by first-class coaching, tailored development, and rewarding work that will empower you to reach new heights and build the future you envision.

You'll gain a vast range of experiences and skills while working towards the BSc (Hons) Degree in Project Management. title: Software Development Engineer, NetOS Observability
descriptionHtml:
AWS runs one of the largest networks in the world. We design and implement its network devices and their operating system, NetOS. Every AWS service runs on this network, and every packet in the cloud touches our code! Nobody notices a healthy network. Operators need to know within seconds when a link degrades in one data center, and the first signal comes from software on the device. We write that software.

Our team, NetOS Observability, builds the agent that collects metrics, events, and logs from every NetOS device and publishes them to the network telemetry platform. Fleet health systems, SDN controllers, and network operators consume what we ship.

We are moving the fleet off a legacy daemon and onto a brand new Rust agent. In 2027, we take it to every supported platform, retire the legacy collectors, and let builders publish a new metric fleet-wide in two weeks. You will own that agent end to end, from its design to its release across the fleet to its behavior in production. The decisions that shape the next decade of network telemetry are open now. We need your help to craft the future.

Key job responsibilities
- Design and implement the NetOS observability agent in Rust on Linux (ARM64).
- Own the telemetry pipeline from device to gateway, including transport, authentication, schema, backpressure, and fleet-scale correctness.
- Migrate consumers off the legacy daemon with adapters that preserve their data shape, then retire the daemon.
- Build the test and release machinery that ships the component to the fleet on its own cadence. Every release passes its test gate.
- Instrument your own systems, define their SLOs, and carry the on-call rotation for them.
- Write design documents and review other engineers' designs. Name the dependency early when another team's roadmap gates yours, and negotiate the date.

A day in the life
You write Rust and test on real routers in our lab. You build for the component teams who define their telemetry in a schema we own, and for the fleet health systems, controllers, and operators who consume it. Every two weeks you settle the device-to-cloud contract with the telemetry platform team. You add a metric to the schema, bring a legacy consumer onto the new pipeline, and run the result on a router under its memory budget. AI agents draft, review, and test alongside you. You ship the component every few weeks and carry its on-call.

About the team
Our team sits inside NetOS Managed Fleet, which delivers health, observability, and management services for the NetOS fleet. We are growing the team in Raleigh, NC. You work directly with senior engineers and leadership across AWS Networking, and you give technical guidance as the team grows. We own what we ship, and we carry the on-call for the agent in production. We value clear design writing, incremental delivery, and property-based tests.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- 1+ years of software development engineer or related occupational experience
- 1+ years of designing and developing large-scale, multi-tiered, multi-threaded, embedded or distributed software applications, tools, systems, and services using: C#, C++, Java, or Perl experience
- 1+ years of Object Oriented Design experience
- Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

title: Data Engineer, Global Procurement Technology, Global Procurement Tech
descriptionHtml:
Data is at the heart of procurement. Do you want to make that data AI-ready — powering not just insight but autonomous decision-making and action at a global scale? As a Data Engineer on the Global Procurement Technology team, you will build the data foundation that drives AI transformation across Amazon's procurement organization. You will design and deliver data solutions end to end: creating supplier entity relationships, aggregating supplier data, enabling supplier performance and risk analysis, and providing supplier sourcing recommendations worldwide.

Your work will directly shape how procurement teams make decisions and how AI applications consume and act on trusted supplier data. You will partner with software engineers, scientists, business intelligence engineers, and business stakeholders to turn complex, multi-source datasets into reliable data products. If you enjoy solving ambiguous data problems and want your solutions to influence procurement strategy globally, we want to hear from you.

Key job responsibilities

- Create logical and physical data models across large datasets from multiple internal and external sources, ensuring data quality and consistency.
- Build self-service data infrastructure and curated datasets that let business intelligence engineers, scientists, and business teams access reliable data on their own.
- Collaborate with software engineers, scientists, and product and program managers to turn business requirements into well-documented, high-performing data solutions.
- Evaluate generative AI tooling for data workflows where appropriate, contributing to the team's broader AI transformation efforts.

A day in the life
Your morning is your focused time. You might spend it building new solutions, improving existing systems, solving operational issues, or pairing with a nearby EU colleague or stakeholder to work through a technical question. In the afternoon, the overlap with North America opens up and the pace shifts. This is when most team meetings, design reviews, and joint problem-solving with your NA counterparts happen. You will join sprint ceremonies with your agile squad, walk through designs with peers, and align with product and program managers on priorities. The rhythm gives you dedicated heads-down hours each day balanced with regular cross-timezone collaboration.

About the team
Global Procurement Technology sits within Global Procurement Operations and builds the data and technology products that power Amazon's procurement processes worldwide. Our key products include the supplier mapping framework, the trusted supplier data repository, and the supplier management system. The team is an agile group of data engineers, software engineers, scientists, and product and program managers, with Principal Engineers in the broader organization providing technical guidance. You will have the chance to build skills across engineering disciplines, and the team's collaborative setup means you can grow by contributing to software, data, and AI work alike.

Basic qualifications

- Experience as a data engineer or related specialty (e.g., software engineer, business intelligence engineer, data scientist) with a track record of manipulating, processing, and extracting value from large datasets

- Experience with data modeling, warehousing and building ETL pipelines

- Experience programming with at least one modern language such as C++, C#, Java, Python, Golang, PowerShell, Ruby

title: Onsite Medical Representative
descriptionHtml:
Join Amazon’s mission to become Earth’s safest place to work! At Amazon, we’ve set the ambitious goal to become the benchmark of safety excellence across all industries in which we operate. The Amazon Workplace Health & Safety (WHS) team sets the strategic direction to provide resources, best practices, and safe environments to proactively manage the health and wellbeing of our workforce. To support these goals, Amazon is seeking an experienced and dynamic Onsite Medical Representative (OMR) to join our team. In this position, you will work closely with the WHS Site Manager, WHS Specialist, and occasionally the Injury Prevention Specialist (IPS). This includes attending weekly associate safety committee meetings, greeting all new hires for the site or through daily one-on-one interaction. Additionally, the OMR will participate in weekly case management review meetings as necessary.

As an OMR, you will independently assess and administer first aid as well as offer guidance to Amazon Associates (AAs) on both occupational and non-occupational injuries or illnesses. You should be passionate about learning and advocating health and wellness principles to consistently support AAs on a daily basis. You will refer care to outside medical providers as needed, and learn about OSHA regulations, risk, and analysis.

The OMR will function as a part of the larger team onsite, assisting with all first aid needs and support safety operations as needed.

Responsibilities include but are not limited to:
- Provide first aid support and make referrals to outside medical providers as necessary.
- Minimize the AA risk of injury through awareness, education, and proactive engagement.
- Maintain all records of care provided to AAs.
- Coordinate and maintain the workers’ compensation and return to work programs for AAs with work-related injuries.
- Provide daily activity logs and end of shift reports.
- Engage with AAs and leadership on operations floor to provide coaching regarding observed at-risk work habits.
- Maintain a clean working environment and ensure appropriate medical supply inventory is maintained.
- Participate in training and certification to facilitate first aid, CPR and AED certifications classes.
- Maintain all first aid, CPR, AED credentials.
- Work flexible shifts which could include days, nights, holidays, and/or weekends.
- Assist with random saliva drug testing protocols.
- Maintain effective care delivery in emergencies and assist emergency response at the site.

Additional Job Elements include:
- Lift up to 49 pounds and frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach
- Stand/walk for up to 12 hours during shifts
- Work in an environment where the noise level varies
- Work in an environment that is subject to variable temperatures and weather (delivery stations include outside loading departments)
- Continuously climb and descend stairs (applies to sites with stairs)

For those that do not have an adult First Aid, CPR, AED certification from the American Heart Association or American Red Cross, must obtain within 3 weeks of start date.

Basic qualifications

descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is an initiative to launch a constellation of Low Earth Orbit satellites that will provide low-latency, high-speed broadband connectivity to unserved and underserved communities around the world.

As a RF Comms Systems Engineer, you will work with a wide variety of functional groups and will be deeply involved in system integration and test of next generation Amazon Leo Satellites.

The Role:

This is a unique opportunity to define a groundbreaking, high-throughput wireless solution with few legacy constraints meet with 3GPP standards. The team works with customer requirements and wireless implementation teams to bring-up, integration and tuning, and debugging of advanced PHY/MAC and beamforming radio systems for state-of-the-art satellite communication system.

In this role you will:
• As a technical contributor, be at the forefront of bring-up, integration, and debugging of advanced PHY/MAC and beamforming radio systems for state-of-the-art satellite communication system.
• Architect, document, and execute 3GPP based testing for satellite to ground networks. Work with vendors to define equipment requirements to achieve 3GPP conformance testing. Ability to adapt test plans daily based on capabilities of HW/SW delivered by the dev teams.
• Collaborate across disciplines—including PHY algorithms, RF design, digital beamforming and antenna, MAC, and firmware teams - to ensure seamless integration and best-in-class wireless performance.
• Understand Doppler pre and post compensation techniques with CFO/SFO in LEO comms systems and test them in the laboratory environment for 3GPP. Knowing channel emulators is a plus.
• Ability to trade link budget and verify RF line-up for payloads in RF and IF configurations.
• Characterize performance, analyze data, root-cause system-level issues, and ensure high product quality.
• Work with a team and take responsibility for power, clock, RF, air, network debugging in lab.
• Contribute development-test bring up procedures with Linux, Python, bash scripting etc.
• Experience with wireless synchronization and signal generators / spectrum analyzers to verify that time/frequency requirements are being met.
• Experience, knowledge and skills on wireless system design, integration, bring up and debug of wireless PHY and RF systems on SoC platforms.
• Strong understanding of OFDM and MIMO-based wireless systems across both baseband and RF domains, with a solid foundation in related communication theory and signal processing.
• Work in lab environment and stay in front of the setups for debugging with ref equipment
• Work on scripting to change a SW/HW pieces incrementally and understand its effect on payload (via probing RF, IF, clock, channel quality messages) with help of Specan, siggen, scope, frequency counter, attenuators etc
• Work cross-functionally with RF, ASIC, SW, Comsys, Testbed teams and vendors to move forward in testing and integration. Be involved in verification and integration on the FPGA.

Export Control Requirement:
Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or a related field, or experience working in electrical engineering field
- 5+ years professional experience working in L1/L2 or beamforming
- Experience with RF lab equipment, bring-up, test and integration activities
- Experience with verification and integration on FPGA

Preferred qualifications

- Masters/PhD with emphasis in wireless communication systems
- Proficiency with modeling in MATLAB and/or C/C++; Experience in test automation setup and scripting languages such as Python/Perl/Matlab
- Broad spectrum of knowledge to be able to understand end-to-end network system architecture from wireless RF and physical layer all the way up to application end-point
- Must have 3GPP NTN and ORAN knowledge to address conformance testing
- Experience with leading technical initiatives and key deliverables.
- Must have the ability to work in a small team and drive to go beyond expectations to deliver results
- Should have background in wireless LTE, 5G/6G, RLC, PDCP, RRC and RAN protocols
- Knowledge of IP, UDP, TCP, HTTP protocols and analysis tools such as Wireshark
- Experience with current software development processes and tools including Agile, TDD, BDD, CI, Git
- Implementation experience with wireless synchronization and parameter sensing techniques such as ranging/positioning based on signaling as well as low-power design expertise
- Ideal candidate has a wireless communication systems or digital signal processing background, a passion for building, integrating and testing real-world carrier-grade communication systems
- Extensive experience with Lab test equipment such as channel emulator, spectrum analyzers and Signal and network traffic generators

title: Principal Technical Program Leader - PLM, One Material Handling System
descriptionHtml:
Own and lead the engineering design and product systems backbone that makes Amazon's in-house material handling business possible. One MHS is building the design, integration, and manufacturing of material handling equipment for Amazon's fulfillment network in-house, and none of it scales without a world-class Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) foundation. As the Principal for PLM, you will own the PLM system and the engineering change process for the organization, and you will be the business process owner for product data and engineering change across all of our hardware: the PLM platform, engineering change management, the connection between computer-aided design (CAD) and PLM, and the way PLM connects to the systems around it. Where our product teams each own a product line, you own the PLM backbone they all depend on to design, release, configure, and manufacture. You will set the strategy for how the organization manages product data and engineering workflows at scale, stand up the team and mechanisms to deliver it, drive the highest-stakes PLM platform decisions in front of us, and bring clear, data-backed recommendations to leadership for approval. You are also a direct contributor to the organization's enterprise technology stack and strategy, partnering with the owners of the surrounding systems to ensure the whole ecosystem works together.
We are a passionate group of innovators, engineers, and business leaders dedicated to reducing variability and complacency in Amazon's logistics systems. This role sits at the center of that mission; the team you stand up and the decisions you drive on PLM architecture, variant management, and engineering change will determine whether our engineering organization can scale from a handful of engineers today to the large, multi-product-family team of the future.


Key job responsibilities
● Stand Up and Grow the Team: Define the team this function needs, and attract, hire, and develop its members (PLM configuration and application engineers, and business or change analysts) as the work scales. Set the mission, mechanisms, and standards, and grow the people and structure needed to run PLM over the long term.
● Own the PLM Backbone: Act as the business process owner for PLM across all of our hardware; own the PLM environment and the product-data and engineering-change processes that every product team relies on, and set the strategic direction for their evolution.
● Contribute to Enterprise Technology Strategy: Serve as a direct contributor and participant in the organization's enterprise technology stack and strategy, ensuring PLM is designed to work end to end with the surrounding systems (ERP, procurement, design tooling, and future manufacturing and supplier systems) in partnership with the teams that own them.
● Drive the Strategic PLM Path: Lead the analysis and recommendation on the defining question in front of us: whether to adopt the shared enterprise PLM platform and its product configurator capability, or stand up our own PLM to remove the external dependency. You will drive this to a decision; final approval rests with leadership up through the senior executive sponsor.
● Drive and Deliver the PLM Build-Out: Act as the technical program owner for creating our PLM system end to end, whether that is continuing within the shared enterprise instance or standing up our own. Define the implementation roadmap, scope, milestones, and resourcing; manage the systems integrators, cross-team dependencies, and engineering workstreams; mitigate risk and clear blockers; and deliver the platform to production on schedule.
● Lead Variant Management and the Product Configurator: Own the requirements, business case, and rollout strategy for the product configurator, the capability that lets the organization deliver equipment variants against firm engineering specifications at scale.
● Own the CAD-to-PLM Architecture: Drive the evaluation and recommendation on the primary CAD platform, balancing integration depth, scalability, migration effort, and team readiness; own the ongoing CAD and PLM vendor relationships, roadmap commitments, and support agreements.
● Engineering Change Management and Business Process Ownership: Define, release, and continuously improve the product-data management, change control, release, and requirements-management processes in PLM across the organization, and drive adoption to sustained usage.
● Compliance and Data Integrity: Own compliance and data governance for the PLM system; ensure product data, bills of materials, and engineering records meet quality, auditability, and security standards.
● Own PLM Integrations and Dependencies: Own the data contracts and integration pathways that connect PLM to the systems around it (enterprise resource planning, procurement, and downstream engineering and manufacturing tools), partnering with the owners of those systems to manage cross-team dependencies.
● Strategic Communication: Build consensus across engineering, manufacturing, finance, and partner teams; communicate complex technical trade-offs clearly and develop the narratives that inform leadership decisions.


About the team
Administration or related field, or adequate experience in business management
● Background in robotics, automation, or advanced hardware-based technological systems
● Understanding of supply chain and manufacturing optimization strategies
About the Team
Amazon installs a significant quantity of new buildings every year. The historical model has been to allow each integrator to use their own equipment, controls, subsystems, and methodologies. While that has allowed Amazon to be successful to this point, the variability between buildings has proven difficult to support and scale. One MHS' charge is to build partnerships focused on consistency and scalability across our network of the future. The PLM backbone this team owns is a foundation that makes that scalability possible; it is how we turn one engineer's design into a manufacturable, configurable, compliant product that any of our partners can build.

Basic qualifications

- 7+ years of technical product or program management experience
- 10+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
- Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules
- Subject matter expertise in Product Line Management (PLM) and/or Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) systems

Preferred qualifications

- 8+ years of hands-on work managing complex technology projects experience
- Experience managing projects across cross functional teams, building sustainable processes and coordinating release schedules
- MBA

title: AWS Commissioning, ACx Amazon Commissioning
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) provides a highly reliable, scalable, low-cost infrastructure platform in the cloud that powers hundreds of thousands of businesses in 190 countries around the world. To meet the growing demand for AWS cloud computing capacity in EMEA (Europe, Middle East and Africa) we are now looking for a Commissioning Engineer to join the team.

Are you experienced in Critical Infrastructure Commissioning?

As a Data Center Commissioning Engineer (CxE), you will be part of highly creative, efficient team tasked with tackling fascinating and challenging problems building and supporting the operations of AWS owned data centres, Hybrid Colo's, Single Tennent Colo and Multi Tennent Colo builds . The AWS Commissioning team (ACx) understands, evaluates, defines and manages the expectations of construction quality in accordance to engineering designs to meet the customer requirements.

Key job responsibilities
You will be responsible for supporting vendors, contractors and other teams involved in the construction and commissioning of various systems such as:

-Medium and low voltage power systems
-Generators
-UPS
-HVAC
-Chilled Water Systems
-Building Management systems (BMS)
-Electrical Power Monitoring Systems (EPMS)
-Testing and balancing
-Pumps and Hydronic systems

The CxE shall provide multi-discipline input into the scheduling, test script development, designing, and planning of projects. In addition, the CxE will be required to review component submittal packages, lead Factory Witness Testing (FWT), perform system level and integrated system testing. During commissioning, the CxE will continuously audit activities to ensure compliance with environmental, quality, and safety requirements. Additionally, the individual will be responsible for comprehensive weekly reporting of status of all ongoing projects and lessons learned to continually improve the quality of our program. This position will include coverage of multiple inflight projects.

A day in the life
The CxE's daily focus is to ensure the commissioning quality and progress meet AWS's high standards by:
Developing commissioning standards.
Reviewing, comment on, and creating commissioning scripts L1-L5.
Organize and attend meetings highlighting AWS requirements and tracking overall build and commissioning progress and blockers.
Performing site walks to identify installation and testing deficiencies and maintain observation logs.
Manage on-site 3rd-party commissioning vendors to ensure coverage of all Cx-activities.
Gather, organize, and review design and commissioning documentation.
Work with AWS partner teams to resolve coordination and delivery issues and report on project health and completion.

About the team
The AWS Data Center Commissioning Team (ACx) is a wholly independent business within the DCCD organization. This team of veteran professional Electrical Engineers, Mechanical Engineers, Controls Engineers, Architectural Engineers, Project Managers, Operators and seasoned Amazonians are uniquely positioned to provide deeply detailed engineering and operational review and testing of equipment designs, operational functionality and construction practices. We are focused on ensuring the rapid delivery of a quality product while maintaining full transparency, recording metrics of manufacturer/contractor/equipment issues pre-PFHO, and identifying opportunities for all our peers and customers.

- 4+ years of industrial or commercial engineering in mission critical facilities including but not limited to: data centers, power generation or oil and gas facilities experience
- 4+ years of commissioning experience
- Experience in industrial or commercial engineering in mission critical facilities including but not limited to: data centers, power generation or oil and gas facilities
- Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or a related field
- Bachelor's degree or above in civil engineering, structural engineering, or architectural engineering from an ABET accredited program
- PE (Professional Engineer) or SE (Structural Engineer) Engineering license
- Knowledge of Microsoft Office including Outlook, Word, and Excel
- Knowledge of building codes, regulations, and standards including IBC (International Building Code) and ASCE (American Society of Civil Engineers)

- Experience in commissioning

title: Technical Support Engineer I, Integrations, External System Integrations, Amazon Shipping
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Shipping delivers packages for businesses of every size across the United States and Europe. Shippers, e-commerce platforms and shipping software partners connect to us through our APIs to get rates, buy labels and track packages from pickup to doorstep. When one of those integrations breaks, a business stops shipping. The External System Integrations team exists to make sure that does not happen, and to fix it fast when it does.

Are you curious about why systems fail and motivated to stop them failing again? Do you enjoy explaining technical problems clearly to people who are not engineers? Amazon Shipping is seeking Support Engineers to help shippers and integration partners build and run business-critical integrations on our shipping APIs. You will investigate failing API calls, reproduce issues, resolve what you can and hand off what you cannot with a complete, clear write-up. You will learn our APIs end to end and grow from well-defined issue types into complex investigations.

Key job responsibilities
- Investigate and resolve support cases covering API errors, failed label creation, authentication problems, rate and coverage questions, and tracking data issues
- Analyze request and response payloads, HTTP status codes and service logs to determine whether an issue sits with the customer's request, their configuration, or our platform
- Reproduce reported issues in sandbox and test environments
- Follow runbooks and escalation paths, and escalate critical, high-impact issues promptly
- Hand off issues outside your scope with a clear summary of customer impact, steps taken, evidence gathered and the open question
- Help new developers through onboarding, including registration, credential setup and sandbox testing
- Track escalated cases to closure and keep customers informed
- Participate in an on-call rotation to respond to critical issues for customers in the United States and Europe
- Write and update runbooks and knowledge base articles
- Script small automations that remove repeated manual steps from your own case work

A day in the life
You start by picking up overnight cases from shippers in Europe. One partner is getting authentication errors after rotating credentials, so you check their token request, find the missing scope and walk them through the fix. A shipper's labels are failing for a handful of postcodes, so you reproduce the call in sandbox, confirm it is a coverage question, and reply with what is and is not serviceable. You join an office hours session to answer questions from a developer starting a new integration. In the afternoon you notice you have looked up the same field mapping three times this week, so you write a short script and add it to the team runbook.

About the team
The External System Integrations (ESI) team is part of Amazon Shipping, which delivers packages for businesses of every size across the United States and Europe. We work with enterprise shippers, e-commerce platforms and shipping software partners from their first API call through to live production volume. Our goal is to make integrating with Amazon Shipping fast and reliable, and to fix things quickly when they break. We value ownership, clear writing and automating repeated work. You will work closely with our Solutions Architects and with the Shipper Support team in San Jose.

Basic qualifications

- 1+ years of software development, or 1+ years of technical support experience
- Experience troubleshooting and debugging technical systems
- Experience working with REST API based services, or experience with REST web services, XML, JSON
- Experience in English-language communication skills, both written and verbal
- Experience working with databases and SQL

Preferred qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
- Experience with API testing tools such as Postman or cURL
- Knowledge of OAuth 2.0 or other token-based authentication

descriptionHtml:
Job description
AWS is looking for a Network Deploy Technician to join our growing team within infrastructure operations. You will work with minimum supervision in a dynamic environment to drive the stability and sustainability of our next-generation networks and assist in the development of innovative ways to automate and scale our network.

The position's responsibilities include scaling support of several data center locations and day to day assistance with capacity management. You will leverage your experience supporting large scale, enterprise class networks as well as network implementation and troubleshooting. In addition to providing management and support of AWS’ vast network infrastructure, Network Deploy Technicians establish and follow best practices and refine operational procedures.

All physical requirements are expected with reasonable accommodations:
• Regularly lift and/or move up to 40 pounds; and participate in group lifts for 41+ pounds

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. Traveling within and outside of regional work area is required. You will be responsible for having a reliable personal vehicle and valid driver's license to travel within the regional work area, as company transportation will not be provided.

A day in the life

Providing the first level networking devices to serve our customer racks entails various tasks (the name of the game is efficiency): You will track network rack intake and delivery; work with various onsite teams to request for rack space, power, and cooling for network racks. title: Safety Specialist I, Workplace Health and Safety (WHS), WHS Field
descriptionHtml:
アマゾンでは、“地球上で最もお客様を大切にする企業になること”というミッションを掲げ、日々改善と改革が行われています。
今回アマゾンの物流拠点/ Fulfillment Center（以下FC。）にて、もっとも重視されている「安全」に対する中核部門をLeadするWHS Managerを募集します。オペレーション各部門と効率的に連携し、大規模FCの安全活動をLeadし安全文化を創造することで、お客様一人一人に確実に商品をお届けすることに貢献する役割を担います。

本ポジションが所属するWHS(Workplace Health and Safety)Teamは、アマゾンの物流拠点であるFCで働くあらゆる立場の方が安全で安心した業務を行う為の環境を提供し、ルールを整備し、関係部署と連携することによって、FCの安全をLeadする部署です。
現場に即した安全を提供するために、慣例に捉われず、リスクを捉えつつ剛柔な判断を行い、本来の安全を追求していきます。

WHS managerは担当するFCの自然災害、火災、FC内でのオペレーションに関わるリスク検出をし、それらに対しての予防措置、是正措置の導入、安全に関わる事故の防止と削減を計画し、関連部署と実行していきます。マテハンなどのMachine safetyや作業安全管理、標準化した内容をFCで実行しつつ、より効果的で効率的な方法を検討しNetwork全体へも展開します。リスクの低減、教育システムの構築や、データ解析による事故低減といった幅広い役割と責任を担いつつ活躍できるポジションです。

具体的には、担当サイトのWHS年間目標と計画作成・実施支援、リスクアセスメント、内部監査の実施、防火・防災対策の計画立案と導入を行います。
また、部下を持つ場合は1-2名程度の直属の部下の採用、勤怠管理、業務指導、キャリア開発/育成、メンタル面のケア、エンゲージメントの向上に取り組んでいただきます。現場を何よりも大切にしているアマゾンであるため、Safetyのスキルをベースに自らが高い現場力を発揮することも求められます。

更に社内のあらゆる部門と関わるだけでなく、社外のパートナーと協働で体制を構築して続けることが重要な業務となるため、Safetyのスキルだけでなく、ビジネスマナーに優れ、高いコミュニケーションでパートナーシップを築ける能力をお持ちの方からのご応募をお待ちしております。

■ 勤務地: 千葉みなとFC
担当サイトでのオンサイト勤務が中心ですが、他サイトへ視察、監査、出張等もあります。

■ 勤務は月10日休みのシフト制となります。（勤務時間9:00～18:00、年間休日120日）
ただし繁忙期等、相談の上夜勤勤務が発生することがあります。

（未取得の方は取得していく必要あり）
※Outlook, Excel, Word, Power Pointなど使用

・担当職種(セーフティ)紹介：https://www.amazon.co.jp/b?node=5609901051
