title: Manager, Operations as a Service, North America Supply Chain (NASC)
descriptionHtml:
Amazon is a global technology and operations company serving customers across multiple businesses and geographies. Our teams build and operate scalable solutions across a wide range of functions, with a focus on customer experience, operational excellence, innovation, and continuous improvement. Employees work in a fast-paced environment, partnering across teams and geographies to solve complex business problems and deliver results at scale.
Operations as a Service (OaaS enables the business to deliver products and services to customers across the globe. Our teams manage complex, high-volume processes and continuously improve how work is executed through standardization, technology, data, and automation. The role offers an opportunity to work across teams and geographies, solve operational challenges, and drive improvements at scale.


Key job responsibilities
An OaaS Manager within GSRC typically leads teams of up to 20 associates, including SMEs and ICs supporting broader programs. The role requires cross-geography stakeholder management and collaboration across programs. Key responsibilities include:
• Business & Process Ownership: Own business metrics, process performance, and continuous improvement against defined goals.
• Stakeholder Management: Partner with stakeholders across geographies to understand business priorities, align execution, and deliver agreed business outcomes.
• Process Management: Onboard and stabilize new processes; identify and eliminate root causes of defects through cross-functional collaboration.
• Metrics & Business Reviews: Analyze trends and gaps; provide insights and contribute to WBRs, MBRs, QBRs, and other business reviews.
• Automation & Scaling: Identify and implement process improvements, automation, and scalable solutions; drive adoption across teams.
• SOP & Governance: Establish and maintain SOPs, processes, and tools to ensure consistent execution and performance.
• Talent Management: Set goals, coach and develop associates, SMEs, and ICs, and build functional and leadership capabilities.
• Hiring: Participate in internal and external hiring to build team capability.
• Workforce Management: Ensure schedule adherence and accurate tracking of productive/non-productive time and leave to maintain productivity and utilization accuracy.
• Flexibility to work in 24x7 shift and rotational weekly off

Basic qualifications

- Experience in team management
- Education: Graduate in any discipline, preferably with overall 6+ years of experience.
- People & Stakeholder Management: 3+ years of experience managing teams and partnering with customers and stakeholders to deliver business outcomes.
- Functional Ownership: 2+ years of independently managing a function or process.
- Analytical & Communication Skills: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with effective verbal and written business communication.

Preferred qualifications

- AI/ML & Automation: Working knowledge of AI/ML and experience identifying and implementing AI, automation, or data-driven solutions to improve business processes.

descriptionHtml:
Are you a passionate builder with an interest in solutions for Media and Entertainment? The Yahoo global account team is seeking a Sr Solutions Architect to work across multiple business units. Fluency in GenAI, AdTech, Security, and Media Services is strongly preferred.

As a Senior Solutions Architect (SA) at AWS, you'll be responsible for educating customers, partners, and internal stakeholders on emerging technologies and solutions that are transforming the M&E, Games, and Sports industries. You'll provide hands-on architectural guidance for real-life customer projects involving various AWS services and Independent Software Vendor (ISV)/partner solutions.

In this role, you'll be a content creator, a storyteller, and a presenter, building and publishing content. You'll work with customers remotely and in person, sharing your expertise and insights. This role includes domestic and potential international travel.

Our team puts a high value on work-life balance. Striking a healthy balance between your personal and professional life is crucial to your happiness and success here, which is why we aren’t focused on how many hours you spend at work or online. Instead, we’re happy to offer a flexible schedule so you can have a more productive and well-balanced life—both in and outside of work.

About AWS
Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.


AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and fastest growing small- and mid-market accounts to enterprise-level customers including public sector. The AWS Global Support team interacts with leading companies and believes that world-class support is critical to customer success. AWS Support also partners with a global list of customers that are building mission-critical applications on top of AWS services.

The AWS Industries team is committed to helping industry customers enable their digital transformation journeys. Our primary goal is to meet customers where they are in their cloud journey and work backwards from their industry specific needs to transform their business and their entire industry. Our team speaks the language of our industry customers, which means that we focus on business outcomes and industry use cases on behalf of our customers, whether that is how we build products and solutions, how we sell, how we deliver, or how we partner.

Key job responsibilities
Responsibilities include:

* Architect and deliver innovative, customer-obsessed solutions leveraging AWS services and partner offerings.
* Foster strategic partnerships with key industry players, driving thought leadership and shaping industry trends.
* Create high-quality enablement content, including guidance, blogs, demos, POCs, and presentations.
* Engage with customers, partners, and industry events to inspire and educate on the transformative potential of AWS solutions.
* Deliver written and spoken communications on complex ad-technology/content monetization subjects and establish AWS as the public cloud of choice for industry organizations looking to accelerate revenue growth and improve return on assets.

Basic qualifications

- 8+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics) experience
- 3+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience
- 10+ years of IT development or implementation/consulting in the software or Internet industries experience

Preferred qualifications

- 5+ years of infrastructure architecture, database architecture and networking experience
- Experience working with end user or developer communities
- Experience architecting/operating solutions built on AWS
- Experience within specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics).

title: Account Manager, Vendor Management, Retail Business Services (RBS)
descriptionHtml:
About Amazon.com
Amazon.com strives to be Earth's most customer-centric company where people can find and discover virtually anything they want to buy online. By giving customers more of what they want - low prices, vast selection, and convenience - Amazon.com continues to grow and evolve as a world-class e-commerce platform. Amazon's evolution from Web site to e-commerce partner to development platform is driven by the spirit of innovation that is part of the company's DNA. The world's brightest technology minds come to Amazon.com to research and develop technology that improves the lives of shoppers and sellers around the world.

About the Role
As an Account Manager, you are expected to demonstrate fluency in Japanese with substantial business experience in Japan, particularly in the online retail or e-commerce space. You should possess strong data analysis and business proposal capabilities, along with proficiency in leveraging AI to develop automation tools. You will own a specific product category and be responsible for identifying the most critical issues within a given period by analyzing fluctuations in key input metrics, conducting deep-dive analysis to uncover common root causes, and setting clear priorities to determine which vendors require one-on-one negotiation and which call for scaled solutions. You will also own the improvement of a designated key input metric within your scope, deeply analyzing the common drivers behind its fluctuations and fully leveraging AI to create automated solutions that address the top contributing factors at scale.

Key job responsibilities
1. Conduct in-depth data analysis on key input metrics such as selection, traffic, conversion, and profitability to identify growth opportunities and develop targeted, high-impact business proposals.
2. Negotiate directly with vendors on a one-on-one basis to secure commitment and drive actionable outcomes aligned with category goals.
3. Take ownership of category-level performance by continuously monitoring trends across key input metrics, diagnosing common root causes behind performance gaps, and designing scalable operational initiatives that drive improvement across the entire vendor portfolio.
4. Lead projects that leverage AI-powered tools and automation to build end-to-end operational workflows, reducing manual intervention and enabling the team to operate at greater scale and efficiency.
5. Collaborate cross-functionally with internal stakeholders to align on priorities, share best practices, and contribute to the continuous evolution of the team's operating model.

About the team
The vision of RBS MVR team is “To unlock the full potential of every vendor on Amazon through an intelligent scaling engine, that transforms how we recruit, launch, and grow our partners to deliver unparalleled selection and value to customers worldwide".

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree
- 2+ years of digital advertising and client facing roles experience
- Experience engaging, verbally and in writing, with internal and external stakeholders to convey complex ideas in a clear, concise manner
- Experience in data analysis, with the ability to interpret and draw insights from data to inform decision-making processes
- Experience identifying and resolving complex issues
- Experience working in a collaborative team environment to deliver high-quality design solutions
- Experience using AI-assisted development tools in academic or professional settings
- Speak, write, and read fluently in Japanese at a business level or above (N1+)
- Influencing and metrics management skills — ability to understand business metrics and create realistic forecasts; strong negotiation skills.

Preferred qualifications

- Speak, write, and read fluently in English
- 3+ years of sales or account management experience
- Knowledge of SQL, Python, Selenium and VBA
- - Study experience in Japan preferred.
- - Experience working in a Japanese local company preferred.

title: Frontend Engineer II, Ground Control Console
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is Amazon's low Earth orbit satellite network, built to deliver fast, reliable broadband to customers and communities around the world, including places traditional networks don't reach.

As a Frontend Engineer on the Leo Ground Control Console team, you'll build the web platform that Leo's engineers and operators use every day to run the constellation. That includes mission operations, network health, satellite and ground systems, and the leadership views that show how the network is performing. You'll own features end to end, from design through production, and see them used by the people flying and operating the network.

What you'll do
- Build and evolve a shared frontend platform that operator and leadership dashboards are built on: common components, charts, maps, tables, navigation, and mobile-friendly layouts, so every team ships a consistent, fast experience.
- Make operational tools fast and dependable at fleet scale. Profile and remove performance bottlenecks, design data-heavy views that stay responsive, and harden the platform against real-world failure modes.
- Instrument what you build. Use real-user monitoring and usage data to find where operators struggle, fix it, and measure the improvement.
- Work directly with engineering teams across ground and space systems to turn complex mission workflows into clear, easy-to-use tools.
- Raise the bar on engineering practice: shared design standards, automated code review, test and release tooling, and AI-assisted development workflows that help a small team move quickly without sacrificing quality.
- Support high-stakes moments such as launches, on-orbit operations and operational rehearsals, where the tools have to just work.

About you
You care about craft and about the people who use what you build. You're comfortable owning ambiguous problems, balancing several priorities at once, and staying calm under pressure. You have deep frontend engineering skills, enjoy making complex systems understandable, and like turning data into decisions. Experience with design systems, performance tuning or observability is a plus. Familiarity with space or network systems is welcome but not required; you'll learn the domain here.

Export Control Requirement:
Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

About the team
The Leo Ground Control Console team owns the operational tooling used across Amazon Leo, on the ground and in orbit. We build a shared platform that is scalable, reliable, adaptable and fast, so every team at Leo can deliver tools their users rely on. We're a small, high-ownership team that ships quickly, measures its impact, and invests in the tools and practices that make the whole organization more productive.

Key job responsibilities
Key job responsibilities
- Design, build, test and operate features end to end in the shared web platform behind Amazon Leo's operator and leadership tools, from design through production support.
- Build reusable components and patterns (tables, charts, maps, navigation, layouts and mobile views) that many teams adopt, and keep them consistent, accessible and well documented.
- Own the performance and reliability of data-heavy applications: measure real-user experience, find and fix bottlenecks, and make tools resilient to slow or failing dependencies.
- Add usage and error telemetry to what you ship, and use the data to prioritize improvements and show their impact.
- Partner with engineers, operators and product owners across ground and space systems to understand mission workflows and turn them into clear, efficient tools.
- Write high-quality, well-tested code, review others' changes, and help define the team's frontend standards, design guidelines and automated quality checks.
- Improve developer productivity through better tooling, CI/CD, test automation and AI-assisted development workflows.
- Participate in on-call and support launches, on-orbit operations and operational rehearsals, where the tools have to just work.

Basic qualifications

- 2+ years of non-internship professional front end, web or mobile software development using JavaScript, HTML and CSS experience
- 2+ years of computer science fundamentals (object-oriented design, data structures, algorithm design, problem solving and complexity analysis) experience
- Experience using JavaScript frameworks such as angular and react

Preferred qualifications

- 1+ years of agile software development methodology experience
- Experience with common front-end technologies such as HTML, CSS, JS, TypeScript, and Node

title: Communications Engineer, Production Network Performance, Amazon Leo
descriptionHtml:
We are looking for an engineer who builds data pipelines and writes code to understand a live satellite network. Amazon Leo is an initiative to launch a constellation of Low Earth Orbit satellites that will provide low-latency, high-speed broadband connectivity to unserved and underserved communities around the world. You will monitor Amazon Leo's live satellite network against what our simulations predict, and use what you find to improve the performance our customers receive. You will help build and run an automated pipeline that compares real-time system and network data with simulation predictions, finds where performance falls short, and helps drive each problem to resolution with the many teams involved. A problem can sit anywhere in the system: satellites and their optical inter-satellite links, gateways, user terminals, the satellite telemetry, tracking and command (TT&C) link, and the software that connects them. The team also supports satellite operations: launch and early orbit, gateway and TT&C station assignments, and the satellite communication links that carry them. The team takes part in an on-call rotation for problems that affect customers or operations.

You will join a new, interdisciplinary team that covers software and data pipelines, radio frequency (RF) and satellite communication link performance (user, gateway and TT&C links), software and data pipelines, artificial intelligence and machine learning (AI/ML) automation, networking, systems integration and test, and production operations and troubleshooting, and that works closely with the modeling and simulation, hardware, software and operations teams across Amazon Leo.

Export Control Requirement
Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident that is a current Green Card holder, or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.


Key job responsibilities
Data pipeline and performance framework
- Build, maintain and use the team's automated pipeline that brings live system and network data, simulation predictions and test measurements together
- Design how the data is stored, queried and kept at scale, so that the pipeline runs reliably and unattended across the whole network
- Write the code that joins sources logged at different rates and times, and keep each record's context with it so that later analysis can explain it
- Integrate simulations and models developed by other teams into the team's framework, and co-develop each tool's automation interface with the team that owns it
- Compare live performance with simulation predictions within tolerances that reflect what each prediction means, and report when the model, not the network, looks wrong

Rapid detection of changes that affect customers
- Build AI, machine learning and automation steps into the pipeline to rapidly detect, group and triage changes that affect customers, and check their conclusions against independent evidence
- Develop statistical change-detection methods that flag when performance moves away from the network's own history
- Turn large telemetry data sets into trends, visualizations and findings the team and its partners can act on

Troubleshooting and resolution
- Help trace performance problems to their root causes across RF, software, hardware and networking, by comparing affected and unaffected terminals, satellites and gateways
- Confirm a cause with an independent measurement, or reproduce the fault in simulation or test
- Hand each cause, with its evidence, to the team that owns the fix, and verify after the fix that customers see the improvement

Documentation and collaboration
- Build up a database of anomaly signatures, so that each investigation builds on earlier ones and known problems are recognized quickly
- Work with the simulation, test, satellite, gateway, terminal and software teams across our organization to get the data and evidence each investigation needs

A day in the life



About the team
We are a new team inside Amazon Leo’s communication systems organization. We turn live network data into clear answers about the performance customers receive, and then work with subject matter experts to improve the customers’ experience. Amazon Leo’s network serves consumers, businesses and government organizations; within Amazon Leo, the team supports the engineering and operations teams that need reliable evidence of how the network performs.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Systems Engineering, or related fields
- 5+ years of experience in data engineering, software engineering or data analysis
- Experience building automated data pipelines that join and process large data sets, using SQL and Python or similar
- Experience analyzing telemetry, log or field data to find the root cause of a problem
- Experience writing software, for example in Python, C++ or MATLAB, with version control and testing, to automate analysis or test

Preferred qualifications

- Master’s degree in electrical engineering, statistics or a related field
- Experience operating or supporting a production network or satellite system
- Experience with RF, satellite or wireless communication systems: link budgets, link adaptation, or link and network performance
- Experience building AI/ML steps into automated data processing flows, with checks on their output
- Experience in satellite, wireless or network systems engineering, integration and test, or operations
- Experience with data lakes and query engines at scale, for example Athena, Spark or Redshift

title: Business Intelligence Engineer II, Compliance Shared Services (CoSS)
descriptionHtml:

As a BIE, you will focus on improving the success within business functions by analyzing data, discovering and solving real world problems, building metrics and business cases to improve customer experience, and providing timely data support for escalations to mitigate risk. We are focused on your success and want to build future leaders within Amazon. A key component of the role is to identify process and system improvement opportunities by developing the right metrics, analyzing data, and partnering with internal teams. The successful candidate will be a self-starter comfortable with ambiguity, with strong attention to detail, an ability to work in a fast-paced and ever-changing environment, and driven by a desire to innovate in this space.

title: Data Center Operations Technician, Data Center Operations
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is growing rapidly, and we are looking for Data Center Technician to join our expanding Infrastructure Operations team.

Data Center Operations designs, installs and maintains the world’s largest Computing Infrastructure. Our scope of work includes systems, repairing, dealing with issues, handling and tracking parts and assisting in Data Center maintenance. Amazon Data Centers are large-scale high-density centers where you will help change the face of Technology in the region.


Key job responsibilities
In this role as a Data Center Operations Technician, you will be responsible for the on-site management of hardware lifecycle of our IT infrastructure that includes:


- You will work as part of the Operations team; whose primary responsibility is the maintenance and upkeep of the data center infrastructure.
- Your role and responsibilities include, but are not limited to, server rack installation, hardware break-fix on various components, troubleshooting network issues also responding to emergent situations that affect operational stability.
- You will work and meet SLAs against assigned trouble tickets via a directed workflow, be the first line touch point for hardware troubleshooting and technical issues.

title: Operations Manager
descriptionHtml:
Operations is the beating heart of Amazon. This key part of our business makes sure we fulfil and dispatch orders efficiently so that our customers get their items on time. It’s driven by Operations Managers who bring the team together to push excellence in safety, quality and productivity across our sites. At your site, you’ll lead other managers and create the operational plan that helps your teams meet their targets. This role is all about driving operational excellence to create the Amazon of tomorrow.

Key job responsibilities
- Manage and develop a team of Area Managers
- Lead operational teams on a shift, deal with issues, and positively impact site performance
- Analyse shift performance against relevant business objectives, and put in place actions to improve our operational excellence
- Work closely with other support teams, including HR, Finance, Health and Safety, and Security
- Design and deliver initiatives across the sites to improve operational performance

A day in the life
You’ll lead shifts at one of our operational sites. You’ll also be the key link between a number of teams, including finance, safety and operations integration teams. That means you’ll be close to the day-to-day operations at your site but also contribute to new ways to innovate at your site.

A typical day will involve meetings with different areas of the business, deep diving into performance and risk metrics for sites, and looking ahead to prepare for different levels of demand. Every day will also involve mentoring and coaching your team. You’ll be a source of leadership and support your team to be the best managers they can be.

About the team
Amazon Extra Large (AMXL) looks after heavy items like furniture and large home appliances. Our team manages the entire service, from supply chain fulfilment to delivery and returns. What sets this service apart from others is the extra level of customer care. Not only do we deliver large items, but we unpack, assemble and install them, and take away old items where needed. With a focus on safety, productivity and innovation, we’re changing the way customers buy and receive large goods for the better.

We have ambitious plans to expand our specialist fulfilment centres and delivery stations across the UK and Europe. While those of us who work in delivery stations will do some night shifts, most of us work during the day. Our team is made up of people across operations, supply chain, business intelligence and programme management, and everyone plays a crucial role in growing this part of the business.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree, or Master's degree
- Relevant experience in manufacturing, production, distribution logistics environments, retail, or grocery in a management role
- Relevant experience of working within a complex stakeholder structure
- Advanced proficiency in verbal and written English and upper intermediate proficiency in the local language

Preferred qualifications

- Preferred qualifications are not required to apply for a position at Amazon. If you have all the basic qualifications above, we’d love to hear from you.
- A bachelor’s, advanced or master’s degree in engineering, supply chain, logistics, or manufacturing
- Experience in managing third-party relationships
- Experience of applying Lean, Six Sigma, and Kaizen methodologies

title: Software Development Manager, Observability & Digital Thread, Amazon Leo, D2D Software
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is building a low Earth orbit satellite constellation to bring fast, affordable connectivity to customers around the world. Direct to Device (D2D) extends Leo to standard mobile phones and devices: a fully regenerative fifth-generation (5G) mobile base station on each satellite, delivering service to standard handsets through mobile network operators (MNOs). D2D Software builds the embedded software that flies, the cloud and ground software that runs the service, and the platform that connects them. Our target is under a day from a defect being found to the fix deployed across the entire constellation, achieved by automating everything that a person would otherwise do by hand.

This role leads observability and digital thread in DevOps & Release, reporting to the Director, DevOps & Release. It owns telemetry ingest, anomaly detection, dashboards, and traceability. Before anything is handed on, the bar is: detect-and-trace time within budget. It hands off to its customers as follows: telemetry, dashboards, and traceability to every team and Software Delivery & Business Ops.

What the team needs to achieve
• Detect-and-trace time within budget.
• Hand-offs that meet their service level: telemetry, dashboards, and traceability to every team and Software Delivery & Business Ops.
• Measured, rising capability and efficiency of the team, with manual work falling release over release.

How the team is measured
• Detect-and-trace time.
• Status derived from the systems of record.

Export Control Requirement:
Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.


Key job responsibilities
• Own telemetry ingest, anomaly detection, dashboards, and traceability.
• Meet the bar before every hand-off: detect-and-trace time within budget.
• Work directly with engineers in the boundary teams as partners, through agreed contracts and service levels.
• Automate everything a person would otherwise do twice.
• Hire, coach, and grow the team, with clear expectations and career development for every engineer.
• Define the team's metrics and service levels, and improve them release over release.
• Make the team's decisions data-driven and its quality measurable, and escalate early when risks cross team boundaries.
• Set the team's roadmap and the structure and mechanisms that deliver it, and negotiate the boundaries of the area with peer teams.
• Build the mechanisms and best practices that make the team's work repeatable, measurable, and improving.



A day in the life
What success looks like in the first twelve months
• Fleet telemetry flowing into one pipeline.
• Traceability from requirement to release live.




About the team
D2D Software is an evolving organization of many teams: Software Architecture & Specifications; Software Delivery & Business Ops; Software Integration, Verification & Reliability; DevOps & Release; Satellite Software Development; Ground Software Development; and Customer Software Engineering & Support. Each Director owns business outcomes: delivering the commitments, and the capability and efficiency of their teams. Teams work as internal customers and suppliers with agreed service levels, interfaces are agreed centrally while designs stay local, and engineers are expected to work directly with engineers across every boundary. Milestones are committed deadlines for delivery with quality, not gates to wait on, and every team runs on one toolchain and one system of record. Every measure is derived from the systems of record, never self-reported, and we improve release over release with a target of perfection.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field
- 5+ years of software development experience
- Experience in managing technical teams with significant personnel management experience and examples of developing engineers and building successful teams
- Experience establishing workflows, metrics, and service levels for a team, and making data-driven trade-offs between short- and long-term needs
- Experience leading a team where the problem and strategy are not yet fully defined, working backwards from the customer
- Experience building observability for large fleets or services, including telemetry pipelines and anomaly detection
- Experience integrating systems of record for traceability
- Experience across the full software development lifecycle, having shipped software and maintained it in production

Preferred qualifications

- A record of writing clear narratives and running data-driven reviews
- Experience with telemetry from embedded devices or satellites
- Experience with AI-assisted anomaly triage
- Experience managing managers or leading several teams
- Experience setting a multi-year direction for an area, designing the team structure and mechanisms to deliver it, and aligning several teams around it
- Experience setting strategy where the problem, opportunity, and strategy are not defined, telling one-way from two-way doors, and presenting decisions and strategy narratives to senior leaders across the organization

title: Senior Software Development Engineer, Ads - Full-Funnel Agentic Intelligence & Models (FAIM)
descriptionHtml:
Build intelligent systems that reason, plan and act on behalf of millions of advertisers. This newly formed team is building the next generation of Full Funnel Optimization for Amazon Advertising. It combines large language models, traditional optimization and Amazon's first-party data on shopper behavior and conversion patterns to deliver insights and optimizations that far outperform manual campaign management.

The goal is to give millions of sellers and brands the kind of advanced optimization tools that used to be available only through agencies or expensive third-party providers. You'll own the architectural direction for the team's AI systems in an ambiguous space, where both the business problem and the solution approach still need to be defined. The work ranges from guiding less experienced sellers through campaign setup to automatically surfacing optimization opportunities that help advertisers succeed.

Key job responsibilities
- Own the architectural direction for full funnel optimization systems that combine LLMs, traditional optimization and first-party shopper data, making foundational decisions on how they evolve
- Lead the design and delivery of complex end-to-end AI solutions in problem areas where both the business problem and the technical approach need to be defined
- Drive the team's engineering strategy and influence the product roadmap, giving context on current and future technology choices
- Build agentic capabilities that reason, plan and act for advertisers, from guided campaign setup to automatically surfacing optimization opportunities
- Build consensus with stakeholders, scientists and engineering peers across multiple teams, and make strategic recommendations on system architecture and implementation
- Mentor engineers and help set the engineering foundations of a newly formed team

About the team
We're a newly formed team in Amazon Advertising building the next generation of Full Funnel Optimization. We combine large language models, traditional optimization and Amazon's first-party data on shopper behavior and conversion patterns to build intelligent systems that reason, plan and act on behalf of advertisers. Our goal is to give millions of sellers and brands the kind of advanced optimization tools that used to be available only through agencies or expensive third-party providers.

- 5+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 5+ years of programming with at least one software programming language experience

Our mission at Amazon is to be Earth’s most customer-centric company, and our award-winning Customer Service team is a key part of achieving that goal.
